class IctProjectCreate(BaseModel):
    system_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = None
    project_title: str = Field(..., max_length=255, example="Citizen Frontline Portal Modernization and GovCloud Migration Project")
    project_category: Union[ProjectCategory, str] = Field(default="Internal ICT Projects")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    objectives: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    
    # Strategic Alignment Checklists
    aligns_pip: bool = Field(default=False)
    aligns_ncsp: bool = Field(default=False)
    aligns_egmp: bool = Field(default=False)
    aligns_pcb: bool = Field(default=False)
    aligns_others: bool = Field(default=False, description="Strategic Alignment 'Others (Specify)'")
    aligns_others_specify: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=255)
    
    # Dynamic Harmonization Framework Criteria
    harmonization_criteria: Dict[str, bool] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Dynamic harmonization criteria map, e.g. {'National Prioritization': true, 'PeGIF': true, ...}"
    )

    # Legacy booleans preserved for backward compatibility
    harmonizes_national_priority: bool = Field(default=False)
    harmonizes_resource_optimization: bool = Field(default=False)
    harmonizes_pegif: bool = Field(default=False)
    harmonizes_cross_collaboration: bool = Field(default=False)
    harmonizes_scalability: bool = Field(default=False)
    
    duration_start_year: Optional[int] = Field(default=2026, example=2026)
    duration_end_year: Optional[int] = Field(default=2028, example=2028)
    
    # Dynamic Multi-Year Deliverables / Milestones Map (2 to 5+ Years)
    annual_deliverables: Dict[str, str] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, 
        description="Dynamic year-keyed deliverables map, e.g. {'2028': '...', '2029': '...', '2030': '...'}"
    )
    
    year_1_deliverables: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    year_2_deliverables: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    year_3_deliverables: Optional[str] = Field(default="")
    
    implementing_unit: Optional[str] = Field(default="ICT Management Office")
    funding_source: Union[FundSource, str] = Field(default="General Appropriations Act (GAA)")
    lead_agency: Optional[str] = None
    partner_agencies: Optional[str] = None

    @field_validator('system_id', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_system_id(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_optional_uuid(v)

    @field_validator('project_category', 'funding_source', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_cat_funding(cls, v: Any) -> str:
        return str(getattr(v, 'value', v) or "")

    @field_validator('annual_deliverables', 'harmonization_criteria', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_dynamic_dicts(cls, v: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return deserialize_dict_if_string(v)

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def sync_criteria_and_deliverables(self) -> 'IctProjectCreate':
        if not self.harmonization_criteria:
            self.harmonization_criteria = {
                "National Prioritization (PDP 2023-2028)": self.harmonizes_national_priority,
                "Resource Optimization (GovNet, GovCloud)": self.harmonizes_resource_optimization,
                "PeGIF Standardized APIs & Interoperability": self.harmonizes_pegif,
                "Cross-Agency Collaboration (JMC / MOA)": self.harmonizes_cross_collaboration,
                "Scalability and Sustainability (SPAR / PREXC)": self.harmonizes_scalability
            }
        else:
            for k, val in self.harmonization_criteria.items():
                k_lower = k.lower()
                b_val = bool(val)
                if "priority" in k_lower or "pdp" in k_lower: self.harmonizes_national_priority = b_val
                if "resource" in k_lower or "cloud" in k_lower or "govnet" in k_lower: self.harmonizes_resource_optimization = b_val
                if "interoperability" in k_lower or "pegif" in k_lower or "api" in k_lower: self.harmonizes_pegif = b_val
                if "cross" in k_lower or "collaboration" in k_lower or "jmc" in k_lower: self.harmonizes_cross_collaboration = b_val
                if "scalability" in k_lower or "sustainability" in k_lower or "spar" in k_lower or "prexc" in k_lower: self.harmonizes_scalability = b_val

        # Synchronize annual deliverables bidirectionally with year-by-year keys
        if not self.annual_deliverables:
            deliverables = {}
            start_yr = self.duration_start_year or 2026
            if self.year_1_deliverables:
                deliverables["Year 1"] = self.year_1_deliverables
                deliverables[str(start_yr)] = self.year_1_deliverables
            if self.year_2_deliverables:
                deliverables["Year 2"] = self.year_2_deliverables
                deliverables[str(start_yr + 1)] = self.year_2_deliverables
            if self.year_3_deliverables:
                deliverables["Year 3"] = self.year_3_deliverables
                deliverables[str(start_yr + 2)] = self.year_3_deliverables
            self.annual_deliverables = deliverables
        else:
            start_yr_str = str(self.duration_start_year or 2026)
            if not self.year_1_deliverables:
                self.year_1_deliverables = self.annual_deliverables.get("Year 1") or self.annual_deliverables.get(start_yr_str) or ""
            if not self.year_2_deliverables:
                self.year_2_deliverables = self.annual_deliverables.get("Year 2") or self.annual_deliverables.get(str(int(start_yr_str) + 1)) or ""
            if not self.year_3_deliverables:
                self.year_3_deliverables = self.annual_deliverables.get("Year 3") or self.annual_deliverables.get(str(int(start_yr_str) + 2)) or ""
        return self

class ProposalCreatePayload(BaseModel):
    # Optional provenance fields: Department users submit raw technical needs;
    # Admin assigns Outcome, Project, Strategic Category, Office, and Fund Source upon review.
    outcome_id: Optional[int] = Field(None, description="Target Organizational Outcome ID (Broader Scope)")
    department_id: Optional[int] = Field(None, description="Target Department ID (Admin assignment)")
    needs_assessment_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = Field(None, description="Linked Department Needs Assessment")
    strategic_category_id: Optional[int] = Field(None, description="Optional foreign key to StrategicCategory")
    subscription_type: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Subscription type designation")
    project_key: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Project key identifier")
    project_id: Optional[Union[uuid.UUID, str]] = Field(None, description="Linked Strategic ICT Project ID")
    
    # High-level classification intent
    category: Optional[str] = Field(default="Hardware", description="Hardware, Software, Subscription, or Services")
    strategic_category: Optional[str] = Field(default="Office Productivity", description="Dynamic Strategic Category")
    office_location: Optional[str] = Field(default="Central Office")
    fund_source: Optional[str] = Field(default="General Appropriations Act (GAA)")
    
    item_select: str = Field(default="other", description="Catalog key identifier ('other' for custom requests)")
    item_name: str = Field(..., max_length=255, description="Name and description of item requested")
    unit_cost: Decimal = Field(..., ge=0, description="Unit cost in Philippine Peso (PHP)")

    # Arbitrary multi-year planning horizon (2 to 5+ years)
    yearly_quantities: Dict[str, int] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, 
        description="Arbitrary multi-year quantity mapping, e.g. {'2028': 5, '2029': 2, '2030': 4, ...}"
    )
    year_1_qty: Optional[int] = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    year_2_qty: Optional[int] = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    year_3_qty: Optional[int] = Field(default=0, ge=0)

    justification: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Detailed technical justification")
    system_development_status: Optional[str] = Field(
        default="N/A",
        description="For Development / For Enhancement if total budget threshold is reached"
    )

    created_by_students: bool = Field(
        default=False, 
        description="Flag indicating in-house / non-commercial internally developed software"
    )
    is_in_house_turnover: Optional[bool] = Field(
        default=None, 
        description="Generic public-sector alias for internally developed / non-commercial asset turnovers"
    )

    canvas_evidence_url: Optional[str] = None
    canvas_expiration_date: Optional[datetime] = None
    supplier_name: Optional[str] = None
    is_expansion: bool = Field(default=False, description="True if adding new capacity rather than replacing retired units")

    uacs_object_code: Optional[str] = None
    expenditure_class: Optional[str] = None

    @field_validator('project_id', 'needs_assessment_id', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_uuid_selectors(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_optional_uuid(v)

    @field_validator('category', 'strategic_category', 'office_location', 'fund_source', 'system_development_status', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_dynamic_string(cls, v: Any) -> Optional[str]:
        if v is None:
            return None
        return str(getattr(v, 'value', v) or "").strip()

    @field_validator('item_select', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def clean_item_select(cls, v: Any) -> str:
        s = clean_optional_string(v)
        return s if s else "other"

    @field_validator('canvas_evidence_url', 'supplier_name', 'uacs_object_code', 'expenditure_class', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def clean_empty_strings(cls, v: Any) -> Optional[str]:
        return clean_optional_string(v)

    @field_validator('canvas_expiration_date', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def parse_canvas_expiration(cls, v: Any) -> Optional[datetime]:
        if v is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(v, datetime):
            return v
        s = str(v).strip()
        if not s or s.lower() in ("none", "null", "undefined", ""):
            return None
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except Exception:
            return None

    @field_validator('item_name', 'justification', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def clean_and_sanitize_inputs(cls, v: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
        return sanitize_text(v)

    @field_validator('yearly_quantities', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_quantities(cls, v: Any) -> Dict[str, int]:
        parsed = deserialize_dict_if_string(v)
        res = {}
        for key, val in parsed.items():
            try:
                res[str(key).strip()] = int(val) if val is not None else 0
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                res[str(key).strip()] = 0
        return res

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def sync_quantities_and_aliases(self) -> 'ProposalCreatePayload':
        if not self.category:
            self.category = "Hardware"
        if not self.strategic_category:
            self.strategic_category = "Office Productivity"
        if not self.office_location:
            self.office_location = "Central Office"
        if not self.fund_source:
            self.fund_source = "General Appropriations Act (GAA)"
        if not self.system_development_status:
            self.system_development_status = "N/A"

        # Bidirectional turnover alias sync
        if self.is_in_house_turnover is not None:
            self.created_by_students = bool(self.is_in_house_turnover)
        elif self.created_by_students:
            self.is_in_house_turnover = True
        else:
            self.is_in_house_turnover = False
            self.created_by_students = False

        # Synchronize yearly quantities across any planning horizon
        if self.yearly_quantities and len(self.yearly_quantities) > 0:
            years_sorted = sorted([k for k in self.yearly_quantities.keys() if str(k).isdigit()])
            if len(years_sorted) >= 1:
                self.year_1_qty = int(self.yearly_quantities.get(years_sorted[0], 0) or 0)
            if len(years_sorted) >= 2:
                self.year_2_qty = int(self.yearly_quantities.get(years_sorted[1], 0) or 0)
            if len(years_sorted) >= 3:
                self.year_3_qty = int(self.yearly_quantities.get(years_sorted[2], 0) or 0)
        else:
            self.yearly_quantities = {
                "Year 1": self.year_1_qty or 0,
                "Year 2": self.year_2_qty or 0,
                "Year 3": self.year_3_qty or 0
            }

        return self

    department_id: int
    allocated_capex: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal("0.00"), ge=0)
    allocated_mooe: Decimal = Field(default=Decimal("0.00"), ge=0)
    sub_ceiling: Optional[Decimal] = None
    annual_allocations: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def resolve_sub_ceiling_assignment(self) -> 'UpdateCeilingPayload':
        if self.sub_ceiling is not None and self.allocated_capex == Decimal("0.00") and self.allocated_mooe == Decimal("0.00"):
            self.allocated_capex = Decimal(str(self.sub_ceiling)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
            self.allocated_mooe = Decimal("0.00")
        return self

    issp_period_from: Optional[int] = Field(None, example=2028)
    issp_period_to: Optional[int] = Field(None, example=2030)
    agency_website_url: Optional[str] = None
    website_url: Optional[str] = None

    amendment_number: Optional[str] = None
    scope_choice: Optional[Union[ScopeChoice, str]] = ScopeChoice.DEPARTMENT_WIDE
    scope_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    is_active: Optional[bool] = False

    signatory_prepared_by: Optional[str] = None
    preparer_position: Optional[str] = None
    preparer_tel: Optional[str] = None
    preparer_fax: Optional[str] = None
    preparer_email: Optional[str] = None

    cio_name: Optional[str] = None
    cio_plantilla_position: Optional[str] = None
    cio_organizational_unit: Optional[str] = None
    cio_email: Optional[str] = None
    cio_contact_no: Optional[str] = None

    focal_name: Optional[str] = None
    focal_position: Optional[str] = None
    focal_organizational_unit: Optional[str] = None
    focal_email: Optional[str] = None
    focal_contact_no: Optional[str] = None

    head_of_agency_name: Optional[str] = None
    agency_head_position: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Official title/position of the Head of Agency")
    signatory_approved_by: Optional[str] = None

    # Normalized Clean Plain-Text Fields
    mandate_text: Optional[str] = ""
    functions: Optional[str] = None
    vision_text: Optional[str] = ""
    mission_text: Optional[str] = ""
    present_situation_text: Optional[str] = ""
    enterprise_architecture_narrative: Optional[str] = None

    # Backward-compatible HTML property aliases
    mandate_html: Optional[str] = None
    legal_basis: Optional[str] = None
    vision_html: Optional[str] = None
    vision_statement: Optional[str] = None
    mission_html: Optional[str] = None
    mission_statement: Optional[str] = None
    present_situation_html: Optional[str] = None

    # Official Schematics & Seals (Canonical 4 Schematics Standard)
    agency_logo_url: Optional[str] = None
    dict_logo_url: Optional[str] = None
    bagong_pilipinas_logo_url: Optional[str] = None
    network_diagram_url: Optional[str] = None
    fiber_backbone_url: Optional[str] = None
    system_architecture_url: Optional[str] = None
    org_chart_url: Optional[str] = None
    existing_ict_org_url: Optional[str] = None
    proposed_ict_org_url: Optional[str] = None
    site_development_plan_url: Optional[str] = None
    process_flow_diagram_url: Optional[str] = None

    drbcp_approval_date: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Official approval date of the DRBCP")
    drbcp_affected_assets_json: Optional[List[Any]] = None
    drbcp_recovery_strategy_text: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_sop_phases_text: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_compliance_narrative_text: Optional[str] = None
    
    # Backward-compatible DRBCP aliases
    drbcp_recovery_strategy_html: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_sop_phases_html: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_compliance_narrative_html: Optional[str] = None

    is_archived: Optional[bool] = False
    final_pdf_vault_url: Optional[str] = None
    final_docx_vault_url: Optional[str] = None

    planners_json: Optional[List[ISPlannerSchema]] = Field(default=[])
    manpower_json: Optional[ManpowerSchema] = None
    annual_ict_budget: Optional[Decimal] = Decimal("0.00")

    @field_validator(
        'preparer_email', 'cio_email', 'focal_email', 'agency_website_url', 
        'website_url', 'agency_logo_url', 'dict_logo_url', 'bagong_pilipinas_logo_url', 
        'network_diagram_url', 'fiber_backbone_url', 'system_architecture_url',
        'org_chart_url', 'existing_ict_org_url', 'proposed_ict_org_url',
        'site_development_plan_url', 'process_flow_diagram_url', 
        'final_pdf_vault_url', 'final_docx_vault_url',
        mode='before'
    )
    @classmethod
    def sanitize_emails_and_urls(cls, v: Any) -> Optional[str]:
        return clean_optional_string(v)

    @field_validator('scope_choice', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_scope_choice(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_enum(ScopeChoice, v) or ScopeChoice.DEPARTMENT_WIDE

    @field_validator('drbcp_affected_assets_json', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_json_lists(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return deserialize_list_if_string(v)

    @field_validator('scope_json', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_scope_json(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return deserialize_dict_if_string(v)

    @model_validator(mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def synchronize_plain_text_and_html_inputs(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            # Sync mandate
            if not data.get("mandate_text"):
                data["mandate_text"] = data.get("mandate_html") or data.get("legal_basis") or ""
            # Sync vision
            if not data.get("vision_text"):
                data["vision_text"] = data.get("vision_html") or data.get("vision_statement") or ""
            # Sync mission
            if not data.get("mission_text"):
                data["mission_text"] = data.get("mission_html") or data.get("mission_statement") or ""
            # Sync situation
            if not data.get("present_situation_text"):
                data["present_situation_text"] = data.get("present_situation_html") or ""
            # Sync DRBCP sections
            if not data.get("drbcp_recovery_strategy_text"):
                data["drbcp_recovery_strategy_text"] = data.get("drbcp_recovery_strategy_html")
            if not data.get("drbcp_sop_phases_text"):
                data["drbcp_sop_phases_text"] = data.get("drbcp_sop_phases_html")
            if not data.get("drbcp_compliance_narrative_text"):
                data["drbcp_compliance_narrative_text"] = data.get("drbcp_compliance_narrative_html")

            # Signatories name resolution
            cio = data.get("cio_name") or data.get("signatory_prepared_by")
            if cio and str(cio).strip():
                data["cio_name"] = str(cio).strip()
                data["signatory_prepared_by"] = str(cio).strip()

            head = data.get("head_of_agency_name") or data.get("signatory_approved_by")
            if head and str(head).strip():
                data["head_of_agency_name"] = str(head).strip()
                data["signatory_approved_by"] = str(head).strip()
        return data


class MasterNarrativeResponse(BaseModel):
    issp_period: str
    agency_name: Optional[str] = None
    issp_period_from: int
    issp_period_to: int
    website_url: Optional[str] = None
    agency_website_url: Optional[str] = None
    is_amendment: bool = False
    amendment_number: Optional[str] = None
    scope_choice: Optional[Union[ScopeChoice, str]] = None
    scope_json: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    is_active: bool
    
    # Official Text Signatories (Formal Physical Sign-off Lines)
    signatory_prepared_by: Optional[str] = ""
    cio_name: Optional[str] = None
    preparer_position: Optional[str] = None
    cio_plantilla_position: Optional[str] = None
    cio_organizational_unit: Optional[str] = None
    preparer_email: Optional[str] = None
    cio_email: Optional[str] = None
    preparer_tel: Optional[str] = None
    cio_contact_no: Optional[str] = None

    focal_name: Optional[str] = None
    focal_position: Optional[str] = None
    focal_organizational_unit: Optional[str] = None
    focal_email: Optional[str] = None
    focal_contact_no: Optional[str] = None

    signatory_approved_by: Optional[str] = ""
    head_of_agency_name: Optional[str] = None
    agency_head_position: Optional[str] = None

    # Normalized Clean Plain Text Fields
    mandate_text: str = ""
    functions: Optional[str] = None
    vision_text: str = ""
    mission_text: str = ""
    present_situation_text: str = ""
    enterprise_architecture_narrative: Optional[str] = None

    # Backward-compatible HTML aliases populated in response
    mandate_html: Optional[str] = ""
    legal_basis: Optional[str] = None
    vision_html: Optional[str] = ""
    vision_statement: Optional[str] = None
    mission_html: Optional[str] = ""
    mission_statement: Optional[str] = None
    present_situation_html: Optional[str] = None

    # Official Logos and Diagrams
    agency_logo_url: Optional[str] = None
    dict_logo_url: Optional[str] = None
    bagong_pilipinas_logo_url: Optional[str] = None
    network_diagram_url: Optional[str] = None
    fiber_backbone_url: Optional[str] = None
    system_architecture_url: Optional[str] = None
    org_chart_url: Optional[str] = None
    existing_ict_org_url: Optional[str] = None
    proposed_ict_org_url: Optional[str] = None
    site_development_plan_url: Optional[str] = None
    process_flow_diagram_url: Optional[str] = None

    drbcp_approval_date: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_affected_assets_json: Optional[List[Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    drbcp_recovery_strategy_text: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_sop_phases_text: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_compliance_narrative_text: Optional[str] = None

    # Backward-compatible DRBCP aliases
    drbcp_recovery_strategy_html: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_sop_phases_html: Optional[str] = None
    drbcp_compliance_narrative_html: Optional[str] = None

    is_archived: bool = False
    final_pdf_vault_url: Optional[str] = None
    final_docx_vault_url: Optional[str] = None

    planners_json: List[ISPlannerSchema] = []
    annual_ict_budget: Decimal = Decimal("0.00")
    authoring_cycle_duration: Optional[int] = 3

    @field_validator('scope_choice', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_scope_choice(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_enum(ScopeChoice, v)

    @field_validator('drbcp_affected_assets_json', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_json_lists(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return deserialize_list_if_string(v)

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def populate_narrative_aliases(self) -> 'MasterNarrativeResponse':
        if not self.mandate_text and self.mandate_html:
            self.mandate_text = self.mandate_html
        if not self.vision_text and self.vision_html:
            self.vision_text = self.vision_html
        if not self.mission_text and self.mission_html:
            self.mission_text = self.mission_html
        if not self.present_situation_text and self.present_situation_html:
            self.present_situation_text = self.present_situation_html

        self.mandate_html = self.mandate_text
        self.legal_basis = self.mandate_text
        self.vision_html = self.vision_text
        self.vision_statement = self.vision_text
        self.mission_html = self.mission_text
        self.mission_statement = self.mission_text
        self.present_situation_html = self.present_situation_text
        
        self.drbcp_recovery_strategy_html = self.drbcp_recovery_strategy_text
        self.drbcp_sop_phases_html = self.drbcp_sop_phases_text
        self.drbcp_compliance_narrative_html = self.drbcp_compliance_narrative_text

        # Synchronize signatories cleanly
        if not self.cio_name and self.signatory_prepared_by:
            self.cio_name = self.signatory_prepared_by
        elif not self.signatory_prepared_by and self.cio_name:
            self.signatory_prepared_by = self.cio_name

        if not self.head_of_agency_name and self.signatory_approved_by:
            self.head_of_agency_name = self.signatory_approved_by
        elif not self.signatory_approved_by and self.head_of_agency_name:
            self.signatory_approved_by = self.head_of_agency_name

        self.cio_plantilla_position = self.preparer_position
        self.cio_email = self.preparer_email
        self.cio_contact_no = self.preparer_tel
        
        if not self.agency_head_position:
            self.agency_head_position = getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_AGENCY_HEAD_TITLE", "Head of Agency")
        if not self.agency_name:
            self.agency_name = getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME", "National Government Agency")
        self.website_url = self.agency_website_url
        return self

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

class WhitelistedUserResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    email: EmailStr
    role_tag: str
    assigned_department_id: Optional[int] = None
    department_id: Optional[int] = None
    department_name: Optional[str] = None

    @field_validator('role_tag', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_role(cls, v: Any) -> str:
        return str(getattr(v, 'value', v) or "ROLE_DEPT_USER")

    @model_validator(mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def populate_attributes(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            dept_id = data.get("department_id") or data.get("assigned_department_id")
            data["assigned_department_id"] = dept_id
            data["department_id"] = dept_id
            if "department" in data and isinstance(data["department"], dict):
                data["department_name"] = data["department"].get("name")
            return data
        
        dept_id = getattr(data, "department_id", None)
        dept_rel = getattr(data, "department", None)
        dept_name = dept_rel.name if dept_rel else None

        return {
            "id": getattr(data, "id", None),
            "email": getattr(data, "email", None),
            "role_tag": str(getattr(data, "role_tag", "ROLE_DEPT_USER")),
            "assigned_department_id": dept_id,
            "department_id": dept_id,
            "department_name": dept_name
        }

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

class ServerCapacityResponse(BaseModel):
    id: Union[uuid.UUID, str]
    campus_id: int
    capacity_tier: str

    @field_validator('id', mode='before')

    @field_validator('id', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def coerce_id(cls, v: Any) -> Any:
        return coerce_optional_uuid(v)

    @field_validator('yearly_quantities', mode='before')
    @classmethod
    def deserialize_fields(cls, v: Any) -> Dict[str, int]:
        parsed = deserialize_dict_if_string(v)
        res = {}
        for key, val in parsed.items():
            try:
                res[str(key).strip()] = int(val) if val is not None else 0
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                res[str(key).strip()] = 0
        return res

    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

# ==========================================================
# THREAD-SAFE IN-PROCESS COMPILATION TASK RUNNER & FALLBACK
# ==========================================================
STANDALONE_TASK_STORE: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
TASK_STORE_LOCK = threading.Lock()


def prune_old_tasks():
    """Prunes finished standalone tasks older than 2 hours to prevent memory leaks."""
    now = time.time()
    with TASK_STORE_LOCK:
        expired_keys = [
            k for k, v in STANDALONE_TASK_STORE.items()
            if now - v.get("created_at", now) > 7200
        ]
        for k in expired_keys:
            del STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[k]


class StandaloneTaskRunner:
    """Mock Celery task context that captures state in STANDALONE_TASK_STORE."""
    def __init__(self, task_id: str):
        self.task_id = task_id

    def update_state(self, state: str = "PROGRESS", meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None):
        with TASK_STORE_LOCK:
            if self.task_id in STANDALONE_TASK_STORE:
                STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[self.task_id]["state"] = state
                if meta and isinstance(meta, dict):
                    if "progress" in meta:
                        STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[self.task_id]["progress"] = meta["progress"]
                    if "status" in meta:
                        STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[self.task_id]["status"] = meta["status"]


def execute_in_process_compilation(task_id: str, compiled_meta: dict):
    """Executes document compilation inside a background thread when Redis is offline."""
    runner = StandaloneTaskRunner(task_id)
    try:
        target_func = getattr(compile_issp_document, "__wrapped__", compile_issp_document)
        sig = inspect.signature(target_func)
        
        if len(sig.parameters) >= 2:
            result = target_func(runner, compiled_meta)
        else:
            result = target_func(compiled_meta)

        with TASK_STORE_LOCK:
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]["state"] = "SUCCESS"
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]["progress"] = 100
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]["status"] = "Compilation Complete"
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]["result"] = result
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error(f"In-process compilation failed for task {task_id}: {exc}", exc_info=True)
        with TASK_STORE_LOCK:
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]["state"] = "FAILURE"
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]["progress"] = 100
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]["status"] = "Compilation Failed"
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]["error"] = str(exc)

@router.get("/dashboard-metrics")
def get_dashboard_metrics(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    active_period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    
    global_ceiling_row = db.query(SystemSetting).filter(SystemSetting.key == "global_budget_ceiling").first()
    global_ceiling = float(global_ceiling_row.value) if global_ceiling_row else float(settings.GLOBAL_BUDGET_CEILING)

    # Calculate spent strictly on project-bound or authorized standalone operational proposals
    non_project_cats = db.query(StrategicCategory.name).filter(
        StrategicCategory.is_project_linked == False,
        StrategicCategory.is_active == True
    ).all()
    standalone_cat_names = [c[0].lower().strip() for c in non_project_cats] if non_project_cats else []
    for default_cat in ["office productivity", "continuing costs/expenses", "continuing costs"]:
        if default_cat not in standalone_cat_names:
            standalone_cat_names.append(default_cat)

    total_spent = db.query(func.sum(Proposal.total_cost)).filter(
        Proposal.issp_period == active_period,
        func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == "approved",
        or_(
            Proposal.project_id.isnot(None),
            func.lower(cast(Proposal.strategic_category, String)).in_(standalone_cat_names)
        ),
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).scalar() or 0.0

    pending_count = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.issp_period == active_period,
        func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == "submitted",
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).count()

    approved_count = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.issp_period == active_period,
        func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == "approved",
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).count()

    return {
        "global_ceiling": global_ceiling,
        "total_spent": float(total_spent),
        "pending_count": pending_count,
        "approved_count": approved_count,
        "active_cycle": active_period
    }


@router.get("/department-analytics", response_model=List[DepartmentAnalyticsResponse])
def get_department_analytics(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    active_period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    depts = db.query(Department).all()
    results = []

    for d in depts:
        props = db.query(Proposal).filter(
            Proposal.department_id == d.id,
            Proposal.issp_period == active_period,
            or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
        ).all()

        total = len(props)
        custom = sum(1 for p in props if not p.item_key or p.item_key == "other")
        ratio = (custom / total * 100.0) if total > 0 else 0.0
        missing_canvas = sum(
            1 for p in props 
            if (not p.item_key or p.item_key == "other") 
            and not p.created_by_students 
            and not p.is_in_house_turnover 
            and not p.canvas_evidence_url
        )
        abuse = ratio > 20.0

        results.append(DepartmentAnalyticsResponse(
            department_id=d.id,
            department_name=d.name,
            total_proposals=total,
            custom_proposals=custom,
            custom_ratio_percent=round(ratio, 2),
            missing_canvas_count=missing_canvas,
            requires_review_abuse=abuse
        ))

    return results


@router.get("/audit-logs", response_model=List[AuditLogEntryResponse])
def get_audit_logs(
    module: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=1000),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    query = db.query(AuditTrail).options(joinedload(AuditTrail.user))
    if module and module.strip().lower() != "all":
        query = query.filter(AuditTrail.module == module.strip().upper())
    
    logs = query.order_by(AuditTrail.timestamp.desc()).limit(limit).all()
    out = []
    for l in logs:
        out.append(AuditLogEntryResponse(
            id=l.id,
            proposal_id=l.proposal_id,
            department_id=l.department_id,
            module=l.module,
            action=l.action,
            ip_address=l.ip_address,
            user_id=l.user_id,
            operator_email=l.user.email if l.user else "System/Cron",
            operator_role=l.user.role_tag.value if l.user else "SYSTEM",
            timestamp=l.timestamp,
            old_value=l.old_value,
            new_value=l.new_value
        ))
    return out

@router.get("/departments")
def get_departments_list(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_user)
):
    depts = db.query(Department).order_by(Department.name.asc()).all()
    return [{"department_id": d.id, "department_name": d.name, "id": d.id, "name": d.name} for d in depts]


@router.post("/departments", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_department(
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    name = (payload.get("name") or payload.get("department_name") or "").strip()
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Department name is required.")
    
    existing = db.query(Department).filter(func.lower(Department.name) == name.lower()).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Department '{name}' already exists.")
    
    dept = Department(name=name)
    db.add(dept)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(dept)
    return {"department_id": dept.id, "department_name": dept.name, "id": dept.id, "name": dept.name}


@router.put("/departments/{dept_id}")
def update_department(
    dept_id: int,
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    dept = db.query(Department).filter(Department.id == dept_id).first()
    if not dept:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Department not found.")
    
    name = (payload.get("name") or payload.get("department_name") or "").strip()
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Department name is required.")

    dept.name = name
    db.commit()
    return {"department_id": dept.id, "department_name": dept.name, "id": dept.id, "name": dept.name}


@router.delete("/departments/{dept_id}")
def delete_department(
    dept_id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    dept = db.query(Department).filter(Department.id == dept_id).first()
    if not dept:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Department not found.")
    
    linked_proposals = db.query(Proposal).filter(Proposal.department_id == dept_id).count()
    if linked_proposals > 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Cannot delete department. {linked_proposals} proposals are currently linked to it.")

    db.delete(dept)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": f"Department '{dept.name}' deleted."}

@router.post("/users/whitelist", response_model=WhitelistedUserResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def add_whitelisted_user(
    payload: WhitelistedUserCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    email = payload.email.strip().lower()
    existing = db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"User with email '{email}' already registered.")

    hashed_pw = bcrypt.hashpw(payload.password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")
    
    new_user = User(
        email=email,
        password_hash=hashed_pw,
        role_tag=payload.role_tag,
        department_id=payload.assigned_department_id,
        is_whitelisted=True
    )
    db.add(new_user)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(new_user)
    return new_user


@router.put("/users/whitelist/{user_id}", response_model=WhitelistedUserResponse)
def update_whitelisted_user(
    user_id: int,
    payload: WhitelistedUserUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    target = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if not target:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found.")

    if payload.email:
        target.email = payload.email.strip().lower()
    if payload.role_tag:
        target.role_tag = payload.role_tag
    if payload.assigned_department_id is not None:
        target.department_id = payload.assigned_department_id
    if payload.password and payload.password.strip():
        target.password_hash = bcrypt.hashpw(payload.password.strip().encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(target)
    return target


@router.delete("/users/whitelist/{user_id}")
def delete_whitelisted_user(
    user_id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    target = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if not target:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found.")
    
    if target.id == admin["id"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Cannot delete your active administrative session.")

    db.delete(target)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": f"User '{target.email}' deleted."}

@router.post("/catalog", response_model=CatalogItemResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_catalog_item(
    payload: CatalogItemCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    existing = db.query(CatalogItem).filter(CatalogItem.item_key == payload.item_key).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Catalog item key '{payload.item_key}' already exists.")

    dumped = {k: v for k, v in payload.model_dump().items() if hasattr(CatalogItem, k)}
    item = CatalogItem(**dumped)
    db.add(item)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(item)
    return item


@router.put("/catalog/{item_id}", response_model=CatalogItemResponse)
def update_catalog_item(
    item_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: CatalogItemUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    item = db.query(CatalogItem).filter(CatalogItem.id == item_id).first()
    if not item:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Catalog item not found.")

    for k, v in payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():
        if hasattr(item, k):
            setattr(item, k, v)

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(item)
    return item


@router.delete("/catalog/{item_id}")
def delete_catalog_item(
    item_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    item = db.query(CatalogItem).filter(CatalogItem.id == item_id).first()
    if not item:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Catalog item not found.")

    db.delete(item)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Catalog item removed."}

@router.post("/glossary", response_model=GlossaryTermResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_glossary_term(
    payload: GlossaryTermCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    term_clean = payload.term.strip()
    existing = db.query(GlossaryTerm).filter(func.lower(GlossaryTerm.term) == term_clean.lower()).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Glossary term '{term_clean}' already exists.")

    max_idx = db.query(func.max(GlossaryTerm.order_index)).scalar() or 0
    item = GlossaryTerm(
        term=term_clean,
        definition=payload.definition.strip(),
        order_index=max_idx + 1
    )
    db.add(item)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(item)
    return item

    return {"status": "success", "message": "Glossary term deleted."}

@router.post("/instructions", response_model=GeneralInstructionResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_instruction(
    payload: GeneralInstructionCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    existing = db.query(GeneralInstruction).filter(GeneralInstruction.step_number == payload.step_number).first()
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Step number {payload.step_number} already exists.")

    dumped = {k: v for k, v in payload.model_dump().items() if hasattr(GeneralInstruction, k)}
    item = GeneralInstruction(**dumped)
    db.add(item)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(item)
    return item

# 5. BUDGET CEILINGS & GOVERNANCE LIMITS
# ==========================================================

@router.get("/budget-ceilings", response_model=List[BudgetCeilingResponse])
def get_budget_ceilings(
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    target_period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
    
    global_row = db.query(SystemSetting).filter(SystemSetting.key == "global_budget_ceiling").first()
    global_limit = Decimal(global_row.value) if global_row else Decimal(str(settings.GLOBAL_BUDGET_CEILING))

    depts = db.query(Department).all()
    results = []

    for d in depts:
        ceiling = db.query(BudgetCeiling).filter(
            BudgetCeiling.department_id == d.id,
            BudgetCeiling.issp_period == target_period
        ).first()

        capex = ceiling.allocated_capex if ceiling else Decimal("0.00")
        mooe = ceiling.allocated_mooe if ceiling else Decimal("0.00")
        annual_map = ceiling.annual_allocations if ceiling else {}

        spent = db.query(func.sum(Proposal.total_cost)).filter(
            Proposal.department_id == d.id,
            Proposal.issp_period == target_period,
            func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)).in_(["submitted", "approved"]),
            or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
        ).scalar() or Decimal("0.00")

        results.append(BudgetCeilingResponse(
            department_id=d.id,
            department_name=d.name,
            allocated_capex=capex,
            allocated_mooe=mooe,
            sub_ceiling=capex + mooe,
            global_ceiling=global_limit,
            current_spent=spent,
            annual_allocations=annual_map
        ))

    return results


@router.post("/budget-ceilings")
def update_budget_ceiling_allocation(
    payload: UpdateCeilingPayload,
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    active_period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    ceiling = db.query(BudgetCeiling).filter(
        BudgetCeiling.department_id == payload.department_id,
        BudgetCeiling.issp_period == active_period
    ).first()

    old_vals = {}
    if not ceiling:
        ceiling = BudgetCeiling(
            department_id=payload.department_id,
            issp_period=active_period,
            allocated_capex=payload.allocated_capex,
            allocated_mooe=payload.allocated_mooe,
            annual_allocations=payload.annual_allocations or {}
        )
        db.add(ceiling)
    else:
        old_vals = {
            "allocated_capex": float(ceiling.allocated_capex),
            "allocated_mooe": float(ceiling.allocated_mooe),
            "sub_ceiling": float(ceiling.sub_ceiling)
        }
        ceiling.allocated_capex = payload.allocated_capex
        ceiling.allocated_mooe = payload.allocated_mooe
        if payload.annual_allocations:
            ceiling.annual_allocations = payload.annual_allocations

    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="SYSTEM_BUDGET_CEILING_UPDATED",
        module="GOVERNANCE",
        user_id=admin["id"],
        department_id=payload.department_id,
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
        old_value=old_vals,
        new_value={
            "department_id": payload.department_id,
            "allocated_capex": float(payload.allocated_capex),
            "allocated_mooe": float(payload.allocated_mooe),
            "sub_ceiling": float(payload.allocated_capex + payload.allocated_mooe)
        }
    )

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Department sub-ceiling updated."}


@router.post("/global-budget-ceiling")
def update_global_budget_ceiling(
    payload: UpdateGlobalCeilingPayload,
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    setting = db.query(SystemSetting).filter(SystemSetting.key == "global_budget_ceiling").first()
    old_val = setting.value if setting else str(settings.GLOBAL_BUDGET_CEILING)

    if not setting:
        db.add(SystemSetting(key="global_budget_ceiling", value=str(payload.global_ceiling)))
    else:
        setting.value = str(payload.global_ceiling)

    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="GLOBAL_CEILING_UPDATED",
        module="GOVERNANCE",
        user_id=admin["id"],
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
        old_value={"global_ceiling": old_val},
        new_value={"global_ceiling": str(payload.global_ceiling)}
    )

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "global_ceiling": float(payload.global_ceiling)}


@router.get("/budget-validation")
def validate_budget_preflight(
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    target_period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
    ceilings = db.query(BudgetCeiling).filter(BudgetCeiling.issp_period == target_period).all()
    
    breaches = []
    for c in ceilings:
        spent = db.query(func.sum(Proposal.total_cost)).filter(
            Proposal.department_id == c.department_id,
            Proposal.issp_period == target_period,
            func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)).in_(["submitted", "approved"]),
            or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
        ).scalar() or Decimal("0.00")

        if spent > c.sub_ceiling:
            dept = db.query(Department).filter(Department.id == c.department_id).first()
            breaches.append({
                "department_id": c.department_id,
                "department_name": dept.name if dept else f"Dept {c.department_id}",
                "allocated_sub_ceiling_php": float(c.sub_ceiling),
                "committed_spent_php": float(spent),
                "budget_overage_php": float(spent - c.sub_ceiling)
            })

    return {
        "issp_period": target_period,
        "validation_passed": len(breaches) == 0,
        "total_violations_detected": len(breaches),
        "breaches": breaches
    }

@router.get("/narratives/{issp_period}", response_model=MasterNarrativeResponse)
def get_master_narrative(
    issp_period: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.issp_period == issp_period).first()
    if not narrative:
        parts = issp_period.split("-")
        start = int(parts[0]) if len(parts) > 0 and parts[0].isdigit() else 2026
        end = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 and parts[1].isdigit() else 2028
        narrative = MasterNarrative(
            issp_period=issp_period,
            agency_name=settings.DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME,
            issp_period_from=start,
            issp_period_to=end,
            agency_website_url=settings.DEFAULT_AGENCY_WEBSITE,
            is_active=True
        )
        db.add(narrative)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(narrative)

    return MasterNarrativeResponse.model_validate(narrative)


@router.post("/narratives/{issp_period}", response_model=MasterNarrativeResponse)
def update_master_narrative(
    issp_period: str,
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.issp_period == issp_period).first()
    if not narrative:
        parts = issp_period.split("-")
        start = int(parts[0]) if len(parts) > 0 and parts[0].isdigit() else 2026
        end = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 and parts[1].isdigit() else 2028
        narrative = MasterNarrative(issp_period=issp_period, issp_period_from=start, issp_period_to=end)
        db.add(narrative)

    # Explicitly map alias and signatory fields if present in payload
    if "cio_name" in payload and payload["cio_name"]:
        narrative.signatory_prepared_by = str(payload["cio_name"]).strip()
    if "head_of_agency_name" in payload and payload["head_of_agency_name"]:
        narrative.signatory_approved_by = str(payload["head_of_agency_name"]).strip()
    if "agency_head_title" in payload and payload["agency_head_title"]:
        narrative.agency_head_position = str(payload["agency_head_title"]).strip()
    if "mandate_text" in payload and payload["mandate_text"] is not None:
        narrative.mandate_text = str(payload["mandate_text"]).strip()
    elif "mandate_html" in payload and payload["mandate_html"] is not None and not narrative.mandate_text:
        narrative.mandate_text = str(payload["mandate_html"]).strip()

    for k, v in payload.items():
        if hasattr(narrative, k) and v is not None:
            # Case-insensitive normalization for scope_choice
            if k == "scope_choice" and isinstance(v, str):
                v_clean = v.strip().lower().replace("_", "-")
                if "department" in v_clean:
                    v = "Department-Wide"
                elif "agency" in v_clean:
                    v = "Agency-Wide"
                elif "lgu" in v_clean:
                    v = "LGU"
                elif "other" in v_clean:
                    v = "Other Government Entity"
            setattr(narrative, k, v)

    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="NARRATIVE_STUDIO_UPDATED",
        module="GOVERNANCE",
        user_id=admin["id"],
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
        new_value={"issp_period": issp_period}
    )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(narrative)
    return MasterNarrativeResponse.model_validate(narrative)


@router.post("/narratives/{issp_period}/activate")
def activate_planning_cycle(
    issp_period: str,
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    parts = issp_period.split("-")
    start = int(parts[0]) if len(parts) > 0 and parts[0].isdigit() else 2026
    end = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 and parts[1].isdigit() else 2028

    db.query(MasterNarrative).update({"is_active": False}, synchronize_session=False)

    target = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.issp_period == issp_period).first()
    if not target:
        target = MasterNarrative(
            issp_period=issp_period,
            agency_name=settings.DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME,
            issp_period_from=start,
            issp_period_to=end,
            agency_website_url=settings.DEFAULT_AGENCY_WEBSITE,
            is_active=True
        )
        db.add(target)
    else:
        target.is_active = True
        target.issp_period_from = start
        target.issp_period_to = end

    setting = db.query(SystemSetting).filter(SystemSetting.key == "issp_active_cycle").first()
    if not setting:
        db.add(SystemSetting(key="issp_active_cycle", value=issp_period))
    else:
        setting.value = issp_period

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "active_cycle": issp_period}


@router.post("/narratives/{issp_period}/upload-diagram")
async def upload_narrative_diagram(
    issp_period: str,
    category: str = Query(...),
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.issp_period == issp_period).first()
    if not narrative:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Planning cycle narrative not found.")

    file_bytes = await file.read()
    safe_name = secure_filename(file.filename)
    key = f"diagrams/{issp_period}/{category}_{safe_name}"

    uploaded = storage_client.upload_binary(file_bytes, key)
    if not uploaded:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to upload schematic to storage.")

    url = storage_client.generate_download_url(key)

    col_map = {
        "agency_logo": "agency_logo_url",
        "network_diagram": "network_diagram_url",
        "fiber_backbone": "fiber_backbone_url",
        "system_architecture": "system_architecture_url",
        "existing_ict_org": "existing_ict_org_url",
        "proposed_ict_org": "proposed_ict_org_url",
        "site_development_plan": "site_development_plan_url",
        "process_flow_diagram": "process_flow_diagram_url"
    }

    target_col = col_map.get(category, f"{category}_url")
    if hasattr(narrative, target_col):
        setattr(narrative, target_col, url)
        db.commit()

    return {"status": "success", "file_url": url, "category": category}

@router.get("/outcomes", response_model=List[OrganizationalOutcomeResponse])
def get_organizational_outcomes(
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    target_period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
    return db.query(OrganizationalOutcome).filter(OrganizationalOutcome.issp_period == target_period).all()


@router.post("/outcomes", response_model=OrganizationalOutcomeResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_organizational_outcome(
    payload: OrganizationalOutcomeCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    type_label_clean = (payload.type_label or "Organizational Outcome").strip()
    outcome_name_clean = payload.outcome_name.strip()
    db_outcome = OrganizationalOutcome(
        issp_period=period,
        type_label=type_label_clean,
        outcome_name=outcome_name_clean,
        program_name=outcome_name_clean,
        description=payload.description.strip() if payload.description else None
    )
    db.add(db_outcome)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_outcome)
    return db_outcome


@router.put("/outcomes/{outcome_id}", response_model=OrganizationalOutcomeResponse)
def update_organizational_outcome(
    outcome_id: int,
    payload: OrganizationalOutcomeCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    outcome = db.query(OrganizationalOutcome).filter(OrganizationalOutcome.id == outcome_id).first()
    if not outcome:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Organizational Outcome not found.")

    outcome.type_label = (payload.type_label or "Organizational Outcome").strip()
    outcome.outcome_name = payload.outcome_name.strip()
    outcome.program_name = payload.outcome_name.strip()
    outcome.description = payload.description.strip() if payload.description else None

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(outcome)
    return outcome


@router.delete("/outcomes/{outcome_id}")
def delete_organizational_outcome(
    outcome_id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    outcome = db.query(OrganizationalOutcome).filter(OrganizationalOutcome.id == outcome_id).first()
    if not outcome:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Organizational Outcome program not found.")
    
    linked_proposals = db.query(Proposal).filter(Proposal.outcome_id == outcome_id).count()
    if linked_proposals > 0:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Cannot delete program outcome. There are {linked_proposals} active proposals linked to it."
        )

    db.delete(outcome)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Outcome category purged successfully."}

@router.put("/concerns/{concern_id}", response_model=StrategicConcernResponse)
def update_strategic_concern(
    concern_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: StrategicConcernCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    concern = db.query(StrategicConcern).filter(StrategicConcern.id == concern_id).first()
    if not concern:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Strategic concern record not found.")

    concern.outcome_id = payload.outcome_id
    concern.mfo = payload.mfo
    concern.critical_system = payload.critical_system
    concern.problems = payload.problems
    concern.intended_use = payload.intended_use
    concern.order_index = payload.order_index

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(concern)
    return concern


@router.delete("/concerns/{concern_id}")
def delete_strategic_concern(
    concern_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    concern = db.query(StrategicConcern).filter(StrategicConcern.id == concern_id).first()
    if not concern:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Strategic concern not found.")
    
    if concern.needs_assessments:
        for na in concern.needs_assessments:
            na.is_aggregated = False
            na.strategic_concern_id = None

    if concern.information_systems:
        for sys in concern.information_systems:
            sys.strategic_concern_id = None

    db.delete(concern)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Strategic concern purged."}


@router.get("/needs-assessments", response_model=List[NeedsAssessmentResponse])
def get_all_needs_assessments(
    dept_id: Optional[int] = Query(None),
    is_aggregated: Optional[bool] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    query = db.query(NeedsAssessment).options(joinedload(NeedsAssessment.department)).filter(
        NeedsAssessment.is_archived == False
    )
    if dept_id:
        query = query.filter(NeedsAssessment.department_id == dept_id)
    if is_aggregated is not None:
        query = query.filter(NeedsAssessment.is_aggregated == is_aggregated)

    records = query.order_by(NeedsAssessment.department_id.asc()).all()
    res = []
    for na in records:
        resp = NeedsAssessmentResponse.model_validate(na)
        resp.department_name = na.department.name if na.department else f"Dept {na.department_id}"
        res.append(resp)
    return res


@router.post("/concerns/aggregate-from-needs", response_model=StrategicConcernResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def aggregate_needs_into_strategic_concern(
    payload: AggregateNeedsAssessmentPayload,
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
    na = db.query(NeedsAssessment).filter(NeedsAssessment.id == payload.needs_assessment_id).first()
    if not na:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Needs Assessment record not found.")

    concern = StrategicConcern(
        issp_period=period,
        outcome_id=payload.outcome_id,
        mfo=payload.mfo,
        critical_system=payload.critical_system,
        problems=payload.problems,
        intended_use=payload.intended_use,
        order_index=payload.order_index
    )
    db.add(concern)
    db.flush()

    na.is_aggregated = True
    na.strategic_concern_id = concern.id

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(concern)
    return concern
