@router.get("/proposals")
def get_admin_master_queue(
    dept_id: Optional[int] = Query(None),
    status_filter: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    strategic_category: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    search: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    skip: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    limit: Optional[int] = Query(1000, ge=1, le=100000),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: dict = Depends(require_supply_or_admin)
):
    try:
        query = db.query(Proposal).options(
            joinedload(Proposal.outcome),
            joinedload(Proposal.project_rel),
            joinedload(Proposal.needs_assessment),
            joinedload(Proposal.department)
        ).filter(or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None)))
        
        if dept_id:
            query = query.filter(Proposal.department_id == dept_id)
        if status_filter and status_filter.strip().lower() != "all":
            clean_status = status_filter.strip().lower()
            query = query.filter(func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == clean_status)

        if strategic_category and strategic_category.strip().lower() != "all":
            clean_cat = strategic_category.strip().lower()
            query = query.filter(func.lower(cast(Proposal.strategic_category, String)) == clean_cat)

        if issp_period and issp_period.strip().lower() != "all":
            query = query.filter(Proposal.issp_period == issp_period.strip())
        if search:
            query = query.filter(Proposal.item_name.ilike(f"%{search}%"))

        total = query.count()
        effective_limit = limit or 1000
        results = query.order_by(Proposal.version.desc()).offset(skip).limit(effective_limit).all()

        serialized_data = []
        for p in results:
            try:
                serialized_data.append(ProposalResponse.model_validate(p))
            except Exception as ser_err:
                logger.debug(f"Direct serialization note: {ser_err}")
                serialized_data.append(p)

        return {"total": total, "skip": skip, "limit": effective_limit, "data": serialized_data}
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error querying master queue: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to fetch master queue.")


@router.post("/proposals/batch-approve")
def batch_approve_proposals(
    payload: Union[BatchApprovePayload, Dict[str, Any]],
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    """1-Click batch approval of submitted proposals with transactional COA audit logging."""
    raw_ids = []
    if isinstance(payload, BatchApprovePayload):
        raw_ids = payload.proposal_ids
    elif isinstance(payload, dict):
        raw_ids = payload.get("proposal_ids", [])
    
    if not raw_ids:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No proposal IDs provided for batch approval.")

    proposal_uuids = []
    for pid in raw_ids:
        try:
            proposal_uuids.append(uuid.UUID(str(pid).strip()))
        except Exception:
            continue

    if not proposal_uuids:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No valid proposal UUIDs found.")

    proposals = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.id.in_(proposal_uuids),
        func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == "submitted"
    ).all()

    default_outcome = None
    for p in proposals:
        if not p.outcome_id:
            if not default_outcome:
                default_outcome = db.query(OrganizationalOutcome).filter(
                    OrganizationalOutcome.issp_period == p.issp_period
                ).first()
            if default_outcome:
                p.outcome_id = default_outcome.id

        # Guard: If item is categorized as a project item but unlinked, fallback to Office Productivity
        is_project_cat = "project" in (p.strategic_category or "").lower()
        if is_project_cat and not p.project_id:
            p.strategic_category = "Office Productivity"
            sc_obj = db.query(StrategicCategory).filter(
                func.lower(StrategicCategory.name) == "office productivity"
            ).first()
            if sc_obj:
                p.strategic_category_id = sc_obj.id

        old_status = p.status
        p.status = "Approved"
        p.version += 1
        log_audit_event(
            db=db,
            action="STATE_TRANSITION_APPROVED",
            module="PROPOSALS",
            user_id=admin["id"],
            department_id=p.department_id,
            proposal_id=p.id,
            ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
            old_value={"status": old_status},
            new_value={"status": "Approved", "outcome_id": p.outcome_id}
        )

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "approved_count": len(proposals)}


@router.post("/proposals", response_model=ProposalResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def admin_create_proposal(
    payload: ProposalCreatePayload,
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    active_period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    target_dept_id = getattr(payload, "department_id", None) or 1
    target_dept = db.query(Department).filter(Department.id == target_dept_id).first()
    automated_office = target_dept.name if target_dept else "Central Office"

    is_turnover = bool(getattr(payload, "is_in_house_turnover", False) or getattr(payload, "created_by_students", False))

    outcome_id = payload.outcome_id
    if not outcome_id:
        default_oo = db.query(OrganizationalOutcome).filter(
            OrganizationalOutcome.issp_period == active_period
        ).first()
        if default_oo:
            outcome_id = default_oo.id

    sc_name = payload.strategic_category or "Office Productivity"
    strat_cat_id = getattr(payload, "strategic_category_id", None)
    if not strat_cat_id and sc_name:
        sc_row = db.query(StrategicCategory).filter(func.lower(StrategicCategory.name) == sc_name.lower().strip()).first()
        if sc_row:
            strat_cat_id = sc_row.id

    uacs_code, exp_class = classify_uacs_and_expenditure(
        item_name=payload.item_name,
        unit_cost=payload.unit_cost,
        strategic_category=sc_name,
        category=payload.category,
        created_by_students=is_turnover,
        is_in_house_turnover=is_turnover,
        db=db
    )

    _, aligned_quantities = align_and_validate_years(db, payload.yearly_quantities or {}, is_submitting=False)

    db_proposal = Proposal(
        department_id=target_dept_id,
        issp_period=active_period,
        outcome_id=outcome_id,
        project_id=payload.project_id,
        needs_assessment_id=getattr(payload, "needs_assessment_id", None),
        strategic_category_id=strat_cat_id,
        category=payload.category or "Hardware",
        strategic_category=sc_name,
        office_location=payload.office_location or "Central Office",
        fund_source=payload.fund_source or "General Appropriations Act (GAA)",
        uacs_object_code=getattr(payload, "uacs_object_code", None) or uacs_code,
        expenditure_class=getattr(payload, "expenditure_class", None) or exp_class,
        status="Approved",
        item_key=payload.item_select or "other",
        item_name=payload.item_name,
        unit_cost=payload.unit_cost,
        yearly_quantities=aligned_quantities,
        justification=payload.justification,
        system_development_status=payload.system_development_status or "N/A",
        created_by_students=is_turnover,
        is_in_house_turnover=is_turnover,
        target_office_automated=automated_office,
        canvas_evidence_url=payload.canvas_evidence_url,
        canvas_expiration_date=payload.canvas_expiration_date,
        supplier_name=payload.supplier_name,
        comments=[],
        is_expansion=payload.is_expansion
    )

    db.add(db_proposal)
    db.flush()

    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="PROPOSAL_CREATED_BY_ADMIN",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=admin["id"],
        department_id=target_dept_id,
        proposal_id=db_proposal.id,
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
        new_value={"item_name": db_proposal.item_name, "total_cost": float(db_proposal.total_cost)}
    )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_proposal)
    return db_proposal


@router.put("/proposals/{proposal_id}/approve")
def approve_proposal(
    proposal_id: uuid.UUID,
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    proposal = db.query(Proposal).filter(Proposal.id == proposal_id).first()
    if not proposal:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found.")

    if not proposal.outcome_id:
        default_outcome = db.query(OrganizationalOutcome).filter(
            OrganizationalOutcome.issp_period == proposal.issp_period
        ).first()
        if default_outcome:
            proposal.outcome_id = default_outcome.id
        else:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Approval Blocked: Please assign an Organizational Outcome (Part I.A.4) to this proposal via Override before approving."
            )

    # PREVENT ORPHAN PROPOSAL LEAK:
    # If categorized as an ICT project item, enforce project linkage before approval
    is_project_cat = "project" in (proposal.strategic_category or "").lower()
    if is_project_cat and not proposal.project_id:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Approval Blocked: Proposal '{proposal.item_name}' is categorized under '{proposal.strategic_category}'. Please link it to an ICT Project (Part III.E) or change its category to a standalone operational category (e.g. 'Office Productivity') before approving."
        )

    old_status = proposal.status
    proposal.status = "Approved"
    proposal.version += 1

    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="STATE_TRANSITION_APPROVED",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=admin["id"],
        department_id=proposal.department_id,
        proposal_id=proposal.id,
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
        old_value={"status": old_status},
        new_value={"status": "Approved", "outcome_id": proposal.outcome_id}
    )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(proposal)
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Proposal approved successfully.", "proposal_id": proposal.id}

@router.put("/proposals/{proposal_id}/override")
def admin_override_proposal(
    proposal_id: uuid.UUID, 
    payload: AdminOverridePayload,
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    try:
        proposal = db.query(Proposal).filter(
            Proposal.id == proposal_id,
            or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
        ).first()

        if not proposal:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found.")

        old_state = {
            "item_name": proposal.item_name,
            "unit_cost": float(proposal.unit_cost) if proposal.unit_cost is not None else 0.0,
            "total_qty": proposal.total_qty,
            "outcome_id": proposal.outcome_id,
            "project_id": str(proposal.project_id) if proposal.project_id else None,
            "strategic_category": proposal.strategic_category,
            "office_location": proposal.office_location,
            "fund_source": proposal.fund_source,
            "uacs_object_code": proposal.uacs_object_code,
            "expenditure_class": proposal.expenditure_class
        }

        if payload.item_name is not None:
            proposal.item_name = html.escape(payload.item_name.strip())
        if payload.unit_cost is not None:
            proposal.unit_cost = payload.unit_cost
        if payload.outcome_id is not None:
            proposal.outcome_id = payload.outcome_id
            
        if payload.project_id is not None:
            proposal.project_id = payload.project_id
            if payload.project_id:
                proj = db.query(IctProject).filter(IctProject.id == payload.project_id).first()
                if proj:
                    proposal.fund_source = str(getattr(proj.funding_source, "value", proj.funding_source) or "General Appropriations Act (GAA)")
                    proposal.strategic_category = str(getattr(proj.project_category, "value", proj.project_category) or "Internal ICT Projects")
                    sc_row = db.query(StrategicCategory).filter(
                        func.lower(StrategicCategory.name) == func.lower(proposal.strategic_category)
                    ).first()
                    proposal.strategic_category_id = sc_row.id if sc_row else None
            else:
                # Disconnected from project: assign standalone category if not specified
                if payload.strategic_category is None:
                    proposal.strategic_category = "Office Productivity"
                    sc_row = db.query(StrategicCategory).filter(
                        func.lower(StrategicCategory.name) == "office productivity"
                    ).first()
                    if sc_row:
                        proposal.strategic_category_id = sc_row.id

        if getattr(payload, "needs_assessment_id", None) is not None:
            proposal.needs_assessment_id = payload.needs_assessment_id
        if getattr(payload, "strategic_category_id", None) is not None:
            proposal.strategic_category_id = payload.strategic_category_id
        if payload.category is not None:
            proposal.category = str(getattr(payload.category, "value", payload.category))
        if payload.strategic_category is not None and not payload.project_id:
            proposal.strategic_category = str(getattr(payload.strategic_category, "value", payload.strategic_category))
            sc_row = db.query(StrategicCategory).filter(
                func.lower(StrategicCategory.name) == str(proposal.strategic_category).strip().lower()
            ).first()
            if sc_row:
                proposal.strategic_category_id = sc_row.id
        if payload.office_location is not None:
            proposal.office_location = str(getattr(payload.office_location, "value", payload.office_location))
        if payload.fund_source is not None and not payload.project_id:
            proposal.fund_source = str(getattr(payload.fund_source, "value", payload.fund_source))
        if payload.justification is not None:
            proposal.justification = html.escape(payload.justification.strip())
        if payload.system_development_status is not None:
            proposal.system_development_status = str(getattr(payload.system_development_status, "value", payload.system_development_status))
        
        is_turnover = getattr(payload, "is_in_house_turnover", None)
        if is_turnover is None:
            is_turnover = getattr(payload, "created_by_students", None)
        if is_turnover is not None:
            proposal.is_in_house_turnover = bool(is_turnover)
            proposal.created_by_students = bool(is_turnover)

        if payload.yearly_quantities is not None:
            _, aligned_quantities = align_and_validate_years(db, payload.yearly_quantities, is_submitting=False)
            proposal.yearly_quantities = aligned_quantities

        # Preserve Admin-assigned UACS object code and expenditure class without overwriting
        if getattr(payload, "uacs_object_code", None):
            proposal.uacs_object_code = str(getattr(payload.uacs_object_code, "value", payload.uacs_object_code))
        if getattr(payload, "expenditure_class", None):
            proposal.expenditure_class = str(getattr(payload.expenditure_class, "value", payload.expenditure_class))
        elif proposal.uacs_object_code:
            if "(CO)" in proposal.uacs_object_code:
                proposal.expenditure_class = "Capital Outlay"
            elif "(MOOE)" in proposal.uacs_object_code:
                proposal.expenditure_class = "Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses"

        if not proposal.uacs_object_code or not proposal.expenditure_class:
            uacs, exp_class = classify_uacs_and_expenditure(
                item_name=proposal.item_name,
                unit_cost=proposal.unit_cost,
                strategic_category=proposal.strategic_category,
                category=proposal.category,
                created_by_students=proposal.is_in_house_turnover,
                is_in_house_turnover=proposal.is_in_house_turnover,
                db=db
            )
            if not proposal.uacs_object_code:
                proposal.uacs_object_code = uacs
            if not proposal.expenditure_class:
                proposal.expenditure_class = exp_class

        proposal.version += 1

        new_state = {
            "item_name": proposal.item_name,
            "unit_cost": float(proposal.unit_cost) if proposal.unit_cost is not None else 0.0,
            "total_qty": proposal.total_qty,
            "outcome_id": proposal.outcome_id,
            "project_id": str(proposal.project_id) if proposal.project_id else None,
            "strategic_category": proposal.strategic_category,
            "office_location": proposal.office_location,
            "fund_source": proposal.fund_source,
            "uacs_object_code": proposal.uacs_object_code,
            "expenditure_class": proposal.expenditure_class
        }

        log_audit_event(
            db=db,
            action="PROPOSAL_OVERRIDDEN_BY_ADMIN",
            module="PROPOSALS",
            user_id=admin["id"],
            department_id=proposal.department_id,
            proposal_id=proposal.id,
            ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
            old_value=old_state,
            new_value=new_state
        )
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(proposal)

        return {"status": "success", "message": "Proposal overridden successfully.", "proposal_id": str(proposal.id)}
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.error(f"Override failure: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Database failure during override.")


@router.put("/proposals/{proposal_id}/uacs")
def assign_proposal_uacs(
    proposal_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: Dict[str, Any],
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    """Explicitly assigns UACS Object Code and Expenditure Class to a proposal."""
    proposal = db.query(Proposal).filter(Proposal.id == proposal_id).first()
    if not proposal:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found.")

    uacs_code = payload.get("uacs_object_code")
    exp_class = payload.get("expenditure_class")

    old_vals = {
        "uacs_object_code": proposal.uacs_object_code,
        "expenditure_class": proposal.expenditure_class
    }

    if uacs_code:
        proposal.uacs_object_code = str(uacs_code).strip()
    if exp_class:
        proposal.expenditure_class = str(exp_class).strip()
    elif uacs_code:
        if "(CO)" in str(uacs_code):
            proposal.expenditure_class = "Capital Outlay"
        elif "(MOOE)" in str(uacs_code):
            proposal.expenditure_class = "Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses"

    proposal.version += 1

    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="PROPOSAL_UACS_ASSIGNED",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=admin["id"],
        department_id=proposal.department_id,
        proposal_id=proposal.id,
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
        old_value=old_vals,
        new_value={
            "uacs_object_code": proposal.uacs_object_code,
            "expenditure_class": proposal.expenditure_class
        }
    )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(proposal)
    return {"status": "success", "message": "UACS object code assigned to proposal.", "proposal_id": str(proposal.id)}


@router.delete("/proposals/{proposal_id}")
def admin_delete_proposal(
    proposal_id: uuid.UUID,
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    proposal = db.query(Proposal).filter(Proposal.id == proposal_id).first()
    if not proposal:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal not found.")

    deleted_snapshot = {
        "item_name": proposal.item_name,
        "total_cost": float(proposal.total_cost),
        "department_id": proposal.department_id
    }
    dept_id = proposal.department_id

    db.delete(proposal)
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="PROPOSAL_DELETED_BY_ADMIN",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=admin["id"],
        department_id=dept_id,
        proposal_id=proposal_id,
        ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
        old_value=deleted_snapshot
    )

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Proposal line item deleted."}


@router.get("/proposals/approved-canvas")
def get_approved_canvas_proposals(
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: dict = Depends(require_supply_or_admin)
):
    period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
    approved = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.issp_period == period,
        func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == "approved",
        Proposal.canvas_evidence_url.isnot(None),
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).all()

    return [
        {
            "id": str(p.id),
            "type": "CapEx" if "capital" in (p.expenditure_class or "").lower() else "MOOE",
            "display_name": p.item_name,
            "unit_cost": float(p.unit_cost or 0),
            "supplier_name": p.supplier_name,
            "canvas_evidence_url": p.canvas_evidence_url,
            "canvas_expiration_date": p.canvas_expiration_date.isoformat() if p.canvas_expiration_date else None
        }
        for p in approved
    ]


# ==========================================================
# RESET PLANNING CYCLE (Safe Flush for Draft States)
# ==========================================================

@router.post("/narratives/{issp_period}/reset")
def reset_planning_cycle(
    issp_period: str,
    request: Request,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    """
    Safely resets the active planning cycle:
    Flushes unapproved proposal drafts and resets submitted systems back to Draft mode.
    Preserves approved items and statutory master narratives intact.
    """
    try:
        deleted_count = db.query(Proposal).filter(
            Proposal.issp_period == issp_period,
            func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == ["draft", "returned"]
        ).delete(synchronize_session=False)

        db.query(InformationSystem).filter(
            InformationSystem.issp_period == issp_period,
            func.lower(cast(InformationSystem.submission_status, String)) == "submitted"
        ).update({"submission_status": "Draft"}, synchronize_session=False)

        log_audit_event(
            db=db,
            action="PLANNING_CYCLE_RESET",
            module="GOVERNANCE",
            user_id=admin["id"],
            ip_address=request.client.host if request.client else None,
            new_value={"issp_period": issp_period, "purged_drafts": deleted_count}
        )
        db.commit()
        return {"status": "success", "message": f"Planning cycle FY {issp_period} safely reset. Purged {deleted_count} draft items."}
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        logger.error(f"Failed to reset cycle '{issp_period}': {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to reset cycle: {str(e)}")

@router.post("/governance/generate-issp")
def trigger_document_generation(
    issp_period: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    export_format: str = Query("pdf", description="Format output: 'pdf' or 'docx'"),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)
):
    """
    Triggers document compilation (PDF or DOCX).
    Resilience Guarantee:
    Attempts to dispatch via Celery background worker if Redis is reachable.
    If Redis or Celery is absent (e.g. single-container Azure App Service),
    falls back cleanly to an in-process thread runner using STANDALONE_TASK_STORE,
    preventing 500 Connection Refused and 502 Bad Gateway timeouts.
    """
    target_period = issp_period or get_active_issp_period(db)
    clean_format = (export_format or "pdf").lower().strip()
    if clean_format not in ("pdf", "docx"):
        clean_format = "pdf"

    narrative = db.query(MasterNarrative).filter(MasterNarrative.issp_period == target_period).first()
    if not narrative:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Planning cycle '{target_period}' not configured.")

    # Strict compilation alignment: Only pull approved proposals that are project-linked OR standalone operational
    non_project_cats = db.query(StrategicCategory.name).filter(
        StrategicCategory.is_project_linked == False,
        StrategicCategory.is_active == True
    ).all()
    standalone_cat_names = [c[0].lower().strip() for c in non_project_cats] if non_project_cats else []
    for default_cat in ["office productivity", "continuing costs/expenses", "continuing costs"]:
        if default_cat not in standalone_cat_names:
            standalone_cat_names.append(default_cat)

    approved_proposals = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == "approved",
        Proposal.issp_period == target_period,
        or_(
            Proposal.project_id.isnot(None),
            func.lower(cast(Proposal.strategic_category, String)).in_(standalone_cat_names)
        ),
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).all()

    if not approved_proposals:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400, 
            detail="Compilation blocked: No approved proposals connected to ICT projects or standalone operations exist for this cycle."
        )

    # Derive accurate parity figures directly from canonical parity calculator
    matrices = calculate_financial_summaries(db, target_period, only_approved=True)
    certified_total = matrices["certified_grand_total"]

    compiled_meta = {
        "issp_id": f"ISSP-{target_period}-FINAL",
        "agency_name": narrative.agency_name,
        "issp_period_years": target_period,
        "allocated_budget": str(certified_total),
        "total_capex": str(matrices["b3_statement_of_expenditure"]["Capital Outlay"]["Total"]),
        "total_mooe": str(matrices["b3_statement_of_expenditure"]["Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses"]["Total"]),
        "export_format": clean_format
    }

    task_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    dispatched_via_celery = False

    # Attempt Celery task queuing if Redis broker is operational
    try:
        celery_task = compile_issp_document.delay(compiled_meta)
        task_id = celery_task.id
        dispatched_via_celery = True
    except Exception as celery_err:
        logger.warning(
            f"Celery/Redis broker dispatch bypassed ({celery_err}). "
            "Switching to in-process thread compilation."
        )

    # In-process standalone background thread fallback
    if not dispatched_via_celery:
        prune_old_tasks()
        with TASK_STORE_LOCK:
            STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id] = {
                "state": "PROGRESS",
                "progress": 10,
                "status": "Starting in-process compilation...",
                "created_at": time.time(),
                "result": None,
                "error": None
            }
        thread = threading.Thread(
            target=execute_in_process_compilation,
            args=(task_id, compiled_meta),
            daemon=True
        )
        thread.start()

    return {
        "status": "queued",
        "task_id": task_id,
        "format": clean_format,
        "active_cycle": target_period,
        "combined_plan_cost_php": str(certified_total),
        "approved_proposals_count": len(approved_proposals)
    }


@router.get("/governance/task-status/{task_id}")
def get_task_status(task_id: str, admin: dict = Depends(require_admin)):
    """
    Checks the status of a document compilation task.
    Transparently supports both in-process standalone tasks and Celery AsyncResults.
    """
    # 1. Inspect in-memory task store first
    with TASK_STORE_LOCK:
        if task_id in STANDALONE_TASK_STORE:
            info = STANDALONE_TASK_STORE[task_id]
            state = info.get("state", "PROGRESS")
            progress = info.get("progress", 50)
            status_msg = info.get("status", "Rendering...")
            
            if state == "SUCCESS":
                return {
                    "state": "SUCCESS",
                    "progress_percent": 100,
                    "current_step_message": "Compilation Complete",
                    "result": info.get("result")
                }
            elif state == "FAILURE":
                return {
                    "state": "FAILURE",
                    "progress_percent": 100,
                    "current_step_message": "Compilation Failed",
                    "error": info.get("error", "Unknown compilation error.")
                }
            return {
                "state": state,
                "progress_percent": progress,
                "current_step_message": status_msg
            }

    # 2. Fallback to Celery AsyncResult if available
    try:
        from celery.result import AsyncResult
        from app.celery_app import celery_app
        res = AsyncResult(task_id, app=celery_app)

        if res.state == "PROGRESS":
            meta = res.info or {}
            return {
                "state": "PROGRESS", 
                "progress_percent": meta.get("progress", 50), 
                "current_step_message": meta.get("status", "Rendering...")
            }
        elif res.state == "SUCCESS":
            return {
                "state": "SUCCESS", 
                "progress_percent": 100, 
                "current_step_message": "Compilation Complete", 
                "result": res.result
            }
        elif res.state == "FAILURE":
            return {
                "state": "FAILURE", 
                "progress_percent": 100, 
                "current_step_message": "Compilation Failed", 
                "error": str(res.info)
            }

        return {
            "state": res.state, 
            "progress_percent": 10, 
            "current_step_message": f"Task state: {res.state}"
        }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Task status poll error: {str(e)}")
        return {
            "state": "FAILURE",
            "progress_percent": 100,
            "current_step_message": "Compilation worker unreachable.",
            "error": f"Task status poll error: {str(e)}"
        }

import jwt

logger = logging.getLogger("app.auth.router")
router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

SECRET_KEY = settings.SECRET_KEY
ALGORITHM = "HS256"

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/api/auth/login")


def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    if not plain_password or not hashed_password:
        return False
    try:
        return bcrypt.checkpw(
            plain_password.encode("utf-8"),
            hashed_password.encode("utf-8")
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.debug(f"Cryptographic verification error: {str(exc)}")
        return False


def is_domain_allowed(email: str) -> bool:
    allowed_domains = getattr(settings, "ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS", ["*"])
    if not allowed_domains or "*" in allowed_domains:
        return True
    if not email or "@" not in email:
        return False
    parts = email.split("@")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        return False
    domain = parts[1].strip().lower()
    return domain in [d.strip().lower() for d in allowed_domains if d.strip()]


class PasswordChangePayload(BaseModel):
    current_password: str
    new_password: str = Field(..., min_length=8, description="The secure new account password.")


async def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> User:
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        email: str = payload.get("sub")
        if email is None:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
                detail="Invalid authentication credentials."
            )
    except InvalidTokenError:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid or expired authentication token."
        )

    user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first()
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="User account no longer exists in the registry."
        )

    return user


async def require_user(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": current_user.id,
        "email": current_user.email,
        "role": current_user.role_tag.value,
        "department_id": current_user.department_id
    }

        )
    return {
        "id": current_user.id,
        "email": current_user.email,
        "role": current_user.role_tag.value,
        "department_id": current_user.department_id
    }

    }

    return {

@router.post("/login", response_model=TokenResponse)
async def authenticate_standard(
    request: Request,
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    username = (form_data.username or "").strip().lower()
    client_ip = (
        request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for", "").split(",")[0].strip()
        or (request.client.host if request.client else "Unknown")
    )

    if not is_domain_allowed(username):
        allowed_desc = ", ".join(settings.ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS)
        log_audit_event(
            db=db,
            action="USER_LOGIN_UNAUTHORIZED_DOMAIN",
            module="AUTHENTICATION",
            ip_address=client_ip,
            new_value={"attempted_username": username}
        )
        db.commit()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail=f"Unauthorized Domain: Account must belong to authorized institutional domains: [{allowed_desc}]"
        )

    user = db.query(User).filter(User.email == username).first()
    has_valid_user = user is not None and getattr(user, "password_hash", None) is not None

    if not has_valid_user:
        dummy_salt = bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12)
        password_hash_to_verify = bcrypt.hashpw(b"dummy_password", dummy_salt).decode("utf-8")
    else:
        password_hash_to_verify = user.password_hash

    is_password_correct = verify_password(form_data.password, password_hash_to_verify)

    if not has_valid_user or not is_password_correct or not user.is_whitelisted:
        log_audit_event(
            db=db,
            action="USER_LOGIN_FAILED",
            module="AUTHENTICATION",
            user_id=user.id if user else None,
            department_id=user.department_id if user else None,
            ip_address=client_ip,
            new_value={"attempted_username": username}
        )
        db.commit()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
            detail="Invalid institutional credentials. Please verify your email and password."
        )

    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="USER_LOGIN_SUCCESS",
        module="AUTHENTICATION",
        user_id=user.id,
        department_id=user.department_id,
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={"email": user.email, "role": user.role_tag.value}
    )
    db.commit()

    token_data = {
        "sub": user.email,
        "role": user.role_tag.value,
        "dept_id": user.department_id,
        "exp": int(time.time()) + 86400
    }
    access_token = jwt.encode(token_data, SECRET_KEY, algorithm=ALGORITHM)

    return {
        "access_token": access_token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
        "role": user.role_tag.value,
        "department_id": user.department_id
    }


@router.post("/change-password")
async def change_password(
    request: Request,
    payload: PasswordChangePayload,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
):
    client_ip = (
        request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for", "").split(",")[0].strip()
        or (request.client.host if request.client else "Unknown")
    )

    if not current_user.password_hash or not verify_password(payload.current_password, current_user.password_hash):
        log_audit_event(
            db=db,
            action="PASSWORD_ROTATION_REJECTED",
            module="AUTHENTICATION",
            user_id=current_user.id,
            department_id=current_user.department_id,
            ip_address=client_ip,
            new_value={"user_email": current_user.email, "reason": "Current password verification failed"}
        )
        db.commit()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Current password verification failed."
        )

    new_hash = bcrypt.hashpw(
        payload.new_password.encode("utf-8"), 
        bcrypt.gensalt()
    ).decode("utf-8")

    current_user.password_hash = new_hash

    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="SYSTEM_SECURITY_PASSWORD_ROTATED",
        module="AUTHENTICATION",
        user_id=current_user.id,
        department_id=current_user.department_id,
        ip_address=client_ip,
        old_value={"user_email": current_user.email},
        new_value={"event": "Security credentials rotated successfully."}
    )

    try:
        db.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail=f"Database transaction failure during password update: {str(e)}"
        )

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "message": "Institutional account password updated successfully."
    }

class DecryptionError(Exception):
    """Raised when cryptographic decryption fails during legacy payload decoding."""
    def __init__(self, message: str = "Cryptographic decryption failed. Data corruption or incorrect key detected."):
        self.message = message
        super().__init__(message)

    """Raised when an operation violates an active ISSP business rule or budget constraint."""
    def __init__(self, message: str):
        self.message = message
        super().__init__(message)

# DIALECT-AGNOSTIC GUID & SAFE ENUM STRING TYPES

class GUID(TypeDecorator):
    """
    Platform-independent GUID implementation.
    Standardizes on CHAR(36) string representations across SQLite and PostgreSQL.
    Prevents PostgreSQL 'operator does not exist: character varying = uuid' errors
    while seamlessly handling native UUID instances and string representations.
    """
    impl = CHAR(36)
    cache_ok = True

    def load_dialect_impl(self, dialect):
        return dialect.type_descriptor(CHAR(36))

    def process_bind_param(self, value, dialect):
        if value is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(value, uuid.UUID):
            return str(value)
        val_str = str(value).strip()
        return val_str if val_str else None

    def process_result_value(self, value, dialect):
        if value is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(value, uuid.UUID):
            return value
        val_str = str(value).strip()
        if not val_str:
            return None
        try:
            return uuid.UUID(val_str)
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            return val_str


class SafeEnumStr(str):
    """
    String wrapper that provides a `.value` property.
    Prevents AttributeError when templates or services call `.value` on standard string fields.
    """
    @property
    def value(self) -> str:
        return str(self)


class SafeEnumStringType(TypeDecorator):
    """SQLAlchemy column type decorator that returns SafeEnumStr instances."""
    impl = String(100)
    cache_ok = True

    def process_result_value(self, value, dialect):
        if value is None:
            return None
        return SafeEnumStr(value)

    def process_bind_param(self, value, dialect):
        if value is None:
            return None
        return getattr(value, "value", str(value))


class SafeEnumType(TypeDecorator):
    """
    Bi-directional Platform-independent Enum TypeDecorator.
    - If send_name=True, binds member.name (for native PostgreSQL enums).
    - If send_name=False, binds member.value (for VARCHAR columns storing human-readable values).
    - Resolves member names, string values, and raw strings seamlessly without throwing LookupError.
    """
    impl = String(200)
    cache_ok = True

    def __init__(self, enum_cls, send_name=False, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.enum_cls = enum_cls
        self.send_name = send_name

    def process_bind_param(self, value, dialect):
        if value is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(value, self.enum_cls):
            return value.name if self.send_name else value.value
        val_str = str(value).strip()
        for member in self.enum_cls:
            if (
                member.name == val_str or 
                member.value == val_str or 
                member.name.lower() == val_str.lower() or 
                member.value.lower() == val_str.lower() or
                member.name.lower().replace("_", " ") == val_str.lower().replace("-", " ")
            ):
                return member.name if self.send_name else member.value
        return val_str

    def process_result_value(self, value, dialect):
        if value is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(value, self.enum_cls):
            return value
        val_str = str(value).strip()
        for member in self.enum_cls:
            if (
                member.value == val_str or 
                member.name == val_str or 
                member.value.lower() == val_str.lower() or 
                member.name.lower() == val_str.lower() or
                member.name.lower().replace("_", " ") == val_str.lower().replace("-", " ")
            ):
                return member
        return SafeEnumStr(value)


# =========================================================================
# CRYPTOGRAPHIC KEY AND SALT ACQUISITION (LEGACY BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY)
# =========================================================================

AES_SECRET_KEYS_STR = getattr(settings, "DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY", None) or "default_insecure_key_for_dev_mode"
AES_SALT_STR = getattr(settings, "DB_ENCRYPTION_SALT", None) or "default_insecure_salt_for_dev_mode"

legacy_salt = AES_SALT_STR.encode("utf-8")
keys_list = [k.strip() for k in AES_SECRET_KEYS_STR.split(",") if k.strip()]

active_ciphers = []
for k in keys_list:
    try:
        kdf = PBKDF2HMAC(
            algorithm=hashes.SHA256(),
            length=32,
            salt=legacy_salt,
            iterations=100_000,
        )
        _key_bytes = kdf.derive(k.encode("utf-8"))
        fernet_key = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(_key_bytes)
        active_ciphers.append(Fernet(fernet_key))
    except Exception as _cipher_err:
        logger.debug(f"Cipher init note: {_cipher_err}")

if not active_ciphers:
    active_ciphers.append(Fernet(Fernet.generate_key()))

legacy_ciphers = active_ciphers


@lru_cache(maxsize=128)
def get_v2_cipher(key: str, salt: bytes) -> Fernet:
    kdf = PBKDF2HMAC(
        algorithm=hashes.SHA256(),
        length=32,
        salt=salt,
        iterations=100_000,
    )
    derived_key = kdf.derive(key.encode("utf-8"))
    fernet_key = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(derived_key)
    return Fernet(fernet_key)


# =========================================================================
# RESILIENT MUTABLE DICT & MUTABLE LIST COERCION
# =========================================================================

class ResilientMutableDict(MutableDict):
    """
    Robust MutableDict that safely coerces strings, ciphertext, and dicts.
    Prevents ValueError: Attribute '<name>' does not accept objects of type <class 'str'>
    when reading from database columns or handling unparsed JSON strings.
    """
    @classmethod
    def coerce(cls, key, value):
        if isinstance(value, cls):
            return value
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return cls(value)
        if isinstance(value, str):
            val_clean = value.strip()
            if not val_clean or val_clean in ("", "{}", "null", "None"):
                return cls()
            if val_clean.startswith("v3$") or val_clean.startswith("v2$"):
                for cipher in active_ciphers:
                    try:
                        ct = val_clean.split("$")[-1]
                        decrypted = cipher.decrypt(ct.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")
                        parsed = json.loads(decrypted)
                        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                            return cls(parsed)
                    except Exception:
                        continue
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(val_clean)
                if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                    return cls(parsed)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return cls()
        if value is None:
            return cls()
        try:
            return super().coerce(key, value)
        except ValueError:
            return cls()


class ResilientMutableList(MutableList):
    """
    Robust MutableList that safely coerces strings and lists.
    Prevents ValueError: Attribute '<name>' does not accept objects of type <class 'str'>
    when reading from database columns or handling unparsed JSON strings.
    """
    @classmethod
    def coerce(cls, key, value):
        if isinstance(value, cls):
            return value
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return cls(value)
        if isinstance(value, str):
            val_clean = value.strip()
            if not val_clean or val_clean in ("", "[]", "null", "None"):
                return cls()
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(val_clean)
                if isinstance(parsed, list):
                    return cls(parsed)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return cls()
        if value is None:
            return cls()
        try:
            return super().coerce(key, value)
        except ValueError:
            return cls()


_orig_mutable_dict_coerce = MutableDict.coerce

def _global_safe_mutable_dict_coerce(cls, key, value):
    return ResilientMutableDict.coerce(key, value)

MutableDict.coerce = classmethod(_global_safe_mutable_dict_coerce)

_orig_mutable_list_coerce = MutableList.coerce

def _global_safe_mutable_list_coerce(cls, key, value):
    return ResilientMutableList.coerce(key, value)

MutableList.coerce = classmethod(_global_safe_mutable_list_coerce)


# =========================================================================
# RESILIENT JSON COLUMN DECORATOR
# =========================================================================

class ResilientJSON(TypeDecorator):
    """
    Platform-independent, robust JSON TypeDecorator that guarantees:
    - Storing as clean JSON text across SQLite, PostgreSQL TEXT, or PostgreSQL JSON/JSONB.
    - Result processing handles dict, JSON string ('{}'), legacy EncryptedJSON ('v3$...'), or None.
    - Always produces a Python dict on fetch, never an unparsed string.
    """
    impl = Text
    cache_ok = True

    def load_dialect_impl(self, dialect):
        return dialect.type_descriptor(Text())

    def process_bind_param(self, value, dialect):
        if value is None:
            return "{}"
        if isinstance(value, str):
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(value)
                return json.dumps(parsed)
            except Exception:
                return "{}"
        try:
            return json.dumps(value)
        except Exception:
            return "{}"

    def process_result_value(self, value, dialect):
        if value is None:
            return {}
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return value
        if isinstance(value, str):
            val_clean = value.strip()
            if not val_clean or val_clean in ("{}", "null", "None", ""):
                return {}
            if val_clean.startswith("v3$") or val_clean.startswith("v2$"):
                for cipher in active_ciphers:
                    try:
                        ct = val_clean.split("$")[-1]
                        decrypted = cipher.decrypt(ct.encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")
                        parsed = json.loads(decrypted)
                        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                            return parsed
                    except Exception:
                        continue
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(val_clean)
                if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                    return parsed
            except Exception:
                pass
            return {}
        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}


class EncryptedJSON(ResilientJSON):
    """Backwards-compatible EncryptedJSON subclassing ResilientJSON."""
    pass

        "NeedsAssessment",
        back_populates="master_narrative",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan"
    )

    # Dynamic Planning Horizon properties
    @property
    def planning_years(self) -> List[int]:
        start = self.issp_period_from or 2028
        end = self.issp_period_to or (start + 2)
        if start > end:
            start, end = end, start
        return list(range(start, end + 1))

    @property
    def planning_span_years(self) -> int:
        return len(self.planning_years)

    @property
    def cio_name(self) -> str:
        return self.signatory_prepared_by

    @cio_name.setter
    def cio_name(self, val: Optional[str]) -> None:
        if val is not None and str(val).strip():
            self.signatory_prepared_by = str(val).strip()

    @property
    def cio_plantilla_position(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.preparer_position

    @cio_plantilla_position.setter
    def cio_plantilla_position(self, val: Optional[str]) -> None:
        self.preparer_position = val

    @property
    def cio_email(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.preparer_email

    @cio_email.setter
    def cio_email(self, val: Optional[str]) -> None:
        self.preparer_email = val

    @property
    def cio_contact_no(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.preparer_tel

    @cio_contact_no.setter
    def cio_contact_no(self, val: Optional[str]) -> None:
        self.preparer_tel = val

    @property
    def head_of_agency_name(self) -> str:
        return self.signatory_approved_by

    @head_of_agency_name.setter
    def head_of_agency_name(self, val: Optional[str]) -> None:
        if val is not None and str(val).strip():
            self.signatory_approved_by = str(val).strip()

    @property
    def agency_head_title(self) -> str:
        return self.agency_head_position or settings.DEFAULT_AGENCY_HEAD_TITLE

    @agency_head_title.setter
    def agency_head_title(self, val: Optional[str]) -> None:
        if val is not None:
            self.agency_head_position = str(val).strip()

    @property
    def website_url(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.agency_website_url

    @website_url.setter
    def website_url(self, val: Optional[str]) -> None:
        self.agency_website_url = val

    # Case-insensitive helper properties for cover page scope selection
    @property
    def is_department_wide_scope(self) -> bool:
        sc = str(self.scope_choice or "").strip().lower().replace("_", "-")
        return sc in ("department-wide", "department", "dept-wide", "")

    @property
    def is_agency_wide_scope(self) -> bool:
        sc = str(self.scope_choice or "").strip().lower().replace("_", "-")
        return "agency" in sc

class InformationSystem(Base):
    """
    Accommodates both Part II.C (Operational) and Part III.D (Proposed/Enhancement)
    following official DICT v.2026 specifications.
    Supports independent checkboxes for multi-classification (Support, Admin, Operations).
    Supports department proposals, needs assessment linkage, proposed budget estimation,
    direct linkage to an ICT Project (Part III.E), and administrative review states.
    """
    __tablename__ = "information_systems"

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(GUID, primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    issp_period: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("master_narratives.issp_period", onupdate="CASCADE", ondelete="CASCADE"), 
        nullable=False, 
        index=True
    )
    strategic_concern_id: Mapped[Optional[uuid.UUID]] = mapped_column(
        GUID,
        ForeignKey("strategic_concerns.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), 
        nullable=True, 
        index=True
    )
    department_id: Mapped[Optional[int]] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("departments.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), 
        nullable=True, 
        index=True
    )
    needs_assessment_id: Mapped[Optional[uuid.UUID]] = mapped_column(
        GUID,
        ForeignKey("needs_assessments.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), 
        nullable=True, 
        index=True
    )
    # Direct bidirectional linkage to major ICT Project (Part III.E)
    project_id: Mapped[Optional[uuid.UUID]] = mapped_column(
        GUID,
        ForeignKey("ict_projects.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True
    )
    submission_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(50), 
        default="Approved", 
        server_default=text("'Approved'"), 
        nullable=False, 
        index=True
    )  # "Draft" | "Submitted" | "Approved" | "Returned"
    rejection_reason: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)

    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="Operational", nullable=False)  # Operational | For Development | For Enhancement
    classification: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(200), default="Operations - Frontline Service", nullable=True)

    # Simplified Department-Facing Cost Proposal
    proposed_cost: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
        Numeric(15, 2), default=Decimal("0.00"), server_default=text("0.00"), nullable=False
    )
    is_client_facing: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(
        Boolean, default=True, server_default=text("true"), nullable=False
    )

    # Independent Multi-Classification Checkboxes (DICT Template Part II.C & Part III.D)
    is_support_to_operations: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("false"), nullable=False)
    is_general_administrative: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("false"), nullable=False)
    is_operations: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=True, server_default=text("true"), nullable=False)

    # Subordinated Frontline details under Operations
    is_frontline_service: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=True, nullable=False)
    frontline_hosting_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="Online", nullable=False)  # Online | On-premise | Hybrid
    online_url: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=True)
    is_non_frontline_service: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)

    description_and_purpose: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    enhancement_details: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)  # Mandated for "For Enhancement"
    
    # Technical fields with sensible defaults (configured/assigned by Admin)
    development_strategy: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="Outsourced", server_default=text("'Outsourced'"), nullable=False)
    development_platform: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), default="Web-Based Architecture", server_default=text("'Web-Based Architecture'"), nullable=False)
    database_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), default="AppDatabase", server_default=text("'AppDatabase'"), nullable=False)
    data_storage_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), default="Cloud / On-premise Storage", server_default=text("'Cloud / On-premise Storage'"), nullable=False)

    internal_users: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, default="Department Personnel", server_default=text("'Department Personnel'"), nullable=False)
    external_users: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, default="General Public", server_default=text("'General Public'"), nullable=False)
    system_owner_office: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), default="Department Office", server_default=text("'Department Office'"), nullable=False)

    # Interoperability Capabilities
    is_integrated_with_others: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    internal_integrated_systems: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    external_integrated_systems: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    generates_data_for_others: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    processes_data_from_others: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    is_deployed_on_shared_platform: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)

    # Data Privacy Act (PIA) Compliance
    processes_personal_information: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    has_undergone_pia: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    pia_target_date_text: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(100), nullable=True)

    master_narrative: Mapped["MasterNarrative"] = relationship("MasterNarrative", back_populates="information_systems_relation")
    strategic_concern: Mapped[Optional["StrategicConcern"]] = relationship("StrategicConcern", back_populates="information_systems")
    department: Mapped[Optional["Department"]] = relationship("Department", back_populates="proposed_systems")
    needs_assessment: Mapped[Optional["NeedsAssessment"]] = relationship("NeedsAssessment", back_populates="proposed_systems")
    projects: Mapped[List["IctProject"]] = relationship("IctProject", foreign_keys="IctProject.system_id", back_populates="information_system")
    project_parent: Mapped[Optional["IctProject"]] = relationship("IctProject", foreign_keys=[project_id], back_populates="linked_systems")
    bia_record: Mapped[Optional["BusinessImpactAnalysis"]] = relationship("BusinessImpactAnalysis", back_populates="system", uselist=False)

    @property
    def hosting_type(self) -> str:
        return self.frontline_hosting_type

    @hosting_type.setter
    def hosting_type(self, val: Any) -> None:
        self.frontline_hosting_type = str(getattr(val, "value", val) or "Online")

class IctProject(Base):
    """Part III.E ICT Projects (E.1 Internal and E.2 Cross-Agency)."""
    __tablename__ = "ict_projects"

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(GUID, primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    issp_period: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("master_narratives.issp_period", onupdate="CASCADE", ondelete="CASCADE"), 
        nullable=False, 
        index=True
    )
    system_id: Mapped[Optional[uuid.UUID]] = mapped_column(
        GUID,
        ForeignKey("information_systems.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), 
        nullable=True, 
        index=True
    )

    project_title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), unique=True, nullable=False)
    project_category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="Internal ICT Projects", nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    objectives: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)

    # Strategic Alignment
    aligns_pip: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    aligns_ncsp: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    aligns_egmp: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    aligns_pcb: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    aligns_others: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("false"), nullable=False)
    aligns_others_specify: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=True)

    # Dynamic Harmonization Framework Criteria (JSON key-value mapping)
    harmonization_criteria: Mapped[Dict[str, bool]] = mapped_column(
        ResilientMutableDict.as_mutable(JSON),
        default=lambda: {
            "National Prioritization (PDP 2023-2028)": False,
            "Resource Optimization (GovNet, GovCloud)": False,
            "PeGIF Standardized APIs & Interoperability": True,
            "Cross-Agency Collaboration (JMC / MOA)": False,
            "Scalability and Sustainability (SPAR / PREXC)": True
        },
        server_default=text("'{}'"),
        nullable=False
    )

    # Legacy booleans preserved for backward compatibility
    harmonizes_national_priority: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    harmonizes_resource_optimization: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    harmonizes_pegif: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    harmonizes_cross_collaboration: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    harmonizes_scalability: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)

    duration_start_year: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)
    duration_end_year: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=False)

    annual_deliverables: Mapped[Dict[str, str]] = mapped_column(
        ResilientMutableDict.as_mutable(JSON),
        default=dict,
        server_default=text("'{}'"),
        nullable=False
    )

    year_1_deliverables: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True, default="")
    year_2_deliverables: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True, default="")
    year_3_deliverables: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True, default="")

    implementing_unit: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(200), default="ICT Management Office", nullable=False)
    funding_source: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="General Appropriations Act (GAA)", nullable=False)

    lead_agency: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=True)
    partner_agencies: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)

    master_narrative: Mapped["MasterNarrative"] = relationship("MasterNarrative", back_populates="ict_projects_relation")
    information_system: Mapped[Optional["InformationSystem"]] = relationship("InformationSystem", foreign_keys=[system_id], back_populates="projects")
    linked_systems: Mapped[List["InformationSystem"]] = relationship("InformationSystem", foreign_keys="InformationSystem.project_id", back_populates="project_parent")
    pmf_metrics: Mapped[List["PerformanceMetric"]] = relationship("PerformanceMetric", back_populates="project_rel", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    resource_items: Mapped[List["Proposal"]] = relationship("Proposal", back_populates="project_rel")

    def get_deliverable_for_year(self, year_num: int, calendar_year: Optional[int] = None) -> str:
        deliv_map = self.annual_deliverables or {}
        if calendar_year and str(calendar_year) in deliv_map:
            return deliv_map[str(calendar_year)]
        key = f"Year {year_num}"
        if key in deliv_map:
            return deliv_map[key]
        if year_num == 1:
            return self.year_1_deliverables or ""
        if year_num == 2:
            return self.year_2_deliverables or ""
        if year_num == 3:
            return self.year_3_deliverables or ""
        return ""

    @property
    def computed_total_project_cost(self) -> Decimal:
        """
        Dynamically computes the exact total project cost from active child line items
        and linked systems. 
        Guarantees that unlinked proposals without an assigned project_id are strictly excluded.
        """
        try:
            sess = object_session(self)
            
            # If bound to an active database session, execute a direct database query
            if sess is not None:
                # 1. Sum approved proposals explicitly bound to this project_id
                proposal_sum = sess.query(func.sum(Proposal.total_cost)).filter(
                    Proposal.project_id == self.id,
                    or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None)),
                    func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)).in_(["approved", "submitted"])
                ).scalar() or Decimal("0.00")

                total = Decimal(str(proposal_sum))

                # 2. Add proposed_cost of approved Information Systems linked to this project
                # ONLY if their name is not already budgeted as an approved proposal item
                approved_proposals = sess.query(Proposal.item_name).filter(
                    Proposal.project_id == self.id,
                    or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
                ).all()
                covered_names = {str(r[0] or "").lower().strip() for r in approved_proposals}

                linked_systems = sess.query(InformationSystem).filter(
                    or_(
                        InformationSystem.project_id == self.id,
                        InformationSystem.id == self.system_id
                    ),
                    InformationSystem.proposed_cost > Decimal("0.00"),
                    func.lower(cast(InformationSystem.status, String)) != "operational"
                ).all()

                for s in linked_systems:
                    s_name = str(s.name or "").lower().strip()
                    if not any(s_name in c or c in s_name for c in covered_names):
                        total += Decimal(str(s.proposed_cost or 0))

                return total.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))

            # Fallback in-memory evaluation (only count items with matching project_id)
            total = Decimal("0.00")
            items = getattr(self, "resource_items", None) or []
            item_names_seen = set()
            for item in items:
                if getattr(item, "project_id", None) != self.id:
                    continue
                if getattr(item, "is_archived", False):
                    continue
                status_str = str(getattr(item, "status", "")).lower().strip()
                if status_str in ["approved", "submitted"]:
                    tc = getattr(item, "total_cost", None)
                    if tc is not None and Decimal(str(tc)) > Decimal("0.00"):
                        total += Decimal(str(tc))
                    elif getattr(item, "unit_cost", None) and getattr(item, "total_qty", None):
                        total += Decimal(str(item.unit_cost)) * Decimal(str(item.total_qty))
                    item_names_seen.add(str(item.item_name or "").lower().strip())

            all_systems = list(getattr(self, "linked_systems", []) or [])
            if getattr(self, "information_system", None):
                if self.information_system not in all_systems:
                    all_systems.append(self.information_system)

            for s in all_systems:
                s_name = str(s.name or "").lower().strip()
                s_status = str(getattr(s.status, "value", s.status) or "").lower()
                if s_status != "operational":
                    has_matching = any(s_name in iname or iname in s_name for iname in item_names_seen)
                    if not has_matching:
                        pc = getattr(s, "proposed_cost", Decimal("0.00")) or Decimal("0.00")
                        total += Decimal(str(pc))

            return total.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
        except Exception:
            return Decimal("0.00")

class Proposal(Base):
    """
    DICT ISSP v.2026 Unified Resource Requirement Line Item (Part IV.A).
    Clean, queryable, without redundant static year columns or encrypted blobs.
    outcome_id is nullable to allow department users to submit raw technical proposals.
    created_by_students and is_in_house_turnover are explicitly mapped columns to prevent
    database NotNullViolation constraints while remaining fully synchronized.
    """
    __tablename__ = "issp_core"

    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(GUID, primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    department_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("departments.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), 
        nullable=False, 
        index=True
    )
    issp_period: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(50), 
        ForeignKey("master_narratives.issp_period", onupdate="CASCADE", ondelete="RESTRICT"),
        nullable=False, 
        index=True
    )
    
    # Provenance Linkages (outcome_id is nullable on initial submission by department)
    outcome_id: Mapped[Optional[int]] = mapped_column(
        Integer,
        ForeignKey("organizational_outcomes.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), 
        nullable=True, 
        index=True
    )
    project_id: Mapped[Optional[uuid.UUID]] = mapped_column(
        GUID,
        ForeignKey("ict_projects.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True
    )
    needs_assessment_id: Mapped[Optional[uuid.UUID]] = mapped_column(
        GUID,
        ForeignKey("needs_assessments.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True
    )
    strategic_category_id: Mapped[Optional[int]] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("strategic_categories.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True
    )

    # Classification & Categorization
    category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="Hardware", nullable=False, index=True)
    strategic_category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="Office Productivity", nullable=False)
    office_location: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="Central Office", nullable=False)
    fund_source: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="General Appropriations Act (GAA)", nullable=False)
    
    # UACS and Expenditure Class
    uacs_object_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(150), default="50604050 03 - ICT Equipment (CO)", server_default=text("''"), nullable=False)
    expenditure_class: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="Capital Outlay", server_default=text("''"), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="Draft", nullable=False, index=True)
    
    # Pricing & Multi-Year Quantities
    item_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    item_key: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(100), default="other", nullable=True)
    unit_cost: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(15, 2), default=Decimal("0.00"), nullable=False)
    
    # Primary JSON Source of Truth for Physical Targets (Supports 1..N Years Dynamically)
    yearly_quantities: Mapped[Dict[str, int]] = mapped_column(
        ResilientMutableDict.as_mutable(JSON), 
        default=dict, 
        server_default=text("'{}'"),
        nullable=False
    )
    total_qty: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False, index=True)
    total_cost: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(15, 2), default=Decimal("0.00"), nullable=False)

    justification: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    system_development_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100), default="N/A", nullable=False)

    # Native Public Sector Attributes
    created_by_students: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(
        Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("false"), nullable=False
    )
    is_in_house_turnover: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(
        Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("false"), nullable=False
    )
    is_expansion: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(
        Boolean, default=False, server_default=text("false"), nullable=False
    )
    target_office_automated: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=True)
    
    # Market Quotation / Proof Attachment
    canvas_evidence_url: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(500), nullable=True)
    canvas_expiration_date: Mapped[Optional[datetime]] = mapped_column(DateTime, nullable=True, index=True)
    supplier_name: Mapped[Optional[str]] = mapped_column(String(200), nullable=True)

    # Native Queryable Revision Comments & Payload
    comments: Mapped[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = mapped_column(
        ResilientMutableList.as_mutable(JSON), 
        default=list, 
        server_default=text("'[]'"), 
        nullable=False
    )
    payload: Mapped[Dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(
        ResilientMutableDict.as_mutable(ResilientJSON),
        default=dict,
        server_default=text("'{}'"),
        nullable=False
    )
    
    version: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, default=1, nullable=False)
    is_archived: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
    
    # Archive tier status metadata for document vault
    s3_storage_class: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), default="STANDARD", nullable=False)
    is_restoring: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)

    # Relationships
    department: Mapped[Department] = relationship("Department", back_populates="proposals")
    outcome: Mapped[Optional[OrganizationalOutcome]] = relationship("OrganizationalOutcome", back_populates="proposals")
    project_rel: Mapped[Optional["IctProject"]] = relationship("IctProject", back_populates="resource_items")
    needs_assessment: Mapped[Optional["NeedsAssessment"]] = relationship("NeedsAssessment", back_populates="proposals")
    master_narrative: Mapped[Optional["MasterNarrative"]] = relationship("MasterNarrative", back_populates="proposals")
    strategic_category_rel: Mapped[Optional["StrategicCategory"]] = relationship("StrategicCategory", back_populates="proposals")
    audit_logs: Mapped[List["AuditTrail"]] = relationship("AuditTrail", back_populates="proposal", cascade="all, delete-orphan")

    @property
    def archive_storage_tier(self) -> str:
        """Sanitized property alias for official document vault storage tier."""
        return self.s3_storage_class

    @property
    def year_1_qty(self) -> int:
        yq = self.yearly_quantities or {}
        if "Year 1" in yq:
            return int(yq["Year 1"] or 0)
        keys = sorted([k for k in yq.keys() if str(k).isdigit() and len(str(k)) == 4])
        if len(keys) >= 1:
            return int(yq.get(keys[0], 0) or 0)
        return int(yq.get("1", 0) or 0)

    @property
    def year_2_qty(self) -> int:
        yq = self.yearly_quantities or {}
        if "Year 2" in yq:
            return int(yq["Year 2"] or 0)
        keys = sorted([k for k in yq.keys() if str(k).isdigit() and len(str(k)) == 4])
        if len(keys) >= 2:
            return int(yq.get(keys[1], 0) or 0)
        return int(yq.get("2", 0) or 0)

    @property
    def year_3_qty(self) -> int:
        yq = self.yearly_quantities or {}
        if "Year 3" in yq:
            return int(yq["Year 3"] or 0)
        keys = sorted([k for k in yq.keys() if str(k).isdigit() and len(str(k)) == 4])
        if len(keys) >= 3:
            return int(yq.get(keys[2], 0) or 0)
        return int(yq.get("3", 0) or 0)

    def sync_payload(self) -> None:
        if self.payload is None or not isinstance(self.payload, dict):
            self.payload = {}
        self.payload["item_name"] = self.item_name
        self.payload["unit_cost"] = str(self.unit_cost)
        self.payload["total_cost"] = str(self.total_cost)
        self.payload["canvas_evidence_url"] = self.canvas_evidence_url
        self.payload["canvas_expiration_date"] = self.canvas_expiration_date.isoformat() if self.canvas_expiration_date else None
        self.payload["supplier_name"] = self.supplier_name
        self.payload["category"] = self.category
        self.payload["strategic_category"] = self.strategic_category
        self.payload["office_location"] = self.office_location
        self.payload["fund_source"] = self.fund_source
        self.payload["is_in_house_turnover"] = self.is_in_house_turnover
        self.payload["created_by_students"] = self.created_by_students
        self.payload["is_expansion"] = self.is_expansion
        self.payload["uacs_object_code"] = self.uacs_object_code
        self.payload["expenditure_class"] = self.expenditure_class


ResourceRequirementItem = Proposal

class BudgetCeiling(Base):
    __tablename__ = "budget_ceilings"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("department_id", "issp_period", name="uq_budget_ceilings_dept_period"),
    )

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    department_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("departments.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), 
        nullable=False, 
        index=True
    )
    allocated_capex: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(15, 2), default=Decimal("0.00"), nullable=False)
    allocated_mooe: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(15, 2), default=Decimal("0.00"), nullable=False)
    
    annual_allocations: Mapped[Dict[str, Any]] = mapped_column(
        JSON,
        default=dict,
        server_default=text("'{}'"),
        nullable=False
    )

    issp_period: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(50), 
        ForeignKey("master_narratives.issp_period", ondelete="CASCADE", onupdate="CASCADE"),
        default=settings.DEFAULT_ISSP_CYCLE,
        nullable=False, 
        index=True
    )

    department: Mapped[Department] = relationship("Department", back_populates="budget_ceilings")

    @hybrid_property
    def sub_ceiling(self) -> Decimal:
        capex_val = self.allocated_capex if self.allocated_capex is not None else Decimal("0.00")
        mooe_val = self.allocated_mooe if self.allocated_mooe is not None else Decimal("0.00")
        return capex_val + mooe_val

    @sub_ceiling.setter
    def sub_ceiling(self, value: Decimal) -> None:
        if value is None:
            value = Decimal("0.00")
        elif not isinstance(value, Decimal):
            value = Decimal(str(value))
        quantized = value.quantize(Decimal("1.00"))
        if (self.allocated_capex or Decimal("0.00")) == Decimal("0.00") and (self.allocated_mooe or Decimal("0.00")) == Decimal("0.00"):
            self.allocated_capex = quantized
            self.allocated_mooe = Decimal("0.00")
