@router.post("/systems", response_model=InformationSystemResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_department_proposed_system(
    request: Request,
    payload: InformationSystemCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    """
    Simplified Department System Proposal intake (Part III.D):
    Department users submit software needs without facing technical architecture jargon.
    Maintains clean separation between Information Systems (Part III.D) and Resource Proposals (Part IV.A).
    """
    active_period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    dept = db.query(Department).filter(Department.id == user["department_id"]).first()
    dept_name = dept.name if dept else "Central Office"

    dumped = payload.model_dump()

    # Validate non-negative cost
    cost = Decimal(str(dumped.get("proposed_cost") or 0))
    if cost < Decimal("0.00"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Proposed cost cannot be negative.")

    # Verify linked needs assessment exists if provided
    needs_assessment_id = coerce_optional_uuid(getattr(payload, "needs_assessment_id", None))
    if needs_assessment_id:
        na = db.query(NeedsAssessment).filter(
            NeedsAssessment.id == needs_assessment_id,
            NeedsAssessment.department_id == user["department_id"]
        ).first()
        if not na:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Referenced Needs Assessment record not found.")
        dumped["needs_assessment_id"] = needs_assessment_id
    else:
        dumped["needs_assessment_id"] = None

    # Handle project_id linkage if provided
    project_id = coerce_optional_uuid(getattr(payload, "project_id", None) or dumped.get("project_id"))
    if project_id:
        proj = db.query(IctProject).filter(IctProject.id == project_id).first()
        if proj:
            dumped["project_id"] = project_id
        else:
            dumped["project_id"] = None
    else:
        dumped["project_id"] = None

    # Calculate multi-classification flags with safe fallbacks
    c_str = str(dumped.get("classification", "")).lower()
    is_support = dumped.get("is_support_to_operations")
    if is_support is None:
        is_support = "support" in c_str

    is_admin = dumped.get("is_general_administrative")
    if is_admin is None:
        is_admin = "administrative" in c_str or "admin" in c_str

    is_ops = dumped.get("is_operations")
    if is_ops is None:
        is_ops = "operations" in c_str or not (is_support or is_admin)

    is_frontline = dumped.get("is_frontline_service")
    if is_frontline is None:
        is_frontline = dumped.get("is_client_facing", True) if ("frontline" in c_str or not is_admin) else False

    is_non_frontline = dumped.get("is_non_frontline_service")
    if is_non_frontline is None:
        is_non_frontline = "non-frontline" in c_str

    dumped["is_support_to_operations"] = bool(is_support)
    dumped["is_general_administrative"] = bool(is_admin)
    dumped["is_operations"] = bool(is_ops)
    dumped["is_frontline_service"] = bool(is_frontline)
    dumped["is_non_frontline_service"] = bool(is_non_frontline)
    dumped["frontline_hosting_type"] = dumped.get("frontline_hosting_type") or dumped.get("hosting_type") or "Online"

    # Department metadata defaults
    dumped["department_id"] = user["department_id"]
    if not dumped.get("system_owner_office"):
        dumped["system_owner_office"] = dept_name
    dumped["submission_status"] = "Draft"

    if dumped.get("status") == "Operational":
        dumped["status"] = "For Development"

    if not dumped.get("development_strategy"):
        dumped["development_strategy"] = "Outsourced"
    if not dumped.get("development_platform"):
        dumped["development_platform"] = "Institutional Web Framework"
    if not dumped.get("database_name"):
        clean_name = dumped.get("name", "app").lower().replace(" ", "_")[:30]
        dumped["database_name"] = f"{clean_name}_db"
    if not dumped.get("data_storage_type"):
        dumped["data_storage_type"] = "GovCloud / On-premise Storage"
    if not dumped.get("internal_users"):
        dumped["internal_users"] = f"{dept_name} Personnel"
    if not dumped.get("external_users"):
        dumped["external_users"] = "General Citizens / Public" if dumped.get("is_client_facing", True) else "None"

    db_system = InformationSystem(
        issp_period=active_period,
        **{k: v for k, v in dumped.items() if hasattr(InformationSystem, k)}
    )

    db.add(db_system)
    db.flush()

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="SYSTEM_PROPOSED_BY_DEPT",
        module="SYSTEMS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={
            "system_id": str(db_system.id),
            "name": db_system.name,
            "status": db_system.status,
            "proposed_cost": float(getattr(payload, "proposed_cost", 0) or 0),
            "project_id": str(db_system.project_id) if db_system.project_id else None,
            "submission_status": "Draft"
        }
    )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_system)

    resp = InformationSystemResponse.model_validate(db_system)
    if db_system.department:
        resp.department_name = db_system.department.name
    elif db_system.system_owner_office:
        resp.department_name = db_system.system_owner_office
    if db_system.needs_assessment:
        resp.needs_assessment_title = db_system.needs_assessment.title
    if getattr(db_system, "project_parent", None):
        resp.project_title = db_system.project_parent.project_title
    elif db_system.project_id:
        proj = db.query(IctProject).filter(IctProject.id == db_system.project_id).first()
        if proj:
            resp.project_title = proj.project_title
    return resp


@router.put("/systems/{system_id}", response_model=InformationSystemResponse)
def update_department_proposed_system(
    request: Request,
    system_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: InformationSystemUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    """Updates a proposed information system draft in Part III.D."""
    system = db.query(InformationSystem).filter(
        InformationSystem.id == system_id,
        InformationSystem.department_id == user["department_id"]
    ).first()

    if not system:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposed information system record not found.")

    if str(getattr(system, "submission_status", "Draft")).lower() in ["submitted", "approved"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail=f"Editing locked: System proposal is currently in '{system.submission_status}' state."
        )

    update_data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)

    if "proposed_cost" in update_data and update_data["proposed_cost"] is not None:
        cost = Decimal(str(update_data["proposed_cost"]))
        if cost < Decimal("0.00"):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Proposed cost cannot be negative.")

    if "project_id" in update_data:
        p_id = coerce_optional_uuid(update_data.get("project_id"))
        if p_id:
            proj = db.query(IctProject).filter(IctProject.id == p_id).first()
            system.project_id = p_id if proj else None
        else:
            system.project_id = None
        del update_data["project_id"]

    if "needs_assessment_id" in update_data:
        n_id = coerce_optional_uuid(update_data.get("needs_assessment_id"))
        system.needs_assessment_id = n_id
        del update_data["needs_assessment_id"]

    for key, value in update_data.items():
        if hasattr(system, key):
            setattr(system, key, value)

    if "classification" in update_data:
        c_str = str(system.classification).lower()
        if "is_support_to_operations" not in update_data:
            system.is_support_to_operations = "support" in c_str
        if "is_general_administrative" not in update_data:
            system.is_general_administrative = "administrative" in c_str or "admin" in c_str
        if "is_operations" not in update_data:
            system.is_operations = "operations" in c_str or not (system.is_support_to_operations or system.is_general_administrative)
        if "is_frontline_service" not in update_data:
            system.is_frontline_service = ("frontline" in c_str and "non-frontline" not in c_str)
        if "is_non_frontline_service" not in update_data:
            system.is_non_frontline_service = ("non-frontline" in c_str)

    if "hosting_type" in update_data and "frontline_hosting_type" not in update_data:
        system.frontline_hosting_type = update_data["hosting_type"] or "Online"

    new_cost = getattr(system, "proposed_cost", Decimal("0.00")) or Decimal("0.00")

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="SYSTEM_PROPOSAL_UPDATED",
        module="SYSTEMS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={
            "system_id": str(system.id), 
            "name": system.name,
            "proposed_cost": float(new_cost),
            "project_id": str(system.project_id) if system.project_id else None
        }
    )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(system)

    resp = InformationSystemResponse.model_validate(system)
    if system.department:
        resp.department_name = system.department.name
    elif system.system_owner_office:
        resp.department_name = system.system_owner_office
    if system.needs_assessment:
        resp.needs_assessment_title = system.needs_assessment.title
    if getattr(system, "project_parent", None):
        resp.project_title = system.project_parent.project_title
    elif system.project_id:
        proj = db.query(IctProject).filter(IctProject.id == system.project_id).first()
        if proj:
            resp.project_title = proj.project_title
    return resp


@router.delete("/systems/{system_id}")
def delete_department_proposed_system(
    request: Request,
    system_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    """Deletes a draft or returned proposed information system."""
    system = db.query(InformationSystem).filter(
        InformationSystem.id == system_id,
        InformationSystem.department_id == user["department_id"]
    ).first()

    if not system:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposed information system record not found.")

    if str(getattr(system, "submission_status", "Draft")).lower() in ["submitted", "approved"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail=f"Cannot delete system in '{system.submission_status}' state."
        )

    sys_name = system.name
    db.delete(system)

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="SYSTEM_PROPOSAL_DELETED",
        module="SYSTEMS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        ip_address=client_ip,
        old_value={"system_id": str(system_id), "name": sys_name}
    )

    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": f"System proposal '{sys_name}' deleted."}


@router.put("/systems/{system_id}/submit")
def submit_department_proposed_system(
    request: Request,
    system_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    """Submits a proposed system draft directly to the Information Systems Intake Queue."""
    system = db.query(InformationSystem).filter(
        InformationSystem.id == system_id,
        InformationSystem.department_id == user["department_id"]
    ).first()

    if not system:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposed information system record not found.")

    if str(getattr(system, "submission_status", "Draft")).lower() not in ["draft", "returned"]:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=f"Cannot submit system. Current submission status is '{system.submission_status}'."
        )

    if not (system.name or "").strip():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="System Name is required.")

    if not (system.description_and_purpose or "").strip():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="System Description & Purpose is required.")

    if (system.status or "").lower() == "for enhancement" and not (system.enhancement_details or "").strip():
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Enhancement Details are required when proposing a system upgrade ('For Enhancement')."
        )

    system.submission_status = "Submitted"
    system.rejection_reason = None

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="SYSTEM_PROPOSAL_SUBMITTED",
        module="SYSTEMS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={"system_id": str(system.id), "name": system.name, "status": "Submitted"}
    )

    db.commit()
    db.refresh(system)
    return {"status": "success", "message": f"Information System '{system.name}' submitted to MIS Review Queue."}

@router.post("/upload/canvas")
async def upload_canvas(
    request: Request,
    proposal_id: str = Form(...),
    supplier_name: str = Form(...),
    canvas_expiration_date: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_user)
):
    """
    Uploads quotation canvas PDF and links it to the proposal.
    Cleans up old unlinked files from storage to prevent orphaned files.
    """
    try:
        proposal_uuid = uuid.UUID(proposal_id)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid UUID format for proposal_id.")

    proposal = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.id == proposal_uuid,
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).first()

    if not proposal:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal record not found.")

    if user["role"] != "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" and proposal.department_id != user["department_id"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Permission denied.")

    if str(proposal.status).lower() not in ["draft", "returned"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Upload locked: Proposal is under administrative review.")

    file_bytes = await file.read()
    if not validate_pdf_content(file_bytes):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid format. Only genuine PDF files are permitted.")
    await file.seek(0)

    old_canvas_url = proposal.canvas_evidence_url

    safe_supplier = secure_filename(supplier_name) if supplier_name else "default_supplier"
    safe_filename = secure_filename(file.filename)
    key = storage_client.get_canvas_key(str(proposal_uuid), safe_supplier, safe_filename)
    
    success = storage_client.upload_canvas_evidence(file_bytes, key)
    if not success:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to write quotation proof document to repository.")

    download_url = storage_client.generate_download_url(key)
    proposal.canvas_evidence_url = download_url
    proposal.supplier_name = supplier_name
    
    if canvas_expiration_date:
        try:
            proposal.canvas_expiration_date = datetime.fromisoformat(canvas_expiration_date.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        except Exception:
            pass

    if old_canvas_url and old_canvas_url != download_url:
        if not is_file_referenced_elsewhere(db, old_canvas_url, exclude_proposal_id=proposal_uuid):
            old_s3_key = get_s3_key_from_url(old_canvas_url)
            if old_s3_key:
                storage_client.delete_object(old_s3_key)

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="CANVAS_UPLOADED",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user.get("department_id"),
        proposal_id=proposal.id,
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={"supplier_name": supplier_name, "canvas_url": download_url}
    )
    
    try:
        db.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Database update failed: {str(e)}")

    return {
        "status": "success", 
        "proposal_id": proposal_uuid, 
        "supplier": supplier_name, 
        "file_url": download_url,
        "canvas_expiration_date": proposal.canvas_expiration_date
    }


@router.post("/upload/unserviceable-report")
async def upload_unserviceable_evidence(
    request: Request,
    inventory_id: str = Form(...),
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    try:
        inventory_uuid = uuid.UUID(inventory_id)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid UUID format for inventory_id.")

    asset = db.query(ExistingInventory).filter(
        ExistingInventory.id == inventory_uuid,
        ExistingInventory.department_id == user["department_id"]
    ).first()

    if not asset:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Inventory asset record not found.")

    if str(asset.status).lower() in ["functional"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Functional items do not require an unserviceable report.")

    file_bytes = await file.read()
    if not validate_pdf_content(file_bytes):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid format. Only genuine PDF files are accepted.")
    await file.seek(0)

    safe_filename = secure_filename(file.filename)
    file_url = storage_client.upload_unserviceable_report(
        file_data=file_bytes,
        department_id=str(user["department_id"]),
        filename=safe_filename
    )

    if not file_url:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Failed to write inspection report to repository.")

    asset.unserviceable_report_url = file_url

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="IIRUP_REPORT_UPLOADED",
        module="INVENTORY",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={"inventory_id": str(asset.id), "file_url": file_url}
    )

    try:
        db.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to link report: {str(e)}")

    return {"status": "success", "inventory_id": asset.id, "file_url": file_url}

@router.get("/notifications", response_model=List[Dict[str, Any]])
def get_department_notifications(
    category: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    days: Optional[int] = Query(None),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    dept_id = user["department_id"]
    notifications = []

    proposals_query = db.query(Proposal).filter(Proposal.department_id == dept_id)
    proposals_list = proposals_query.all()
    proposal_map = {p.id: p.item_name for p in proposals_list}
    proposal_uuids = list(proposal_map.keys())

    audit_query = db.query(AuditTrail).options(joinedload(AuditTrail.user))

    conditions = [AuditTrail.department_id == dept_id]
    if proposal_uuids:
        conditions.append(AuditTrail.proposal_id.in_(proposal_uuids))
    audit_query = audit_query.filter(or_(*conditions))

    if days:
        boundary_date = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=days)
        audit_query = audit_query.filter(AuditTrail.timestamp >= boundary_date)

    for log in audit_query.order_by(AuditTrail.timestamp.desc()).limit(100).all():
        is_relevant = False
        title = "Workspace Event"
        description = ""
        type_ = "general"
        target_name = "Department Asset"
        url_path = None

        log_prop_id = str(log.proposal_id) if log.proposal_id else None
        operator_email = log.user.email if log.user else "System/Cron"
        operator_role = getattr(log.user.role_tag, "value", str(log.user.role_tag)) if log.user else "SYSTEM"

        if log_prop_id and log.proposal_id in proposal_map:
            is_relevant = True
            target_name = proposal_map[log.proposal_id]
            url_path = "/dept/proposals"
            if log.action == "STATE_TRANSITION_SUBMITTED":
                title = "Proposal Submitted"
                description = f"Proposal '{target_name}' has been queued for review."
                type_ = "status_change"
            elif log.action == "STATE_TRANSITION_APPROVED":
                title = "Proposal Approved"
                description = f"Proposal '{target_name}' was approved."
                type_ = "status_change"
            elif log.action == "STATE_TRANSITION_RETURNED":
                title = "Proposal Returned"
                description = f"Proposal '{target_name}' was returned. Please review action items."
                type_ = "status_change"
            elif log.action == "PROPOSAL_OVERRIDDEN_BY_ADMIN":
                title = "Compliance Classification Applied"
                description = f"MIS Admin applied a governance classification to '{target_name}'."
                type_ = "override"
            elif log.action == "PROPOSAL_CREATED":
                title = "Proposal Drafted"
                description = f"New proposal line item '{target_name}' created in workspace."
                type_ = "status_change"
            elif log.action == "PROPOSAL_DUPLICATED":
                title = "Proposal Cloned"
                description = f"Proposal '{target_name}' duplicated into a new draft."
                type_ = "status_change"

        elif log.action == "SYSTEM_BUDGET_CEILING_UPDATED":
            nv = log.new_value or {}
            if nv.get("department_id") == dept_id or log.department_id == dept_id:
                is_relevant = True
                title = "Budget Ceiling Updated"
                description = f"Department allocation updated: CapEx ₱{float(nv.get('allocated_capex', 0)):,.2f} | MOOE ₱{float(nv.get('allocated_mooe', 0)):,.2f}"
                type_ = "budget"
                url_path = "/dept/dashboard"

        elif log.action == "NEEDS_ASSESSMENT_CREATED":
            is_relevant = True
            title = "Needs Assessment Logged"
            nv = log.new_value or {}
            description = f"Needs Assessment recorded: '{nv.get('title', 'Technical Need')}'"
            type_ = "general"
            url_path = "/dept/needs"

        if is_relevant:
            notifications.append({
                "id": str(log.id),
                "title": title,
                "description": description,
                "type": type_,
                "timestamp": log.timestamp.isoformat(),
                "ref_id": log_prop_id or "",
                "target_name": target_name,
                "url_path": url_path,
                "operator_email": operator_email,
                "operator_role": operator_role,
                "old_value": log.old_value,
                "new_value": log.new_value
            })

    for p in proposals_list:
        comments_list = p.comments or []
        for c in comments_list:
            if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("requires_department_action") and not c.get("is_resolved"):
                notifications.append({
                    "id": c.get("id"),
                    "title": "Action Required: Pinned Feedback",
                    "description": f"Admin remark on '{p.item_name}': \"{c.get('text')}\"",
                    "type": "comment",
                    "timestamp": c.get("timestamp") or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                    "ref_id": str(p.id),
                    "target_name": p.item_name,
                    "url_path": "/dept/proposals",
                    "operator_email": c.get("author_email") or "Admin",
                    "operator_role": "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN",
                    "old_value": None,
                    "new_value": {"comment_text": c.get("text")}
                })

    if category:
        notifications = [n for n in notifications if n["type"] == category.lower().strip()]

    notifications.sort(key=lambda x: x["timestamp"], reverse=True)
    return notifications[:50]


@router.get("/action-items/summary", response_model=Dict[str, int])
def get_action_items_summary(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    dept_id = user["department_id"]
    active_period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    unread_actions = 0

    proposals = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.department_id == dept_id,
        Proposal.issp_period == active_period,
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).all()
    
    for p in proposals:
        comments_list = p.comments or []
        for c in comments_list:
            if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("requires_department_action") and not c.get("is_resolved"):
                unread_actions += 1

    returned_proposals = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.department_id == dept_id,
        Proposal.issp_period == active_period,
        func.lower(cast(Proposal.status, String)) == "returned",
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).count()

    return {"unread_actions": unread_actions, "returned_proposals": returned_proposals}


@router.post("/proposals/{proposal_id}/comments")
def post_inline_comment(
    request: Request,
    proposal_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: CommentCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_user)
):
    target = db.query(Proposal).filter(Proposal.id == proposal_id).first()
    if not target:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal record not found.")

    if user["role"] != "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" and target.department_id != user["department_id"]:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Permission denied.")

    current_comments = list(target.comments or [])
    new_comment = {
        "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "author_name": user["email"].split("@")[0].replace(".", " ").title(),
        "author_email": user["email"],
        "author_role": user["role"],
        "text": payload.text,
        "timestamp": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "is_resolved": False,
        "field_name": payload.field_name,
        "requires_department_action": payload.requires_department_action
    }

    current_comments.append(new_comment)
    target.comments = current_comments

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="COMMENT_POSTED",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user.get("department_id"),
        proposal_id=proposal_id,
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={"comment_id": new_comment["id"], "text": payload.text, "requires_action": payload.requires_department_action}
    )

    try:
        db.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to post comment: {str(e)}")

    return {"status": "success", "comment": new_comment}

@router.post("/proposals/{proposal_id}/comments/{comment_id}/resolve")
def resolve_proposal_comment(
    request: Request,
    proposal_id: uuid.UUID,
    comment_id: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    target = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.id == proposal_id,
        Proposal.department_id == user["department_id"]
    ).first()
    
    if not target:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal record not found.")

    comments = list(target.comments or [])
    comment_found = False
    for comment in comments:
        if comment.get("id") == comment_id:
            comment["is_resolved"] = True
            comment_found = True
            break

    if not comment_found:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Comment record not found.")

    target.comments = comments

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="COMMENT_RESOLVED",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        proposal_id=proposal_id,
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={"comment_id": comment_id, "resolved": True}
    )

    try:
        db.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to resolve comment: {str(e)}")

    return {"status": "success", "message": "Action item marked as resolved."}

@router.post("/needs-assessment", response_model=NeedsAssessmentResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_needs_assessment(
    request: Request,
    payload: NeedsAssessmentCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    active_period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    dept = db.query(Department).filter(Department.id == user["department_id"]).first()
    dept_name = dept.name if dept else None

    new_assessment = NeedsAssessment(
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        issp_period=active_period,
        title=payload.title.strip(),
        mfo_alignment=payload.mfo_alignment.strip(),
        current_problem=payload.current_problem.strip(),
        proposed_solution=payload.proposed_solution.strip(),
        expected_impacts=payload.expected_impacts,
        other_impact=payload.other_impact.strip() if payload.other_impact else None,
        is_aggregated=False,
        strategic_concern_id=None
    )
    db.add(new_assessment)

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="NEEDS_ASSESSMENT_CREATED",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        ip_address=client_ip,
        new_value={"title": new_assessment.title, "mfo_alignment": new_assessment.mfo_alignment}
    )

    try:
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(new_assessment)
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to save assessment: {str(e)}")
    
    resp = NeedsAssessmentResponse.model_validate(new_assessment)
    resp.department_name = dept_name
    return resp

def get_needs_assessments(
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    active_period = get_active_issp_period(db)
    dept = db.query(Department).filter(Department.id == user["department_id"]).first()

    items = db.query(NeedsAssessment).filter(

@router.put("/needs-assessment/{assessment_id}", response_model=NeedsAssessmentResponse)
def update_needs_assessment(
    request: Request,
    assessment_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: NeedsAssessmentCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    assessment = db.query(NeedsAssessment).filter(
        NeedsAssessment.id == assessment_id,
        NeedsAssessment.department_id == user["department_id"],
        NeedsAssessment.is_archived == False
    ).first()

    if not assessment:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, 
            detail="Needs Assessment record not found."
        )

    dept = db.query(Department).filter(Department.id == user["department_id"]).first()
    dept_name = dept.name if dept else "Department"

    old_state = {
        "title": assessment.title,
        "mfo_alignment": assessment.mfo_alignment,
        "current_problem": assessment.current_problem,
        "proposed_solution": assessment.proposed_solution,
        "expected_impacts": assessment.expected_impacts,
        "other_impact": assessment.other_impact
    }

    assessment.title = payload.title.strip()
    assessment.mfo_alignment = payload.mfo_alignment.strip()
    assessment.current_problem = payload.current_problem.strip()
    assessment.proposed_solution = payload.proposed_solution.strip()
    assessment.expected_impacts = payload.expected_impacts
    assessment.other_impact = payload.other_impact.strip() if payload.other_impact else None

    if assessment.strategic_concern_id and assessment.strategic_concern:
        assessment.strategic_concern.problems = f"[{dept_name}]: {assessment.current_problem}"
        assessment.strategic_concern.intended_use = assessment.proposed_solution

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="NEEDS_ASSESSMENT_UPDATED",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        ip_address=client_ip,
        old_value=old_state,
        new_value={
            "title": assessment.title,
            "mfo_alignment": assessment.mfo_alignment
        }
    )

    try:
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(assessment)
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, 
            detail=f"Failed to update assessment: {str(e)}"
        )

    resp = NeedsAssessmentResponse.model_validate(assessment)
    resp.department_name = dept_name
    return resp


@router.delete("/needs-assessment/{assessment_id}")
def delete_needs_assessment(
    request: Request,
    assessment_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    assessment = db.query(NeedsAssessment).filter(
        NeedsAssessment.id == assessment_id,
        NeedsAssessment.department_id == user["department_id"]
    ).first()

    if not assessment:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, 
            detail="Needs Assessment record not found."
        )

    if assessment.is_aggregated:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Deletion blocked: This Needs Assessment has been aggregated into a Strategic Concern by the MIS Administrator."
        )

    client_ip = request.client.host if (request and request.client) else "Unknown"
    log_audit_event(
        db=db,
        action="NEEDS_ASSESSMENT_DELETED",
        module="PROPOSALS",
        user_id=user["id"],
        department_id=user["department_id"],
        ip_address=client_ip,
        old_value={"title": assessment.title, "id": str(assessment.id)}
    )

    db.delete(assessment)
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "success", "message": "Needs Assessment deleted successfully."}

@router.post("/proposals/{proposal_id}/restore")
def retrieve_archived_document(
    request: Request,
    proposal_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    """
    Transparent Document Access Handler:
    Department users have immediate automated access to quotation canvases and archives.
    Eliminates manual vendor restoration requests and returns active access URLs.
    """
    proposal = db.query(Proposal).filter(
        Proposal.id == proposal_id,
        Proposal.department_id == user["department_id"],
        or_(Proposal.is_archived == False, Proposal.is_archived.is_(None))
    ).first()

    if not proposal:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal record not found.")

    canvas_url = proposal.canvas_evidence_url
    if not canvas_url:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Proposal has no linked quotation proof.")

    # Automatically retrieve download URL transparently
    key = get_s3_key_from_url(canvas_url)
    resolved_url = storage_client.generate_download_url(key) if key else canvas_url

    return {
        "status": "available",
        "file_url": resolved_url,
        "message": "Document verified and available for viewing."
    }


@router.post("/proposals/{proposal_id}/sync-metadata")
def sync_proposal_document_metadata(
    proposal_id: uuid.UUID,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: dict = Depends(require_dept_user)
):
    """Refreshes document availability state cleanly without cloud vendor jargon."""

        Proposal.id == proposal_id,
        Proposal.department_id == user["department_id"]
    ).first()
    if not proposal:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Proposal record not found.")

    return {
        "status": "success",
        "storage_tier": "Official Procurement Archive",
        "is_available": True,
        "restore_progress": 100
    }

# app/services/docx_generator.py
"""
=============================================================================
DICT ISSP v.2026 COMPLIANCE ENGINE — WORD (.DOCX) DOCUMENT GENERATOR
=============================================================================
Strictly adheres to official DICT ISSP v.2026 Guidelines and statutory order:
- Single Central Institutional Emblem (No Secondary Side Logos)
- First-Page Section Isolation (Strict 1-Page Cover Page, No Spillover)
- Running 3-Column Header Table with Dynamic Logo, Agency Title & Planning Horizon
- Running Footer with Dynamic Page Numbering (Page X of Y)
- Full Statutory Structure:
    * Cover Page (Page 1)
    * Table of Contents (2-Column Format with Statutorily Mapped Page Numbers)
    * Preliminary: Definition of Terms (Glossary with Fallback Seeding)
    * Part I: Agency Profile & Strategic Context (A, B.1, B.2, C)
    * Part II: Current ICT Assessment (A, B1, B2, C, D)
    * Part III: Proposed ICT Strategy (A1, A2, B, C, D, E1/E2 Charters, F1/F2/F3 PMF)
    * Part IV: Resource Requirements (A. Detailed Annual Deployments, B. Parity Tables B.1-B.4)
    * Annex 1: Existing ICT Asset Inventory (1. Equipment, 2. Software - Real Aggregations)
    * Annex 2: Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Plan (DRBCP Sections 1-6 + KPIs)
=============================================================================
"""

# =========================================================================
# UNIVERSAL IMAGE RETRIEVAL & BYTE STREAM RESOLUTION
# =========================================================================

def get_image_bytes(url: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
    """
    Universally resolves an image URL or local file path into raw bytes.
    Defensively checks:
    1. Direct local disk path
    2. Candidate uploads directories across environments (Docker, Azure, dev)
    3. S3 storage client (via base64 URI)
    4. Direct HTTP/HTTPS network streams
    """
    if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
        return None
    url_clean = url.strip()

    if any(k in url_clean.lower() for k in DIAGRAM_BLACKLIST):
        logger.warning(f"Sanity Guard: Blocked test artwork from Word generation: {url_clean}")
        return None

    # 1. Direct local path
    if os.path.exists(url_clean) and os.path.isfile(url_clean):
        try:
            with open(url_clean, "rb") as f:
                return f.read()
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 2. Extract relative path and check multiple candidate directories
    rel = None
    if "/static/uploads/" in url_clean:
        rel = url_clean.split("/static/uploads/")[-1].lstrip("/")
    elif "uploads/" in url_clean:
        rel = url_clean.split("uploads/")[-1].lstrip("/")
    else:
        rel = url_clean.lstrip("/")

    candidate_dirs = [
        getattr(settings, "LOCAL_UPLOAD_DIR", "uploads"),
        os.path.join(getattr(settings, "BASE_DIR", "."), "uploads"),
        os.path.join(getattr(settings, "BASE_DIR", "."), "uploads", "diagrams"),
        "/home/site/wwwroot/uploads",
        "/home/uploads",
        "/code/uploads",
        "./uploads",
        "uploads"
    ]

    for cdir in candidate_dirs:
        if cdir:
            cand_path = os.path.join(cdir, rel)
            if os.path.exists(cand_path) and os.path.isfile(cand_path):
                if not any(k in cand_path.lower() for k in DIAGRAM_BLACKLIST):
                    try:
                        with open(cand_path, "rb") as f:
                            return f.read()
                    except Exception:
                        pass

    # 3. Use storage_client if initialized
    try:
        from app.storage.s3_client import storage_client
        data_uri = storage_client.get_as_base64_uri(url_clean)
        if data_uri and data_uri.startswith("data:") and "," in data_uri:
            b64_str = data_uri.split(",", 1)[1]
            return base64.b64decode(b64_str)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug(f"storage_client image extraction note: {e}")

    # 4. Fetch via HTTP/HTTPS URL
    if url_clean.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(
                url_clean,
                headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) docx-generator/5.0'}
            )
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as resp:
                return resp.read()
        except Exception as net_err:
            logger.debug(f"HTTP image fetch note: {net_err}")

    return None


def get_agency_logo_bytes(narrative: Any) -> Optional[bytes]:
    """
    Resolves the official institutional agency logo bytes with fallback to disk.
    """
    raw_url = getattr(narrative, "agency_logo_url", None)
    if raw_url:
        data = get_image_bytes(raw_url)
        if data:
            return data

    search_dirs = [
        os.path.join(getattr(settings, "LOCAL_UPLOAD_DIR", "uploads"), "diagrams", "agency_logo"),
        os.path.join(getattr(settings, "BASE_DIR", "."), "uploads", "diagrams", "agency_logo"),
        "/home/site/wwwroot/uploads/diagrams/agency_logo",
        "/home/uploads/diagrams/agency_logo",
        "/code/uploads/diagrams/agency_logo",
        "./uploads/diagrams/agency_logo",
        "uploads/diagrams/agency_logo"
    ]
    for sdir in search_dirs:
        if os.path.exists(sdir) and os.path.isdir(sdir):
            for fname in os.listdir(sdir):
                if fname.lower().endswith((".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp")):
                    if not any(k in fname.lower() for k in DIAGRAM_BLACKLIST):
                        fpath = os.path.join(sdir, fname)
                        try:
                            with open(fpath, "rb") as f:
                                return f.read()
                        except Exception:
                            pass
    return None


# =========================================================================
# XML FORMATTING HELPERS FOR WORD TABLES, CELLS & FIELDS
# =========================================================================

def add_xml_field(paragraph, field_name: str):
    """Inserts a native dynamic Word field (like PAGE or NUMPAGES) into a paragraph."""
    run = paragraph.add_run()
    run.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    run.font.size = Pt(7.5)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(148, 163, 184)
    fldChar1 = parse_xml(r'<w:fldChar %s w:fldCharType="begin"/>' % nsdecls('w'))
    instrText = parse_xml(r'<w:instrText %s xml:space="preserve"> %s </w:instrText>' % (nsdecls('w'), field_name))
    fldChar2 = parse_xml(r'<w:fldChar %s w:fldCharType="separate"/>' % nsdecls('w'))
    fldChar3 = parse_xml(r'<w:fldChar %s w:fldCharType="end"/>' % nsdecls('w'))
    run._r.append(fldChar1)
    run._r.append(instrText)
    run._r.append(fldChar2)
    run._r.append(fldChar3)
    return run


def set_cell_shading(cell, color_hex: str = "F1F5F9"):
    """Applies a solid background shading color to a Word table cell."""
    shading_elm = parse_xml(f'<w:shd {nsdecls("w")} w:fill="{color_hex}"/>')
    cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr().append(shading_elm)


def set_cell_margins(cell, top: int = 60, bottom: int = 60, left: int = 100, right: int = 100):
    """Sets internal padding (in dxa: 20 dxa = 1 pt) for a table cell."""
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    tcMar = OxmlElement('w:tcMar')
    for m, val in [('w:top', top), ('w:bottom', bottom), ('w:left', left), ('w:right', right)]:
        node = OxmlElement(m)
        node.set(qn('w:w'), str(val))
        node.set(qn('w:type'), 'dxa')
        tcMar.append(node)
    tcPr.append(tcMar)


def set_table_borders(table, color: str = "334155", sz: str = "4", val: str = "single"):
    """Applies clean, standard borders to all edges and inside grid lines of a Word table."""
    tblPr = table._tbl.tblPr
    borders = parse_xml(
        f'<w:tblBorders {nsdecls("w")}>'
        f'  <w:top w:val="{val}" w:sz="{sz}" w:space="0" w:color="{color}"/>'
        f'  <w:bottom w:val="{val}" w:sz="{sz}" w:space="0" w:color="{color}"/>'
        f'  <w:insideH w:val="{val}" w:sz="{sz}" w:space="0" w:color="{color}"/>'
        f'  <w:insideV w:val="{val}" w:sz="{sz}" w:space="0" w:color="{color}"/>'
        f'  <w:left w:val="{val}" w:sz="{sz}" w:space="0" w:color="{color}"/>'
        f'  <w:right w:val="{val}" w:sz="{sz}" w:space="0" w:color="{color}"/>'
        f'</w:tblBorders>'
    )
    tblPr.append(borders)


def set_header_table_bottom_border(table, color: str = "CBD5E1", sz: str = "12", val: str = "single"):
    """Applies solely a clean horizontal dividing border to the bottom of the running header table."""
    tblPr = table._tbl.tblPr
    borders = parse_xml(
        f'<w:tblBorders {nsdecls("w")}>'
        f'  <w:top w:val="none"/>'
        f'  <w:bottom w:val="{val}" w:sz="{sz}" w:space="0" w:color="{color}"/>'
        f'  <w:insideH w:val="none"/>'
        f'  <w:insideV w:val="none"/>'
        f'  <w:left w:val="none"/>'
        f'  <w:right w:val="none"/>'
        f'</w:tblBorders>'
    )
    tblPr.append(borders)


def make_header_row_repeat(row):
    """Ensures a table header row repeats at the top of subsequent pages."""
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    trPr.append(OxmlElement('w:tblHeader'))


def prevent_row_split(row):
    """Prevents a table row from awkwardly breaking across pages."""
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    trPr.append(OxmlElement('w:cantSplit'))


def fmt_currency(val: Any) -> str:
    """Formats numeric and decimal currency values to standard Philippine Peso format."""
    if val is None:
        return "PHP 0.00"
    try:
        dec = Decimal(str(val))
        return f"PHP {dec:,.2f}"
    except Exception:
        return "PHP 0.00"


def clean_str(val: Any, default: str = "") -> str:
    """Extracts a clean, non-null string value safely from objects or enums."""
    if val is None:
        return default
    s = str(getattr(val, "value", val) or "").strip()
    return s if s else default


def strip_html_tags(text_val: Any) -> str:
    """Converts HTML strings into clean, structured plain text paragraphs."""
    if not text_val:
        return ""
    clean = re.sub(r'</?(p|br|li|h[1-6]|tr|div)[^>]*>', '\n', str(text_val), flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    clean = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', clean)
    clean = clean.replace('&amp;', '&').replace('&lt;', '<').replace('&gt;', '>').replace('&quot;', '"').replace('&#39;', "'")
    clean = re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+', '\n\n', clean).strip()
    return clean


def clean_uacs_title(uacs_str: str) -> str:
    """Strips numeric UACS accounting prefixes, displaying solely the clean account title."""
    if not uacs_str:
        return ""
    val = str(uacs_str).strip()
    if " - " in val:
        return val.split(" - ", 1)[1].strip()
    cleaned = re.sub(r'^\d{8}(?:\s+\d{2})?\s*[-–]?\s*', '', val).strip()
    return cleaned or val


def resolve_proposal_category(itm: Any) -> str:
    """
    In DICT ISSP methodology, categorization is strictly governed by the 
    parent ICT Project or designated standalone operational bucket.
    """
    proj = getattr(itm, "project_rel", None)
    if proj and getattr(proj, "project_category", None):
        return clean_str(getattr(proj.project_category, "value", proj.project_category))
    
    strat = clean_str(getattr(itm, "strategic_category", ""))
    if strat:
        return strat

    cat_lower = clean_str(getattr(itm, "category", "")).lower()
    if cat_lower in ["subscription", "services"]:
        return "Continuing Costs/Expenses"

    return "Office Productivity"


def render_schematic_box(doc, title: str, subtitle: str, section_label: str, img_url: Optional[str] = None):
    """
    Renders an official schematic exhibit in Word format.
    If an authentic image exists, inserts it cleanly.
    Otherwise, renders the official statutory DICT schematic container box.
    """
    img_data = get_image_bytes(img_url)
    if img_data:
        try:
            p_img = doc.add_paragraph()
            p_img.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            p_img.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(4)
            p_img.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
            r_img = p_img.add_run()
            r_img.add_picture(io.BytesIO(img_data), width=Inches(9.2))
            return
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Direct schematic image insertion note for {title}: {e}")

    tbl = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    tbl.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    tbl.autofit = False

    cell = tbl.rows[0].cells[0]
    cell.width = Inches(10.2)
    set_cell_shading(cell, "F8FAFC")
    set_cell_margins(cell, top=160, bottom=160, left=200, right=200)

    tblPr = tbl._tbl.tblPr
    borders = parse_xml(
        f'<w:tblBorders {nsdecls("w")}>'
        f'  <w:top w:val="dashed" w:sz="8" w:space="0" w:color="94A3B8"/>'
        f'  <w:bottom w:val="dashed" w:sz="8" w:space="0" w:color="94A3B8"/>'
        f'  <w:insideH w:val="none"/>'
        f'  <w:insideV w:val="none"/>'
        f'  <w:left w:val="dashed" w:sz="8" w:space="0" w:color="94A3B8"/>'
        f'  <w:right w:val="dashed" w:sz="8" w:space="0" w:color="94A3B8"/>'
        f'</w:tblBorders>'
    )
    tblPr.append(borders)

    p = cell.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)

    r_hdr = p.add_run("OFFICIAL SCHEMATIC SPECIFICATION FRAMEWORK\n")
    r_hdr.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_hdr.font.size = Pt(10)
    r_hdr.font.bold = True
    r_hdr.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(30, 58, 138)

    r_title = p.add_run(f"{section_label}: {title.upper()}\n")
    r_title.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_title.font.size = Pt(9)
    r_title.font.bold = True
    r_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(15, 23, 42)

    r_sub = p.add_run(f"{subtitle}\n\n")
    r_sub.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_sub.font.size = Pt(8)
    r_sub.font.italic = True
    r_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(100, 116, 139)

    r_note = p.add_run("Physical and logical architecture diagram maintained under institutional repository.\nApproved under DICT ISSP Guidelines • Reference Exhibit for Planning Horizon.")
    r_note.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_note.font.size = Pt(7.5)
    r_note.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(71, 85, 105)


def render_cybersecurity_checklist(doc, cyber_list: List[Any], is_proposed: bool = False):
    """Renders the official DICT Cybersecurity Control Checklist grouped by standard security domains."""
    standard_domains = [
        "PHYSICAL SECURITY",
        "PERIMETER SECURITY",
        "NETWORK SECURITY",
        "ENDPOINT SECURITY",
        "DATA SECURITY",
        "APPLICATION SECURITY",
        "OTHER MEASURES"
    ]

    active_controls = [c for c in cyber_list if getattr(c, "is_proposed", False) == is_proposed]

    tbl = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
    tbl.style = 'Table Grid'
    set_table_borders(tbl)
    make_header_row_repeat(tbl.rows[0])
    prevent_row_split(tbl.rows[0])

    headers = ["Security Domain", "MANDATORY CONTROLS", "OPTIONAL CONTROLS"]
    widths = [Inches(2.5), Inches(4.5), Inches(3.2)]

    for idx, h in enumerate(headers):
        c = tbl.rows[0].cells[idx]
        c.width = widths[idx]
        set_cell_shading(c, "F1F5F9")
        set_cell_margins(c, top=60, bottom=60, left=80, right=80)
        r = c.paragraphs[0].add_run(h)
        r.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
        r.font.bold = True
        r.font.size = Pt(8)

    for domain in standard_domains:
        d_controls = [c for c in active_controls if clean_str(getattr(c, "control_domain", "")).upper() == domain]
        mandatory = [c for c in d_controls if getattr(c, "is_mandatory", True)]
        optional = [c for c in d_controls if not getattr(c, "is_mandatory", True)]

        row = tbl.add_row()
        prevent_row_split(row)

        c0 = row.cells[0]
        c0.width = widths[0]
        set_cell_shading(c0, "F8FAFC")
        set_cell_margins(c0, top=50, bottom=50, left=80, right=80)
        r0 = c0.paragraphs[0].add_run(domain)
        r0.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
        r0.font.bold = True
        r0.font.size = Pt(7.5)

        c1 = row.cells[1]
        c1.width = widths[1]
        set_cell_margins(c1, top=50, bottom=50, left=80, right=80)
        p1 = c1.paragraphs[0]
        if mandatory:
            for c in mandatory:
                is_impl = getattr(c, "is_implemented", False)
                r = p1.add_run(f"[{'X' if is_impl else ' '}] {clean_str(c.control_name)}\n")
                r.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
                r.font.size = Pt(7)
        else:
            r = p1.add_run("No mandatory controls registered")
            r.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
            r.font.size = Pt(7)
            r.font.italic = True
            r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(148, 163, 184)

        c2 = row.cells[2]
        c2.width = widths[2]
        set_cell_margins(c2, top=50, bottom=50, left=80, right=80)
        p2 = c2.paragraphs[0]
        if optional:
            for c in optional:
                is_impl = getattr(c, "is_implemented", False)
                r = p2.add_run(f"[{'X' if is_impl else ' '}] {clean_str(c.control_name)}\n")
                r.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
                r.font.size = Pt(7)
        else:
            r = p2.add_run("None specified")
            r.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
            r.font.size = Pt(7)
            r.font.italic = True
            r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(148, 163, 184)


def render_information_system_card_docx(doc, sys_obj: Any, is_proposed: bool = False, projects: List[Any] = None):
    """Renders an official DICT Information System Specification Card in Word format."""
    tbl = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
    tbl.style = 'Table Grid'
    set_table_borders(tbl)
    prevent_row_split(tbl.rows[0])

    c_hdr = tbl.rows[0].cells[0]
    c_hdr_merge = tbl.rows[0].cells[1]
    c_hdr.merge(c_hdr_merge)
    set_cell_shading(c_hdr, "1E3A8A")
    set_cell_margins(c_hdr, top=80, bottom=80, left=120, right=120)

    p_hdr = c_hdr.paragraphs[0]
    p_hdr.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_hdr.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    r_hdr = p_hdr.add_run(f"INFORMATION SYSTEM: {clean_str(sys_obj.name).upper()}")
    r_hdr.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_hdr.font.bold = True
    r_hdr.font.size = Pt(8.5)
    r_hdr.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)

    def add_card_row(label: str, content: str, is_mono: bool = False, is_highlight: bool = False):
        row = tbl.add_row()
        prevent_row_split(row)
        c0, c1 = row.cells[0], row.cells[1]
        c0.width = Inches(2.6)
        c1.width = Inches(7.6)
        set_cell_shading(c0, "F8FAFC")
        set_cell_margins(c0, top=50, bottom=50, left=100, right=100)
        set_cell_margins(c1, top=50, bottom=50, left=100, right=100)

        p0 = c0.paragraphs[0]
        p0.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
        p0.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
        r0 = p0.add_run(label)
        r0.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
        r0.font.bold = True
        r0.font.size = Pt(7.5)

        p1 = c1.paragraphs[0]
        p1.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
        p1.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
        r1 = p1.add_run(content)
        r1.font.name = "Courier New" if is_mono else "Palatino Linotype"
        r1.font.size = Pt(7.5)
        if is_highlight:
            r1.font.bold = True
            r1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(4, 120, 87)

    class_str = clean_str(getattr(sys_obj, "classification", "")).lower()
    is_supp = getattr(sys_obj, "is_support_to_operations", False) or "support" in class_str
    is_adm = getattr(sys_obj, "is_general_administrative", False) or "admin" in class_str
    is_ops = getattr(sys_obj, "is_operations", False) or ("operations" in class_str and not is_supp and not is_adm)
    is_front = getattr(sys_obj, "is_frontline_service", False) or ("frontline" in class_str and "non-frontline" not in class_str)
    is_non_front = getattr(sys_obj, "is_non_frontline_service", False) or "non-frontline" in class_str

    hosting = clean_str(getattr(sys_obj, "frontline_hosting_type", None) or getattr(sys_obj, "hosting_type", "Online"))
    url = clean_str(getattr(sys_obj, "online_url", None))
    front_details = f" [{'X' if hosting == 'Online' else ' '}] Online [{'X' if hosting == 'On-premise' else ' '}] On-premise [{'X' if hosting == 'Hybrid' else ' '}] Hybrid" + (f" (URL: {url})" if url else "")

    class_text = (
        f"[{'X' if is_supp else ' '}] Support to Operations\n"
        f"[{'X' if is_adm else ' '}] General Administrative Systems\n"
        f"[{'X' if is_ops else ' '}] Operations\n"
        f"    [{'X' if is_front else ' '}] Frontline Service (Direct public/client delivery):{front_details}\n"
        f"    [{'X' if is_non_front else ' '}] Non-Frontline Service (Core mandate back-office)"
    )
    add_card_row("CLASSIFICATION", class_text)
    add_card_row("DESCRIPTION & PURPOSE", clean_str(sys_obj.description_and_purpose))

    status_val = clean_str(getattr(sys_obj, "status", "Operational"))
    add_card_row("LIFECYCLE STATUS", status_val)

    if is_proposed:
        cost_val = fmt_currency(getattr(sys_obj, "proposed_cost", 0))
        add_card_row("ESTIMATED PROPOSED COST", cost_val, is_mono=True, is_highlight=True)

        proj_title = None
        if getattr(sys_obj, "project_parent", None):
            proj_title = sys_obj.project_parent.project_title
        elif getattr(sys_obj, "project_id", None) and projects:
            p_obj = next((p for p in projects if str(p.id) == str(sys_obj.project_id)), None)
            if p_obj:
                proj_title = p_obj.project_title
        if proj_title:
            add_card_row("LINKED ICT PROJECT (PART III.E)", proj_title)

        if "enhancement" in status_val.lower() and getattr(sys_obj, "enhancement_details", None):
            add_card_row("ENHANCEMENT DETAILS", clean_str(sys_obj.enhancement_details))

    strat = clean_str(getattr(sys_obj, "development_strategy", "Outsourced"))
    add_card_row("DEVELOPMENT STRATEGY", strat)
    add_card_row("DEVELOPMENT PLATFORM", clean_str(sys_obj.development_platform))
    add_card_row("DATABASE NAME", clean_str(sys_obj.database_name), is_mono=True)
    add_card_row("DATA STORAGE", clean_str(sys_obj.data_storage_type))
    add_card_row("INTERNAL USERS", clean_str(sys_obj.internal_users))
    add_card_row("EXTERNAL USERS", clean_str(sys_obj.external_users))
    add_card_row("SYSTEM OWNER OFFICE", clean_str(sys_obj.system_owner_office))

    is_integ = getattr(sys_obj, "is_integrated_with_others", False)
    integ_text = (
        f"[{'X' if is_integ else ' '}] Integrated with another system\n"
        f"    Internal: {clean_str(sys_obj.internal_integrated_systems, 'None')} | External: {clean_str(sys_obj.external_integrated_systems, 'None')}\n"
        f"[{'X' if getattr(sys_obj, 'generates_data_for_others', False) else ' '}] Generates data utilized by other systems\n"
        f"[{'X' if getattr(sys_obj, 'processes_data_from_others', False) else ' '}] Processes data generated by other systems\n"
        f"[{'X' if getattr(sys_obj, 'is_deployed_on_shared_platform', False) else ' '}] Deployed on a shared platform"
    )
    add_card_row("INTEROPERABILITY", integ_text)

    proc_pii = getattr(sys_obj, "processes_personal_information", False)
    pia_done = getattr(sys_obj, "has_undergone_pia", False)
    pia_target = clean_str(getattr(sys_obj, "pia_target_date_text", None))
    pia_text = (
        f"Processes Personal Information: [{'X' if proc_pii else ' '}] Yes  [{'X' if not proc_pii else ' '}] No\n"
        f"Undergone PIA Audit: [{'X' if pia_done else ' '}] Yes  [{'X' if (proc_pii and not pia_done) else ' '}] No" +
        (f" (Target Completion Date: {pia_target})" if (proc_pii and not pia_done and pia_target) else "")
    )
    add_card_row("PRIVACY IMPACT ASSESSMENT (PIA)", pia_text)

    p_spacer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_spacer.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_spacer.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)


def render_project_charter_card(doc, proj: Any, is_cross: bool = False, planning_years: List[int] = None):
    """Renders an official DICT Project Charter Card in Word format (Parts III.E.1 & III.E.2)."""
    tbl = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
    tbl.style = 'Table Grid'
    set_table_borders(tbl)
    prevent_row_split(tbl.rows[0])

    c_hdr = tbl.rows[0].cells[0]
    c_hdr_merge = tbl.rows[0].cells[1]
    c_hdr.merge(c_hdr_merge)
    set_cell_shading(c_hdr, "1E3A8A")
    set_cell_margins(c_hdr, top=80, bottom=80, left=120, right=120)

    p_hdr = c_hdr.paragraphs[0]
    p_hdr.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_hdr.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    sec_prefix = "E.2. CROSS-AGENCY ICT PROJECT" if is_cross else "E.1. INTERNAL ICT PROJECT"
    r_hdr = p_hdr.add_run(f"{sec_prefix}: {clean_str(proj.project_title).upper()}")
    r_hdr.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_hdr.font.bold = True
    r_hdr.font.size = Pt(8.5)
    r_hdr.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)

    def add_charter_row(label: str, content: str, is_mono: bool = False, is_highlight: bool = False):
        row = tbl.add_row()
        prevent_row_split(row)
        c0, c1 = row.cells[0], row.cells[1]
        c0.width = Inches(2.6)
        c1.width = Inches(7.6)
        set_cell_shading(c0, "F8FAFC")
        set_cell_margins(c0, top=50, bottom=50, left=100, right=100)
        set_cell_margins(c1, top=50, bottom=50, left=100, right=100)

        p0 = c0.paragraphs[0]
        p0.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
        p0.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
        r0 = p0.add_run(label)
        r0.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
        r0.font.bold = True
        r0.font.size = Pt(7.5)

        p1 = c1.paragraphs[0]
        p1.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
        p1.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
        r1 = p1.add_run(content)
        r1.font.name = "Courier New" if is_mono else "Palatino Linotype"
        r1.font.size = Pt(7.5)
        if is_highlight:
            r1.font.bold = True
            r1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(4, 120, 87)

    add_charter_row("PROJECT TITLE", clean_str(proj.project_title))
    add_charter_row("DESCRIPTION", clean_str(proj.description))
    add_charter_row("OBJECTIVES", clean_str(proj.objectives))

    aligns_others_specify = clean_str(getattr(proj, "aligns_others_specify", None))
    others_text = f" ({aligns_others_specify})" if getattr(proj, "aligns_others", False) and aligns_others_specify else ""
    align_text = (
        f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'aligns_pip', False) else ' '}] Public Investment Program (PIP)\n"
        f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'aligns_ncsp', False) else ' '}] National Cybersecurity Plan (NCSP)\n"
        f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'aligns_egmp', False) else ' '}] E-Government Master Plan (EGMP)\n"
        f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'aligns_pcb', False) else ' '}] Program Convergence Budgeting (PCB)\n"
        f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'aligns_others', False) else ' '}] Others{others_text}"
    )
    add_charter_row("STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT", align_text)

    harm_map = getattr(proj, "harmonization_criteria", None)
    if isinstance(harm_map, str):
        try: harm_map = json.loads(harm_map)
        except Exception: harm_map = None

    if isinstance(harm_map, dict) and len(harm_map) > 0:
        harm_lines = [f"[{'X' if val else ' '}] {crit}" for crit, val in harm_map.items()]
        harm_text = "\n".join(harm_lines)
    else:
        harm_text = (
            f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'harmonizes_national_priority', False) else ' '}] National Prioritization (PDP 2023-2028)\n"
            f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'harmonizes_resource_optimization', False) else ' '}] Resource Optimization (GovNet, GovCloud)\n"
            f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'harmonizes_pegif', False) else ' '}] PeGIF Standardized APIs & Interoperability\n"
            f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'harmonizes_cross_collaboration', False) else ' '}] Cross-Agency Collaboration (JMC / MOA)\n"
            f"[{'X' if getattr(proj, 'harmonizes_scalability', False) else ' '}] Scalability and Sustainability (SPAR / PREXC)"
        )
    add_charter_row("HARMONIZATION FRAMEWORK", harm_text)

    p_start = getattr(proj, "duration_start_year", None) or 2028
    p_end = getattr(proj, "duration_end_year", None) or (p_start + 2)
    add_charter_row("DURATION", f"FY {p_start} to FY {p_end} ({max(1, p_end - p_start + 1)} Years)")

    annual_map = getattr(proj, "annual_deliverables", None) or {}
    if isinstance(annual_map, str):
        try: annual_map = json.loads(annual_map)
        except Exception: annual_map = {}

    p_years = list(range(p_start, p_end + 1)) if p_end >= p_start else [p_start]
    for idx, yr in enumerate(p_years):
        m_text = annual_map.get(str(yr)) or annual_map.get(f"Year {idx + 1}")
        if not m_text:
            if idx == 0: m_text = getattr(proj, "year_1_deliverables", "N/A")
            elif idx == 1: m_text = getattr(proj, "year_2_deliverables", "N/A")
            elif idx == 2: m_text = getattr(proj, "year_3_deliverables", "N/A")
            else: m_text = "N/A"
        add_charter_row(f"YEAR {idx + 1} DELIVERABLES (FY {yr})", clean_str(m_text, "N/A"))

    add_charter_row("IMPLEMENTING UNIT", clean_str(proj.implementing_unit, "ICT Management Office"))
    add_charter_row("TOTAL PROJECT COST", fmt_currency(proj.computed_total_project_cost), is_mono=True, is_highlight=True)
    add_charter_row("FUNDING SOURCE", clean_str(getattr(proj.funding_source, 'value', proj.funding_source), "GAA"))

    if is_cross:
        add_charter_row("LEAD AGENCY", clean_str(getattr(proj, "lead_agency", None), "DICT"))
        add_charter_row("PARTNER AGENCIES", clean_str(getattr(proj, "partner_agencies", None), "None"))

    p_spacer = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_spacer.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_spacer.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)


# =========================================================================
# CORE DOCUMENT GENERATOR PIPELINE
# =========================================================================

def create_issp_docx(
    narrative: Any,
    outcomes: List[Any],
    concerns: List[Any],
    systems: List[Any],
    projects: List[Any],
    performance_metrics: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    items: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    inventory: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    parity_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    human_capitals: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    staff_positions: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    stakeholders: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    egov_checklists: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    glossary: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    network_infra: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    cyber_controls: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    dr_teams: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    dr_bias: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    dr_metrics: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
    **kwargs
) -> io.BytesIO:
    """
    Builds a fully formatted, editable Microsoft Word (.docx) document
    representing the complete DICT ISSP v.2026 statutory blueprint.
    Guarantees strict single-page cover sheet layout, running headers/footers with
    dynamic page numbers, and total sanitization of placeholder images.
    """
    doc = Document()

    # =========================================================================
    # SECTION 1: COVER PAGE SETUP (NO HEADER, NO FOOTER, STRICT 1-PAGE)
    # =========================================================================
    sec1 = doc.sections[0]
    sec1.orientation = WD_ORIENTATION.LANDSCAPE
    sec1.page_width = Inches(11.69)
    sec1.page_height = Inches(8.27)
    sec1.top_margin = Inches(0.55)
    sec1.bottom_margin = Inches(0.55)
    sec1.left_margin = Inches(0.7)
    sec1.right_margin = Inches(0.7)

    # Detach headers and footers completely for Section 1
    sec1.header.is_linked_to_previous = False
    sec1.footer.is_linked_to_previous = False
    sec1.header.paragraphs[0].text = ""
    sec1.footer.paragraphs[0].text = ""

    issp_period = clean_str(narrative.issp_period, "2026-2028")
    agency_name = clean_str(narrative.agency_name, getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME", "National Government Agency"))
    
    start_year = getattr(narrative, "issp_period_from", None)
    end_year = getattr(narrative, "issp_period_to", None)
    if start_year is None or end_year is None:
        if "-" in issp_period:
            try:
                parts = issp_period.split("-")
                start_year = int(parts[0].strip())
                end_year = int(parts[1].strip())
            except Exception:
                start_year = 2026
                end_year = 2028
        else:
            start_year = 2026
            end_year = 2028
            
    planning_years = list(range(start_year, end_year + 1))

    # Resolve Signatories cleanly (preserving user-entered names without hardcoded human names)
    raw_cio = clean_str(getattr(narrative, "signatory_prepared_by", None) or getattr(narrative, "cio_name", None))
    cio_name = raw_cio if raw_cio else "CHIEF INFORMATION OFFICER"

    raw_head = clean_str(getattr(narrative, "signatory_approved_by", None) or getattr(narrative, "head_of_agency_name", None))
    head_name = raw_head if raw_head else clean_str(getattr(narrative, "agency_head_position", None), getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_AGENCY_HEAD_TITLE", "Head of Agency")).upper()

    head_title = clean_str(getattr(narrative, "agency_head_position", None), getattr(settings, "DEFAULT_AGENCY_HEAD_TITLE", "Head of Agency"))

    # Resolve relationships defensively if optional lists are omitted
    hc_list = human_capitals or getattr(narrative, "human_capitals_relation", []) or []
    sh_list = stakeholders or getattr(narrative, "stakeholder_analyses_relation", []) or []
    net_list = network_infra or getattr(narrative, "network_infrastructures", []) or []
    cyber_list = cyber_controls or getattr(narrative, "cybersecurity_controls", []) or []
    egov_list = egov_checklists or getattr(narrative, "egov_checklists_relation", []) or []
    staff_list = staff_positions or getattr(narrative, "staff_positions_relation", []) or []
    drt_list = dr_teams or getattr(narrative, "dr_team_relation", []) or []
    bia_list = dr_bias or getattr(narrative, "dr_bia_relation", []) or []
    drm_list = dr_metrics or getattr(narrative, "dr_metrics_relation", []) or []

    # MERGE STATUTORY GLOSSARY: Guarantee all 12 official terms exist alongside custom definitions
    glossary_dict = {}
    for term, definition in DEFAULT_CANONICAL_GLOSSARY:
        glossary_dict[term.upper()] = (term, definition)

    if glossary:
        for g in glossary:
            if isinstance(g, (list, tuple)) and len(g) >= 2:
                t, d = str(g[0]).strip(), str(g[1]).strip()
            else:
                t = clean_str(getattr(g, "term", ""))
                d = clean_str(getattr(g, "definition", ""))
            if t and d:
                glossary_dict[t.upper()] = (t, d)

    glossary_list = list(glossary_dict.values())

    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    # BUILD COVER PAGE CONTENT (STRICT COMPACT 1-PAGE FIT)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------
    agency_logo_data = get_agency_logo_bytes(narrative)
    if agency_logo_data:
        try:
            p_logo = doc.add_paragraph()
            p_logo.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            p_logo.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
            p_logo.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
            p_logo.add_run().add_picture(io.BytesIO(agency_logo_data), width=Inches(1.2))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"Cover logo insertion note: {e}")

    p_rep = doc.add_paragraph()
    p_rep.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    p_rep.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_rep.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
    p_rep.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.12

    r_rep = p_rep.add_run("Republic of the Philippines\n")
    r_rep.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_rep.font.size = Pt(8.5)
    r_rep.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(71, 85, 105)

    r_agency = p_rep.add_run(f"{agency_name.upper()}\n")
    r_agency.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_agency.font.size = Pt(13)
    r_agency.font.bold = True
    r_agency.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(15, 23, 42)

    agency_addr = clean_str(getattr(narrative, 'agency_address', None), "")
    if agency_addr:
        r_loc = p_rep.add_run(f"{agency_addr}\n")
        r_loc.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
        r_loc.font.size = Pt(8.0)
        r_loc.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(100, 116, 139)

    r_plan = p_rep.add_run("INFORMATION SYSTEMS STRATEGIC PLAN (ISSP)\n")
    r_plan.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_plan.font.size = Pt(17)
    r_plan.font.bold = True
    r_plan.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(30, 58, 138)

    is_amend = bool(getattr(narrative, "is_amendment", False))
    amend_num = getattr(narrative, "amendment_number", "1st") or "1st"
    type_str = f"[X] AMENDMENT <{amend_num}>     [ ] REGULAR ISSP" if is_amend else "[X] REGULAR ISSP     [ ] AMENDMENT"

    r_type = p_rep.add_run(f"{type_str}\n")
    r_type.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_type.font.size = Pt(9.5)
    r_type.font.bold = True

    r_period = p_rep.add_run(f"For the period {start_year} to {end_year}\n")
    r_period.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_period.font.size = Pt(10)
    r_period.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(71, 85, 105)

    if narrative.agency_website_url:
        r_url = p_rep.add_run(f"<{narrative.agency_website_url}>\n")
        r_url.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
        r_url.font.size = Pt(8.5)
        r_url.font.italic = True
        r_url.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(100, 116, 139)

    # Cover Table: Signatories & Scope
    cov_table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
    cov_table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    cov_table.autofit = False
    set_table_borders(cov_table, color="FFFFFF")
    prevent_row_split(cov_table.rows[0])

    # Left Cell: Signatories structured cleanly without excessive vertical newlines
    c_left = cov_table.rows[0].cells[0]
    c_left.width = Inches(5.1)
    set_cell_margins(c_left, top=30, bottom=30, left=80, right=80)

    p_prep = c_left.paragraphs[0]
    p_prep.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_prep.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(20)
    r_prep = p_prep.add_run("PREPARED BY:")
    r_prep.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_prep.font.size = Pt(8.5)
    r_prep.font.bold = True
    r_prep.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(30, 58, 138)

    p_cio = c_left.add_paragraph()
    p_cio.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_cio.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
    r_cio = p_cio.add_run(f"    {cio_name.upper()}")
    r_cio.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_cio.font.size = Pt(9.5)
    r_cio.font.bold = True

    p_cio_line = c_left.add_paragraph()
    p_cio_line.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_cio_line.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
    r_cline = p_cio_line.add_run("    _________________________________________")
    r_cline.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_cline.font.size = Pt(8.5)

    p_cio_tit = c_left.add_paragraph()
    p_cio_tit.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_cio_tit.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(18)
    r_ctit = p_cio_tit.add_run("    Name & Signature of Chief Information Officer")
    r_ctit.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_ctit.font.size = Pt(7.5)
    r_ctit.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(71, 85, 105)

    p_app = c_left.add_paragraph()
    p_app.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_app.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(20)
    r_app = p_app.add_run("APPROVED BY:")
    r_app.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_app.font.size = Pt(8.5)
    r_app.font.bold = True
    r_app.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(30, 58, 138)

    p_head = c_left.add_paragraph()
    p_head.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_head.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
    r_head = p_head.add_run(f"    {head_name.upper()}")
    r_head.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_head.font.size = Pt(9.5)
    r_head.font.bold = True

    p_head_line = c_left.add_paragraph()
    p_head_line.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_head_line.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
    r_hline = p_head_line.add_run("    _________________________________________")
    r_hline.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_hline.font.size = Pt(8.5)

    p_head_tit = c_left.add_paragraph()
    p_head_tit.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_head_tit.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    r_htit = p_head_tit.add_run(f"    Name & Signature of Agency Head\n    ({head_title})")
    r_htit.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_htit.font.size = Pt(7.5)
    r_htit.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(71, 85, 105)

    # Right Cell: Scope Checklist Box
    c_right = cov_table.rows[0].cells[1]
    c_right.width = Inches(5.1)
    set_cell_shading(c_right, "F8FAFC")
    set_cell_margins(c_right, top=60, bottom=60, left=120, right=120)

    p_scope = c_right.paragraphs[0]
    p_scope.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
    p_scope.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
    p_scope.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.12

    r_sc_title = p_scope.add_run("SCOPE OF PLAN:\n")
    r_sc_title.font.name = "Palatino Linotype"
    r_sc_title.font.size = Pt(8.5)
    r_sc_title.font.bold = True
    r_sc_title.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(30, 58, 138)

    scope_choice_clean = clean_str(narrative.scope_choice, "Department-Wide").lower().replace("_", "-")
    scope_json = getattr(narrative, "scope_json", {}) or {}
    has_reg = bool(scope_json.get("with_regional_offices"))
    has_bur = bool(scope_json.get("with_bureaus"))

    is_dept_wide = "department-wide" in scope_choice_clean or not scope_choice_clean
    is_dept_co = "central" in scope_choice_clean and not is_dept_wide

    def render_pmf_subtable(metrics_subset: List[Any], subheader: str):
        p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
        p_sub.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(4)
        p_sub.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
        r_sub = p_sub.add_run(subheader)

            return

        pmf_table.style = 'Table Grid'

        widths_pmf = [Inches(2.2), Inches(1.5), Inches(2.6), Inches(1.1), Inches(1.2), Inches(1.6)]

        for i, h in enumerate(headers_pmf):
            cell = pmf_table.rows[0].cells[i]
            cell.width = widths_pmf[i]
            set_cell_shading(cell, "F1F5F9")
            set_cell_margins(cell, top=50, bottom=50, left=60, right=60)
            r = cell.paragraphs[0].add_run(h)
            r.font.bold = True
            r.font.size = Pt(7.5)
