}

/**
 * 1-Step Unified Proposal Creation with Direct Quotation File Upload.
 * Accepts proposal metadata and an optional PDF file in a single request.
 *
 * @param {Object} payload - ProposalCreatePayload schema
 * @param {File|null} file - Optional quotation canvas PDF file
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function createProposalWithCanvas(payload, file = null, customToken = null) {
  const cleanPayload = sanitizeProposalPayload(payload);

  if (file && file instanceof File) {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("payload_json", JSON.stringify(cleanPayload));
    formData.append("file", file);

    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals/with-canvas`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: getHeaders(true, customToken),
      body: formData
    });
    return handleResponse(res, "Failed to create proposal with canvas evidence");
  }

  // Fallback to standard JSON endpoint if no file was provided
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken),
    body: JSON.stringify(cleanPayload)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to create draft proposal");
}

/**
 * Creates a new draft proposal in the unified Part IV.A ledger.
 * Overloaded to support optional file upload as the second argument.
 *
 * @param {Object} payload - Validated ProposalCreatePayload schema
 * @param {File|string|null} fileOrToken - Optional File object or override token string
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function createDraftProposal(payload, fileOrToken = null, customToken = null) {
  let file = null;
  let token = customToken;

  if (fileOrToken instanceof File) {
    file = fileOrToken;
  } else if (typeof fileOrToken === "string") {
    token = fileOrToken;
  }

  if (file) {
    return createProposalWithCanvas(payload, file, token);
  }

  const cleanPayload = sanitizeProposalPayload(payload);
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: getHeaders(false, token),
    body: JSON.stringify(cleanPayload)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to create draft proposal");
}

 * Clones an existing proposal into a fresh Draft state.

    method: "POST",
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to duplicate proposal");
}

/**
 * Updates parameters of an existing proposal in Draft or Returned state.
 * Optionally uploads an updated canvas file if supplied.
 *
 * @param {string} proposalId - UUID of the proposal
 * @param {Object} payload - Validated ProposalCreatePayload schema
 * @param {File|string|null} fileOrToken - Optional File object or override token string
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function updateProposal(proposalId, payload, fileOrToken = null, customToken = null) {
  let file = null;
  let token = customToken;

  if (fileOrToken instanceof File) {
    file = fileOrToken;
  } else if (typeof fileOrToken === "string") {
    token = fileOrToken;
  }

  const cleanPayload = sanitizeProposalPayload(payload);
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/proposals/${encodeURIComponent(proposalId)}`, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers: getHeaders(false, token),
    body: JSON.stringify(cleanPayload)
  });
  const updatedProposal = await handleResponse(res, "Failed to update proposal parameters");

  // If a file was attached alongside updates, upload it to link cleanly
  if (file) {
    const supplier = cleanPayload.supplier_name || "Supplier";
    const expiry = cleanPayload.canvas_expiration_date || null;
    await uploadCanvas(proposalId, supplier, file, expiry, token);
  }

  return updatedProposal;
}

// 6. ANNEX 1: DEPARTMENT INVENTORY (Read-Only Scoped View)
// ==============================================================================

/**
 * Retrieves the department's baseline ICT equipment and software inventory.
 * Strictly scoped so department planners view ONLY their own assets.
 * Supports optional filtering by DICT standard category (dict_category), search query,
 * obsolescence/EOL flags, software classification, and condition status.
 *
 * @param {number|Object} paramsOrSkip - Pagination offset (number) OR options/filter object
 * @param {number} limit - Items per page (if first parameter is numeric offset)
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function getInventory(paramsOrSkip = 0, limit = 100, customToken = null) {
  const queryParams = new URLSearchParams();
  let token = customToken;

  if (typeof paramsOrSkip === "object" && paramsOrSkip !== null) {
    const {
      skip = 0,
      limit: lim = 100,
      search = "",
      dict_category = "",
      dictCategory = "",
      is_software = null,
      isSoftware = null,
      is_end_of_life = null,
      isEndOfLife = null,
      is_backup = null,
      isBackup = null,
      status_filter = "",
      statusFilter = "",
      token: optToken = null
    } = paramsOrSkip;

    queryParams.append("skip", String(skip));
    queryParams.append("limit", String(lim));
    if (search) queryParams.append("search", String(search).trim());

    const resolvedCategory = dict_category || dictCategory;
    if (resolvedCategory && resolvedCategory !== "All") {
      queryParams.append("dict_category", String(resolvedCategory).trim());
    }

    const resolvedIsSoftware = is_software !== null ? is_software : isSoftware;
    if (resolvedIsSoftware !== null && resolvedIsSoftware !== undefined) {
      queryParams.append("is_software", String(resolvedIsSoftware));
    }

    const resolvedEol = is_end_of_life !== null ? is_end_of_life : isEndOfLife;
    if (resolvedEol !== null && resolvedEol !== undefined) {
      queryParams.append("is_end_of_life", String(resolvedEol));
    }

    const resolvedBackup = is_backup !== null ? is_backup : isBackup;
    if (resolvedBackup !== null && resolvedBackup !== undefined) {
      queryParams.append("is_backup", String(resolvedBackup));
    }

    const resolvedStatus = status_filter || statusFilter;
    if (resolvedStatus && resolvedStatus !== "All") {
      queryParams.append("status_filter", String(resolvedStatus).trim());
    }

    if (optToken) token = optToken;
  } else {
    queryParams.append("skip", String(paramsOrSkip));
    queryParams.append("limit", String(limit));
  }

  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/inventory?${queryParams.toString()}`, {
    headers: getHeaders(false, token)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to load departmental baseline inventory");
}

/**
 * Logs an inventory asset into Annex 1.
 * Routes to the master supply handler with fallback support.
 * Explicitly preserves dict_category and other_category_name in payload.
 *
 * @param {Object} payload - SupplyInventoryCreate schema (including dict_category and other_category_name)
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional override token
 */
export async function logExistingAsset(payload, customToken = null) {
  let res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/supply/inventory`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: getHeaders(false, customToken),
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });

  if (res.status === 404 || res.status === 405) {
    res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/inventory`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: getHeaders(false, customToken),
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
  }

  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to register baseline inventory asset");
}

// 7. SECTION 8.0: NEEDS ASSESSMENT & OPERATIONAL JUSTIFICATIONS
// ==============================================================================

/**
 * Retrieves documented technical needs assessments and operational justifications.
 * Accepts optional query parameters or authorization override tokens.
 *
 * @param {Object|string} paramsOrToken - Optional query parameters object or token string
 * @param {string|null} customToken - Optional explicit token override
 */
export async function getNeedsAssessments(paramsOrToken = {}, customToken = null) {
  let params = {};
  let token = customToken;

  if (typeof paramsOrToken === "string") {
    token = paramsOrToken;
  } else if (typeof paramsOrToken === "object" && paramsOrToken !== null) {
    params = paramsOrToken;
  }

  const query = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();
  const url = `${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/needs-assessment${query ? `?${query}` : ""}`;
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    headers: getHeaders(false, token)
  });
  return handleResponse(res, "Failed to load department needs assessments");
}

// frontend/src/components/common/AlertBanner.jsx
import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Info, 
  X,
  ChevronRight
} from "lucide-react";

/**
 * Parses and extracts human-readable error messages, Pydantic arrays, 
 * DAG violation envelopes, and handles Error objects without producing '[object Object]' or raw tracebacks.
 */
function extractErrorDetails(input) {
  if (!input) return { heading: null, items: [] };

  // 1. Error instance handling (JSON.stringify(new Error()) is {} in JS)
  if (input instanceof Error) {
    if (Array.isArray(input.violations) && input.violations.length > 0) {
      return {
        heading: input.message?.includes(":") ? input.message.split(":")[0] : "Integrity Verification Failed",
        items: input.violations
      };
    }
    return extractErrorDetails(input.data || input.message);
  }

  // 2. Direct Array parsing
  if (Array.isArray(input)) {
    const items = input.map(item => {
      if (typeof item === "string") return item;
      if (typeof item === "object" && item !== null) {
        if (item.msg) {
          const field = item.loc ? item.loc.filter(p => p !== "body").join(" -> ") : "";
          return field ? `${field}: ${item.msg}` : item.msg;
        }
        return JSON.stringify(item);
      }
      return String(item);
    }).filter(Boolean);
    return { heading: null, items };
  }

  // 3. Object parsing (FastAPI / Pydantic / Singularity DAG envelopes)
  if (typeof input === "object" && input !== null) {
    // Singularity Graph violation array
    if (Array.isArray(input.violations) && input.violations.length > 0) {
      return {
        heading: input.error || input.heading || "Compliance Integrity Failure",
        items: input.violations
      };
    }
    // Nested detail violations object
    if (input.detail && typeof input.detail === "object" && Array.isArray(input.detail.violations)) {
      return {
        heading: input.detail.error || "Compliance Integrity Failure",
        items: input.detail.violations
      };
    }
    // Pydantic array in detail
    if (Array.isArray(input.detail)) {
      const items = input.detail.map(err => {
        if (err.msg) {
          const field = err.loc ? err.loc.filter(p => p !== "body").join(" -> ") : "";
          return field ? `${field}: ${err.msg}` : err.msg;
        }
        return typeof err === "string" ? err : JSON.stringify(err);
      });
      return { heading: "Validation Error", items };
    }
    // String in detail or message
    if (typeof input.detail === "string") {
      return extractErrorDetails(input.detail);
    }
    if (typeof input.message === "string") {
      return extractErrorDetails(input.message);
    }
    if (typeof input.error === "string") {
      return extractErrorDetails(input.error);
    }
    
    // Fallback serialization avoiding empty object representation
    const str = JSON.stringify(input);
    return { heading: null, items: str === "{}" ? ["An unexpected error occurred."] : [str] };
  }

  // 4. String parsing
  if (typeof input === "string") {
    let raw = input.trim();
    if (raw === "[object Object]") {
      return { heading: null, items: ["An unexpected error occurred. Please verify your connection or inspect logs."] };
    }

    // Strip raw Python tracebacks down to the final meaningful exception line
    if (raw.includes("Traceback (most recent call last)")) {
      const lines = raw.split("\n").map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const lastLine = lines[lines.length - 1] || "Internal server exception intercepted";
      return { heading: "Server Exception Intercepted", items: [lastLine] };
    }

    // Bulleted lists: \n• or \n-
    if (raw.includes("\n•") || raw.includes("\n-")) {
      const lines = raw.split(/\n[•-]\s*/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const heading = lines.length > 1 ? lines[0].replace(/:$/, "") : null;
      const items = lines.length > 1 ? lines.slice(1) : lines;
      return { heading, items };
    }

    // Pipe-delimited messages: "field1: msg1 | field2: msg2"
    if (raw.includes(" | ")) {
      const segments = raw.split(" | ").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      let heading = null;
      let items = segments;
      if (segments[0].includes(": ")) {
        const [prefix, firstItem] = segments[0].split(/:\s*(.+)/);
        heading = prefix;
        items = [firstItem, ...segments.slice(1)];
      }
      return { heading, items };
    }

    // Standard newlines
    if (raw.includes("\n")) {
      const lines = raw.split("\n").map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (lines.length > 1) {
        const heading = lines[0].endsWith(":") ? lines[0].slice(0, -1) : null;
        const items = heading ? lines.slice(1) : lines;
        return { heading, items };
      }
    }

    return { heading: null, items: [raw] };
  }

  return { heading: null, items: [String(input)] };
}

/**
 * Enhanced Statutory AlertBanner Component
 *
 * Supports single-line notifications, rich titles, and multi-violation checklists.
 * Automatically parses pipe-delimited (`|`), newline-delimited (`\n` or `•`),
 * and Pydantic validation envelopes into an itemized, human-readable compliance checklist.
 *
 * @param {string|string[]|object|Error} text - Alert message, string array, error object, or Error instance
 * @param {string} [title] - Optional bold title header
 * @param {string} [type="info"] - "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "error"
 * @param {string[]} [violations] - Optional explicit array of violation strings
 * @param {function} [onDismiss] - Optional dismiss callback
 * @param {React.ReactNode} [action] - Optional actionable button/link
 * @param {string} [className] - Additional wrapper CSS classes
 * @param {React.ReactNode} [children] - Optional custom child content
 */
export default function AlertBanner({ 
  text, 
  title = null,
  type = "info", 
  violations = null,
  onDismiss = null,
  action = null,
  className = "",
  children = null
}) {
  const normalizedType = type === "error" ? "danger" : type;

  const configs = {
    success: {
      style: "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200",
      icon: <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
    },
    warning: {
      style: "bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:border-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200",
      icon: <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
    },
    danger: {
      style: "bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-900 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:border-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200",
      icon: <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
    },
    info: {
      style: "bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-900 dark:bg-blue-950/40 dark:border-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200",
      icon: <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
    }
  };

  const { style, icon } = configs[normalizedType] || configs.info;

  // Process and sanitize input into clean heading and checklist items
  const parsedData = useMemo(() => {
    // 1. Explicit violations array passed via prop
    if (Array.isArray(violations) && violations.length > 0) {
      return {
        heading: title || "Compliance Verification Checklist",
        items: violations
      };
    }

    const extracted = extractErrorDetails(text);
    return {
      heading: title || extracted.heading,
      items: extracted.items
    };
  }, [text, title, violations]);

  // Don't render an empty banner if there is no text/items and no children
  if (parsedData.items.length === 0 && !children && !parsedData.heading) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div 
      role="alert"
      className={`p-4 border rounded-2xl text-xs leading-relaxed flex items-start justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs animate-fadeIn ${style} ${className}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-start gap-3 flex-1">
        <span className="mt-0.5">{icon}</span>
        
        <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1">
          {parsedData.heading && (
            <div className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wide font-sans">
              {parsedData.heading}
            </div>
          )}

          {parsedData.items.length > 1 ? (
            <ul className="space-y-1.5 pt-0.5">
              {parsedData.items.map((item, idx) => (
                <li key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] leading-snug">
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-60 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span className="break-words">{item}</span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : parsedData.items.length === 1 ? (
            <div className="font-medium whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed break-words font-sans text-xs">
              {parsedData.items[0]}
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {children}

          {action && (
            <div className="pt-2">
              {action}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {onDismiss && (
        <button 
          type="button"
          onClick={onDismiss} 
          className="text-current opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity p-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          aria-label="Dismiss alert"
          title="Dismiss"
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { verifyCompilerSync } from "../../api/admin";
import {

// Friendly mapping of internal module keys to official DICT ISSP sections
const MODULE_DISPLAY_NAMES = {
  outcomes: "Part I.A.4: Organizational Outcomes",
  organizational_outcomes: "Part I.A.4: Organizational Outcomes",
  concerns: "Part II.A: Strategic Concerns for ICT Use",
  strategic_concerns: "Part II.A: Strategic Concerns for ICT Use",

/**
 * Universal Compiler Verification Button
 *
 * Executes automated pre-flight checks against the active database state,
 * asserting that the module's relational graph linkages and statutory constraints
 * meet the prerequisites for DICT ISSP v.2026 WeasyPrint PDF compilation.
 *
 * @param {string} moduleName - Canonical key matching backend audit router
 * @param {string} activeCycle - Active planning cycle (e.g. "2026-2028")
 * @param {string|null} token - Optional JWT token override
 * @param {Function|null} onSaveAndSync - Optional pre-verification callback (e.g., save form, refresh state)
 * @param {string} label - Button display text
 * @param {string} variant - "primary" | "secondary" | "compact" | "outline"
 * @param {string} className - Additional CSS classes
 * @param {boolean} showVaultLink - If true, displays shortcut to Document Vault on certification
 */
export default function CompilerSyncButton({ 
  moduleName, 
  activeCycle = "", 
  token = null, 
  onSaveAndSync = null, 
  label = "Save & Verify Compiler Pipeline",
  variant = "primary",
  className = "",
  showVaultLink = true
}) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [verifying, setVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [report, setReport] = useState(null);

  // Close modal on Escape key press
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && report) {
        setReport(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [report]);

  const handleVerify = async () => {
    setVerifying(true);
    setReport(null);
    try {
      if (onSaveAndSync) {
        await onSaveAndSync();
      }
      const data = await verifyCompilerSync(token, moduleName, activeCycle);
      setReport(data);
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMsg = typeof err === "object" && err !== null 
        ? (err.message || JSON.stringify(err)) 
        : String(err);

      setReport({
        status: "DISCONNECT",
        compiler_ready: false,
        module: moduleName,
        issp_period: activeCycle || "Active Cycle",
        records_count: 0,
        message: errorMsg || "Failed to communicate with the compiler verification service.",
        checks: [],
        warnings: [errorMsg || "Compiler verification service unreachable."]
      });
    } finally {
      setVerifying(false);
    }
  };

  const moduleKey = (report?.module || moduleName || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  const moduleDisplayName = MODULE_DISPLAY_NAMES[moduleKey] || (moduleName || "GOVERNANCE").toUpperCase();
  const cycleDisplay = report?.issp_period || activeCycle || "Active Cycle";

  // Visual variant styling resolver
  const buttonStyle = useMemo(() => {
    if (className) return className;
    switch (variant) {
      case "secondary":
        return "px-3 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs text-xs cursor-pointer transition-all shrink-0";
      case "compact":
        return "px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-xs text-[11px] cursor-pointer transition-all shrink-0";
      case "outline":
        return "px-3 py-2 bg-transparent hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs cursor-pointer transition-all shrink-0";
      case "primary":
      default:
        return "px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm text-xs cursor-pointer transition-all shrink-0";
    }
  }, [variant, className]);

  return (
    <>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleVerify}
        disabled={verifying}
        className={buttonStyle}
        title="Validates that this module's records satisfy the DICT Singularity Graph and are ready for PDF compilation"
      >
        <ShieldCheck className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 ${verifying ? "animate-spin text-white" : ""}`} />
        <span>{verifying ? "Auditing Pipeline..." : label}</span>
      </button>

      {/* Verification Status Modal */}
      {report && (
        <div 
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn"
          onClick={(e) => {
            if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setReport(null);
          }}
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
        >
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col">
            
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                {report.compiler_ready ? (
                  <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-955/40 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800">
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-955/40 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800">
                    <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 animate-pulse" />
                  </div>
                )}
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">
                    {report.compiler_ready 
                      ? "Module Certified for PDF Compilation" 
                      : "Compiler Pipeline Disconnect Detected"}
                  </h3>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono block mt-0.5">
                    {moduleDisplayName} &bull; FY {cycleDisplay}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <button 
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setReport(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Close (Esc)"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Body */}
            <div className="space-y-3.5 text-xs leading-relaxed overflow-y-auto pr-1 flex-1">
              <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium">
                {report.message}
              </p>

              {/* Verified Pre-Flight Linkages List */}
              {report.checks && report.checks.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1.5 bg-emerald-50/70 dark:bg-emerald-955/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/40 p-3.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-[10.5px]">
                  <strong className="text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300 uppercase font-bold text-[9px] block tracking-wider">
                    Verified Compiler Assertions:
                  </strong>
                  {report.checks.map((chk, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 flex items-start gap-1.5">
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      <span>{chk}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Actionable Disconnect Warnings List */}
              {report.warnings && report.warnings.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-2 bg-rose-50/80 dark:bg-rose-955/30 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900/60 p-3.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-[10.5px]">
                  <strong className="text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 text-[9.5px] uppercase block font-bold tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
                    <span>Action Required Prior to Document Generation:</span>
                  </strong>
                  <ul className="space-y-1.5 pl-1">
                    {report.warnings.map((warn, idx) => (
                      <li key={idx} className="text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 flex items-start gap-1.5 leading-snug">
                        <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold shrink-0">&bull;</span>
                        <span>{warn}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Modal Actions Footer */}
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                Records: <strong>{report.records_count ?? 0}</strong>
              </span>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {report.compiler_ready && showVaultLink && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setReport(null);
                      navigate("/admin/vault");
                    }}
                    className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5"
                  >
                    <FileCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Proceed to Document Vault</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                )}

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setReport(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer transition-all border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700"
                >
                  {report.compiler_ready ? "Done" : "Acknowledge"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/common/DataTable.jsx
import React from "react";

export default function DataTable({ 
  headers = [], 
  data = [], 
  renderRow, 
  emptyMessage = "No active records found.",
  headerActions = null 
}) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
      {headerActions && (
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-between items-center">
          {headerActions}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase text-[9.5px] tracking-wider font-mono">
              {headers.map((header, idx) => (
                <th key={idx} className="p-3.5">
                  {header}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
            {data.length > 0 ? (
              data.map((item, idx) => renderRow(item, idx))
            ) : (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={headers.length} className="p-12 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
                  {emptyMessage}
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/common/Modal.jsx
import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import { X } from "lucide-react";

export default function Modal({ 
  isOpen, 
  onClose, 
  title, 
  subtitle = null,
  size = "md",
  children,
  footer = null
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && isOpen && onClose) {
        onClose();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [isOpen, onClose]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const sizeClasses = {
    sm: "max-w-sm",
    md: "max-w-lg",
    lg: "max-w-2xl",
    xl: "max-w-4xl",
    "2xl": "max-w-6xl"
  }[size] || "max-w-lg";

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
      <div 
        className={`bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl w-full ${sizeClasses} flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 font-sans`}
      >
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{title}</h3>
            {subtitle && (
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{subtitle}</p>
            )}
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 custom-scrollbar">
          {children}
        </div>

        {footer && (
          <div className="px-6 py-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
            {footer}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// frontend/src/components/common/StatusPill.jsx
import React from 'react';

export default function StatusPill({ status }) {
  const normalized = (status || "Draft").toString().trim();
  
  const styles = {
    Approved: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20",
    Submitted: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400 dark:border-blue-500/20",
    Returned: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500/20",
    Draft: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700",
    Operational: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20",
    "For Development": "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400 dark:border-blue-500/20",
    "For Enhancement": "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/20",
    Functional: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20",
    Condemned: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500/20",
    "Needs Repair": "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/20",
  };

      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-current opacity-80" />
      <span>{normalized}</span>
    </span>
  );

// frontend/src/components/layout/DashboardLayout.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { NavLink, Outlet, useNavigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../context/CycleContext";
import { useNotifications } from "../../context/NotificationContext";
import { useTheme } from "../../context/ThemeContext";
import { API_BASE_URL } from "../../api/apiClient";
import { 
  Search, Bell, Mail, CheckCircle2, Sun, Moon, 
  LayoutDashboard, FolderKanban, Database, 
  Landmark, Coins, TrendingUp, Users, 
  ImageIcon, History, LogOut,
  ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Key, FileText,
  ClipboardList, Inbox, BookOpen,
  GraduationCap, ShieldCheck,
  ShieldAlert, CheckSquare, Activity,
  FileBarChart, MessageSquare, ArrowRight, X,
  Calendar, Table, HelpCircle, SlidersHorizontal,
  LifeBuoy, Tag
} from "lucide-react";

export default function DashboardLayout() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { user, logoutSession } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle, agencyLogoUrl, agencyName: cycleAgencyName } = useCycle();
  const { actionCount, returnedCount, recentNotifications, recentRemarks } = useNotifications();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();

  const [globalSearch, setGlobalSearch] = useState("");
  const [headroom, setHeadroom] = useState(null);
  const searchInputRef = useRef(null);

  const [activePopover, setActivePopover] = useState(null);
  const popoverRef = useRef(null);

  // Grouped Navigation Accordions
  const [openSections, setOpenSections] = useState({
    dashboards: true,
    strategy: true,
    finance: true,
    governance: true
  });

  const toggleSection = (sectionKey) => {
    setOpenSections(prev => ({ ...prev, [sectionKey]: !prev[sectionKey] }));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
      if (popoverRef.current && !popoverRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setActivePopover(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "k") {
        e.preventDefault();
        searchInputRef.current?.focus();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  const defaultAgencyName = import.meta.env.VITE_DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME || "National Government Agency";
  const agencyName = import.meta.env.VITE_AGENCY_NAME || cycleAgencyName || user?.agency_name || defaultAgencyName;
  const userEmail = user?.email || "user@agency.gov.ph";
  const userRole = user?.role || "ROLE_DEPT_USER";

  const deptName = user?.department_name || (
    userRole === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" 
      ? "MIS Governance Directorate" 
      : userRole === "ROLE_SUPPLY_USER" 
      ? "Property & Supply Office" 
      : "Department Planning Office"
  );

  // Multi-tier Breadcrumbs Parser
  const currentPath = location.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  const breadcrumbSection = currentPath[0]?.toUpperCase() || "WORKSPACE";
  const breadcrumbPage = currentPath[1] 
    ? currentPath[1].replace(/-/g, " ").toUpperCase() 
    : "DASHBOARD";
  const breadcrumbSubpage = currentPath[2]
    ? currentPath[2].replace(/-/g, " ").toUpperCase()
    : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userRole === "ROLE_DEPT_USER") {
      const authToken = user?.token || localStorage.getItem("access_token") || "";

      fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/budget-summary`, {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${authToken}` }
      })
      .then(res => res.ok ? res.json() : null)
      .then(data => data && setHeadroom(data))
      .catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [userRole, user?.token, activeCycle]);

  const handleLogout = () => {
    if (logoutSession) logoutSession();
    navigate("/login");
  };

  const executeGlobalSearch = () => {
    if (!globalSearch.trim()) return;
    const q = encodeURIComponent(globalSearch.trim());
    if (userRole === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN") {
      navigate(`/admin/queue?search=${q}`);
    } else if (userRole === "ROLE_DEPT_USER") {
      navigate(`/dept/proposals?search=${q}`);
    } else {
      navigate(`/supply/inventory?search=${q}`);
    }
    setGlobalSearch("");
  };

  const handleSearchKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      executeGlobalSearch();
    }
  };

  const navClass = ({ isActive }) => 
    `group flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all duration-150 select-none ${
      isActive 
        ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs font-bold dark:bg-blue-600 dark:text-white" 
        : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-[#e4edf7] dark:hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-slate-100"
    }`;

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen bg-[#edf3fa] dark:bg-[#0b1329] overflow-hidden text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 font-sans antialiased transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* SIDEBAR NAVIGATION */}
      <aside className="w-64 bg-[#f8fafc] dark:bg-slate-900 border-r border-[#cbd8e6] dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col justify-between select-none z-20 shrink-0 shadow-xs print-hide">
        <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1 p-4 space-y-5 custom-scrollbar">
          
          {/* Institutional Brand Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-1 py-1">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 p-1 flex items-center justify-center border border-[#cbd8e6] dark:border-slate-700 shadow-xs shrink-0 overflow-hidden">
              {agencyLogoUrl ? (
                <img 
                  src={agencyLogoUrl} 
                  alt={agencyName} 
                  className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                  onError={(e) => { e.target.style.display = 'none'; }}
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="w-full h-full rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-indigo-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="truncate">
              <h1 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight truncate">e-ISSP Compliance</h1>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono uppercase truncate">{agencyName}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* User Profile Mini-Badge */}
          <div className="p-3 bg-[#e8f0f8] dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-[#cbd8e6] dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-600/10 dark:bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs shrink-0 font-mono">
              {userEmail.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
            </div>
            <div className="truncate flex-1">
              <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white block truncate">
                {userEmail.split("@")[0].replace(".", " ").toUpperCase()}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block truncate font-mono">
                {deptName}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Navigation Links */}
          <nav className="space-y-4">
            {userRole === "ROLE_MIS_ADMIN" && (
              <>
                {/* Section 1: Overview & Reviews */}
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => toggleSection("dashboards")}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <span>Overview &amp; Reviews</span>
                    {openSections.dashboards ? <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />}
                  </button>
                  {openSections.dashboards && (
                    <div className="space-y-0.5 pt-0.5">
                      <NavLink to="/admin/dashboard" end className={navClass}>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <LayoutDashboard className="w-4 h-4 opacity-75" />
                          <span>Executive Dashboard</span>
                        </div>
                      </NavLink>
                      <NavLink to="/admin/queue" className={navClass}>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          <FolderKanban className="w-4 h-4 opacity-75" />
                          <span>Proposals Queue</span>
                        </div>
                        {actionCount > 0 && (
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-amber-500 text-white rounded text-[9px] font-bold font-mono">

                          </span>

                      </NavLink>

                <div className="space-y-1">

// frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from "react";

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

/**
 * Safe Base64-URL decoding utility.
 * Handles URL-safe character conversions (- to +, _ to /), proper padding,
 * and multi-byte UTF-8 string encoding to prevent window.atob exceptions.
 */
const safeDecodeJWT = (token) => {
  if (!token || typeof token !== "string") return null;
  try {
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;

    const base64Url = parts[1];
    const base64 = base64Url.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
    const paddedBase64 = base64.padEnd(base64.length + (4 - (base64.length % 4)) % 4, '=');

    const jsonPayload = decodeURIComponent(
      window.atob(paddedBase64)
        .split('')
        .map((c) => '%' + ('00' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).slice(-2))
        .join('')
    );
    return JSON.parse(jsonPayload);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("JWT Decoding Failure:", error);
    return null;
  }
};

/**
 * Targeted Storage Cleanup.
 * Wipes only authentication-specific keys, avoiding destruction of unrelated
 * storage keys like UI theme preferences or table sorting states.
 */
const clearAuthSession = () => {
  localStorage.removeItem("access_token");
  localStorage.removeItem("user_role");
  localStorage.removeItem("department_id");
  localStorage.removeItem("user_email");
};

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Synchronizes and restores existing session credentials on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem("access_token");
      const storedRole = localStorage.getItem("user_role");
      const storedDeptId = localStorage.getItem("department_id");
      const storedEmail = localStorage.getItem("user_email");

      if (token) {
        const payload = safeDecodeJWT(token);

        if (payload) {
          // Hydration Deadlock & Clock Skew Guard:
          // Uses a 60-second grace window to absorb system clock drift.
          const isExpired = payload.exp ? (((payload.exp * 1000) - 60000) <= Date.now()) : false;

          if (!isExpired) {
            const resolvedRole = payload.role || storedRole || "ROLE_DEPT_USER";
            const resolvedEmail = payload.sub || storedEmail || "";
            const rawDept = payload.dept_id !== undefined ? payload.dept_id : storedDeptId;
            const resolvedDeptId = rawDept !== null && rawDept !== undefined && rawDept !== "null"
              ? parseInt(rawDept, 10) 
              : null;

            setUser({
              token,
              email: resolvedEmail,
              role: resolvedRole,
              department_id: resolvedDeptId
            });
          } else {
            console.warn("Hydration pre-flight notice: Access token has expired. Clearing session.");
            clearAuthSession();
            setUser(null);
          }
        } else {
          console.error("Malformed authentication token encountered. Purging session.");
          clearAuthSession();
          setUser(null);
        }
      } else {
        setUser(null);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to restore previous authentication session:", e);
      clearAuthSession();
      setUser(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  /**
   * Atomically commits user credentials and claims to both state and localStorage.
   * Automatically decodes the JWT token to extract the user's email (`sub`) if not explicitly supplied.
   *
   * @param {string} token - Bearer JWT access token
   * @param {string} role - Authorization role tag (e.g., ROLE_MIS_ADMIN, ROLE_DEPT_USER, ROLE_SUPPLY_USER)
   * @param {number|string|null} departmentId - Assigned institutional unit ID
   * @param {string|null} email - Optional explicit email override
   */
  const loginSession = (token, role, departmentId, email = null) => {
    const payload = safeDecodeJWT(token);
    const resolvedEmail = email || payload?.sub || "";
    const resolvedRole = role || payload?.role || "ROLE_DEPT_USER";
    const rawDept = departmentId !== undefined && departmentId !== null ? departmentId : payload?.dept_id;
    const resolvedDeptId = rawDept !== null && rawDept !== undefined && rawDept !== "null"
      ? parseInt(rawDept, 10)
      : null;

    localStorage.setItem("access_token", token);
    localStorage.setItem("user_role", resolvedRole);

    if (resolvedEmail) {
      localStorage.setItem("user_email", resolvedEmail);
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem("user_email");
    }

    if (resolvedDeptId !== null && !isNaN(resolvedDeptId)) {
      localStorage.setItem("department_id", String(resolvedDeptId));
    } else {
      localStorage.removeItem("department_id");
    }

    setUser({
      token,
      email: resolvedEmail,
      role: resolvedRole,
      department_id: resolvedDeptId
    });
  };

  /**
   * Dynamically updates user metadata in context and localStorage without requiring a full re-login.
   *
   * @param {Object} updates - Object containing fields to update (e.g., { email, role, department_id })
   */
  const updateUser = (updates) => {
    setUser((prev) => {
      if (!prev) return null;
      const next = { ...prev, ...updates };

      if (updates.role) localStorage.setItem("user_role", updates.role);
      if (updates.email) localStorage.setItem("user_email", updates.email);
      if (updates.department_id !== undefined) {
        if (updates.department_id !== null && !isNaN(updates.department_id)) {
          localStorage.setItem("department_id", String(updates.department_id));
        } else {
          localStorage.removeItem("department_id");
        }
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  /**
   * Atomically clears all active session parameters to prevent authorization leaks.
   */
  const logoutSession = () => {
    clearAuthSession();
    setUser(null);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, loginSession, logoutSession, updateUser }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useAuth must be consumed within an AuthProvider boundary.");
  }
  return context;
};

// frontend/src/context/CycleContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { API_BASE_URL } from '../api/apiClient';

const CycleContext = createContext(null);

export function CycleProvider({ children }) {
  const [activeCycle, setActiveCycleState] = useState("2026-2028");
  const [planningYears, setPlanningYears] = useState([2026, 2027, 2028]);
  const [fromYear, setFromYear] = useState(2026);
  const [toYear, setToYear] = useState(2028);

  const [agencyName, setAgencyName] = useState(
    import.meta.env?.VITE_DEFAULT_AGENCY_NAME || 
    import.meta.env?.VITE_AGENCY_NAME || 
    "National Government Agency"
  );
  const [agencyHeadPosition, setAgencyHeadPosition] = useState(
    import.meta.env?.VITE_DEFAULT_AGENCY_HEAD_TITLE || "Head of Agency"
  );
  const [agencyLogoUrl, setAgencyLogoUrl] = useState(null);
  const [dictLogoUrl, setDictLogoUrl] = useState(null);
  const [bagongPilipinasLogoUrl, setBagongPilipinasLogoUrl] = useState(null);
  const [cycleLoading, setCycleLoading] = useState(true);

  /**
   * Computes an arbitrary sequence of fiscal years for any horizon span (1 to N years).
   * Supports:
   * - 1-Year Annual Update (e.g., "2028" -> [2028])
   * - 2-Year Amendment (e.g., "2028-2029" -> [2028, 2029])
   * - Standard 3-Year Cycle (e.g., "2026-2028" -> [2026, 2027, 2028])
   * - 5-Year Strategic Horizon (e.g., "2028-2032" -> [2028, 2029, 2030, 2031, 2032])
   */
  const computeYearsFromPeriod = (period, startHint = null, endHint = null) => {
    if (!period) return { start: 2026, end: 2028, years: [2026, 2027, 2028] };

    const parts = String(period).trim().split("-");
    let start = startHint !== null && startHint !== undefined ? parseInt(startHint, 10) : parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    let end = endHint !== null && endHint !== undefined 
      ? parseInt(endHint, 10) 
      : (parts.length > 1 ? parseInt(parts[1], 10) : start);

    if (isNaN(start)) start = 2026;
    if (isNaN(end)) end = start;

    if (start > end) {
      const temp = start;
      start = end;
      end = temp;
    }

    const years = [];
    for (let y = start; y <= end; y++) {
      years.push(y);
    }

    return { start, end, years };
  };

  /**
   * Dynamically sets the active cycle and recalculates the planning years sequence.
   */
  const setActiveCycle = useCallback((period, customFrom = null, customTo = null) => {
    setActiveCycleState(period);
    const { start, end, years } = computeYearsFromPeriod(period, customFrom, customTo);
    setFromYear(start);
    setToYear(end);
    setPlanningYears(years);
  }, []);

  /**
   * Updates agency co-branding and seals, clearing values if null.
   */
  const setAgencyBranding = useCallback((branding) => {
    if (!branding) return;
    if (branding.agency_name) setAgencyName(branding.agency_name);
    if (branding.agency_head_position) setAgencyHeadPosition(branding.agency_head_position);
    if (branding.agency_logo_url !== undefined) setAgencyLogoUrl(branding.agency_logo_url || null);
    if (branding.dict_logo_url !== undefined) setDictLogoUrl(branding.dict_logo_url || null);
    if (branding.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url !== undefined) setBagongPilipinasLogoUrl(branding.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url || null);
  }, []);

  /**
   * Fetches active cycle metadata, statutory period bounds, and agency seals from the backend.
   */
  const fetchActiveCycle = useCallback(async () => {
    setCycleLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/auth/active-cycle`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.issp_period) {
          setActiveCycleState(data.issp_period);
          const { start, end, years } = computeYearsFromPeriod(
            data.issp_period,
            data.from_year,
            data.to_year
          );
          setFromYear(start);
          setToYear(end);
          setPlanningYears(years);
        }
        if (data.agency_name) {
          setAgencyName(data.agency_name);
        }
        if (data.agency_head_position) {
          setAgencyHeadPosition(data.agency_head_position);
        }
        setAgencyLogoUrl(data.agency_logo_url || null);
        setDictLogoUrl(data.dict_logo_url || null);
        setBagongPilipinasLogoUrl(data.bagong_pilipinas_logo_url || null);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to load active cycle and agency branding:", e);
    } finally {
      setCycleLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchActiveCycle();
  }, [fetchActiveCycle]);

  const cycleSpan = planningYears.length;

  return (
    <CycleContext.Provider
      value={{
        activeCycle,
        setActiveCycle,
        planningYears,
        setPlanningYears,
        fromYear,
        toYear,
        startYear: fromYear,
        endYear: toYear,
        cycleSpan,
        cycleLoading,
        agencyName,
        setAgencyName,
        agencyHeadPosition,
        setAgencyHeadPosition,
        agencyLogoUrl,
        dictLogoUrl,
        bagongPilipinasLogoUrl,
        setAgencyBranding,
        fetchActiveCycle,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </CycleContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useCycle = () => {
  const context = useContext(CycleContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useCycle must be consumed within a CycleProvider boundary.");
  }
  return context;
};

// frontend/src/context/NotificationContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from './AuthContext';
import { API_BASE_URL } from '../api/apiClient';

const NotificationContext = createContext(null);

export function NotificationProvider({ children }) {
  const { user, token } = useAuth();
  
  // Badge Counters
  const [actionCount, setActionCount] = useState(0);
  const [returnedCount, setReturnedCount] = useState(0);
  const [pendingProposalsCount, setPendingProposalsCount] = useState(0);
  const [pendingSystemsCount, setPendingSystemsCount] = useState(0);

  // Notification Feeds
  const [recentNotifications, setRecentNotifications] = useState([]);
  const [recentRemarks, setRecentRemarks] = useState([]);
  const [readNotificationIds, setReadNotificationIds] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = sessionStorage.getItem('read_notif_ids');
      return saved ? new Set(JSON.parse(saved)) : new Set();
    } catch {
      return new Set();
    }
  });

  // Transient Toast State
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Resolve Active Authentication Token & Role strictly from active authenticated session
  const authToken = user?.token || token || null;
  const userRole = user?.role 
    ? String(user.role).toUpperCase() 
    : (user?.role_tag ? String(user.role_tag).toUpperCase() : null);
  const departmentId = user?.department_id ?? null;

  // Reset counters and feeds when user logs out
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) {
      setActionCount(0);
      setReturnedCount(0);
      setPendingProposalsCount(0);
      setPendingSystemsCount(0);
      setRecentNotifications([]);
      setRecentRemarks([]);
    }
  }, [user]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // TOAST MANAGEMENT HELPERS
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const removeToast = useCallback((id) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const addToast = useCallback(({ message, type = 'info', duration = 4000, title = null }) => {
    const id = `${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, type, duration, title }]);
    
    if (duration > 0) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        removeToast(id);
      }, duration);
    }
    return id;
  }, [removeToast]);

  const showToast = useCallback((msg, type = 'info', title = null) => {
    if (typeof msg === 'object' && msg !== null) {
      return addToast(msg);
    }
    return addToast({ message: String(msg || ''), type, title });
  }, [addToast]);

  const toast = useMemo(() => ({
    success: (msg, title) => showToast(msg, 'success', title),
    error: (msg, title) => showToast(msg, 'error', title),
    info: (msg, title) => showToast(msg, 'info', title),
    warning: (msg, title) => showToast(msg, 'warning', title),
  }), [showToast]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // NOTIFICATION READ / DISMISS HANDLERS
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const markAsRead = useCallback((id) => {
    setReadNotificationIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.add(String(id));
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem('read_notif_ids', JSON.stringify([...next]));
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage errors in restricted contexts
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const markAllAsRead = useCallback(() => {
    const allIds = [
      ...recentNotifications.map(n => String(n.id)),
      ...recentRemarks.map(r => String(r.id))
    ];
    setReadNotificationIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set([...prev, ...allIds]);
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem('read_notif_ids', JSON.stringify([...next]));
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage errors
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, [recentNotifications, recentRemarks]);

  const dismissNotification = useCallback((id) => {
    setRecentNotifications((prev) => prev.filter((n) => String(n.id) !== String(id)));
    setRecentRemarks((prev) => prev.filter((r) => String(r.id) !== String(id)));
    markAsRead(id);
  }, [markAsRead]);

  const clearNotifications = useCallback(() => {
    setRecentNotifications([]);
    setRecentRemarks([]);
  }, []);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // FETCH NOTIFICATIONS PIPELINE
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    // Abort if unauthenticated, role is not yet determined, or user object is null
    if (!authToken || !userRole || !user) return;
    
    setLoading(true);
    const headers = { 
      Authorization: `Bearer ${authToken}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json"
    };

    try {
      if (userRole === 'ROLE_DEPT_USER') {
        // Guard against calling department endpoints if department_id is not assigned yet
        if (!departmentId) {
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        // 1. Department Action Items Summary
        try {
          const summaryRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/action-items/summary`, { credentials: 'include', headers });
          if (summaryRes.ok) {
            const sData = await summaryRes.json();
            setActionCount(Number(sData.unread_actions || sData.pending_actions || 0));
            setReturnedCount(Number(sData.returned_proposals || 0));
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.debug("Department summary fetch skipped:", err);
        }

        // 2. Department Activity & Remarks Feed
        try {
          const notifRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/dept/notifications?days=14`, { credentials: 'include', headers });
          if (notifRes.ok) {
            const nData = await notifRes.json();
            const items = Array.isArray(nData) ? nData : [];
            setRecentNotifications(items.filter(i => i.type !== 'comment'));
            setRecentRemarks(items.filter(i => i.type === 'comment'));
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.debug("Department activity fetch skipped:", err);
        }

      } else if (userRole === 'ROLE_MIS_ADMIN') {
        // 1. Real-time COA Audit Trail Events
        try {
          const auditRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/audit-logs?limit=15`, { credentials: 'include', headers });
          if (auditRes.ok) {
            const aData = await auditRes.json();
            const logs = Array.isArray(aData) ? aData : [];
            
            setRecentNotifications(logs.map(l => {
              const actionText = String(l.action || 'AUDIT_LOG').replace(/_/g, ' ');
              let detailText = 'System Audit Trail Event';

              if (l.new_value && typeof l.new_value === 'object') {
                const parts = [];
                if (l.new_value.item_name) parts.push(l.new_value.item_name);
                if (l.new_value.system_name) parts.push(l.new_value.system_name);
                if (l.new_value.reason) parts.push(l.new_value.reason);
                if (parts.length > 0) {
                  detailText = parts.join(' — ');
                } else {
                  detailText = Object.entries(l.new_value)
                    .slice(0, 2)
                    .map(([k, v]) => `${k.replace(/_/g, ' ')}: ${typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : v}`)
                    .join(' | ');
                }
              }

              // Context-Aware Target Route
              let targetPath = '/admin/audit';
              const actionUpper = String(l.action || '').toUpperCase();
              const moduleUpper = String(l.module || '').toUpperCase();

              if (l.proposal_id || moduleUpper === 'PROPOSALS') {
                targetPath = '/admin/queue';
              } else if (actionUpper.includes('SYSTEM') || moduleUpper === 'SYSTEMS') {
                targetPath = '/admin/systems';
              } else if (actionUpper.includes('PROJECT') || moduleUpper === 'PROJECTS') {
                targetPath = '/admin/projects';
              } else if (actionUpper.includes('CEILING') || moduleUpper === 'BUDGET') {
                targetPath = '/admin/budget';
              } else if (actionUpper.includes('USER') || moduleUpper === 'AUTH') {
                targetPath = '/admin/users';
              }

              return {
                id: String(l.id),
                title: actionText,
                description: detailText,
                type: moduleUpper === 'AUTHENTICATION' ? 'security' : moduleUpper === 'PROPOSALS' ? 'status_change' : 'governance',
                timestamp: l.timestamp,
                ref_id: l.proposal_id || '',
                url_path: targetPath,
                is_read: readNotificationIds.has(String(l.id))
              };
            }));
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.debug("Admin audit log sync skipped:", err);
        }

        // 2. Pending Proposals Count (Part IV.A Queue)
        let pendingProps = 0;
        try {
          const propRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/proposals?status_filter=Submitted&limit=1`, { credentials: 'include', headers });
          if (propRes.ok) {
            const pData = await propRes.json();
            pendingProps = pData.total !== undefined ? Number(pData.total) : (Array.isArray(pData?.data) ? pData.data.length : (Array.isArray(pData) ? pData.length : 0));
            setPendingProposalsCount(pendingProps);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.debug("Pending proposals count skipped:", err);
        }

        // 3. Pending Information Systems Intake (Part II.C / III.D)
        let pendingSys = 0;
        try {
          const sysRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/information-systems?submission_status=Submitted`, { credentials: 'include', headers });
          if (sysRes.ok) {
            const sData = await sysRes.json();
            pendingSys = Array.isArray(sData) ? sData.length : 0;
            setPendingSystemsCount(pendingSys);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.debug("Pending systems count skipped:", err);
        }

        // Consolidated Master Admin Action Badge
        setActionCount(pendingProps + pendingSys);

      } else if (userRole === 'ROLE_SUPPLY_USER') {
        // Supply User Flow: Monitor approved items requiring canvas verification
        try {
          const canvasRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/admin/proposals/approved-canvas`, { credentials: 'include', headers });
          if (canvasRes.ok) {
            const cData = await canvasRes.json();
            const items = Array.isArray(cData) ? cData : [];
            setActionCount(items.length);
          } else {
            setActionCount(0);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.debug("Supply verification sync skipped:", err);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("Notification sync pipeline warning:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [authToken, userRole, user, departmentId, readNotificationIds]);

  // Periodic Polling (Every 30 Seconds)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (authToken && userRole) {
      fetchNotifications();
      const interval = setInterval(fetchNotifications, 30000);
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, [fetchNotifications, authToken, userRole]);

  // Calculate Unread Notifications
  const unreadCount = useMemo(() => {
    return recentNotifications.filter(n => !readNotificationIds.has(String(n.id))).length;
  }, [recentNotifications, readNotificationIds]);

  return (
    <NotificationContext.Provider
      value={{
        actionCount,
        returnedCount,
        pendingProposalsCount,
        pendingSystemsCount,
        recentNotifications,
        recentRemarks,
        unreadCount,
        readNotificationIds,
        loading,
        fetchNotifications,
        markAsRead,
        markAllAsRead,
        dismissNotification,
        clearNotifications,
        toasts,
        showToast,
        toast,
        addToast,
        removeToast
      }}
    >
      {children}

      {/* Floating System Toast Container */}
      {toasts.length > 0 && (
        <aside 
          aria-label="System Notifications"
          className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-sm w-full pointer-events-none transition-all"
        >
          {toasts.map((t) => {
            const isSuccess = t.type === 'success';
            const isError = t.type === 'error';
            const isWarning = t.type === 'warning';

            return (
              <div
                key={t.id}
                role="status"
                aria-live="polite"
                className={`pointer-events-auto flex items-start gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-lg border backdrop-blur-md text-xs transition-all duration-300 animate-slideUp ${
                  isSuccess
                    ? 'bg-emerald-50/95 dark:bg-emerald-950/90 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-100'
                    : isError
                    ? 'bg-rose-50/95 dark:bg-rose-950/90 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-100'
                    : isWarning
                    ? 'bg-amber-50/95 dark:bg-amber-950/90 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-100'
                    : 'bg-blue-50/95 dark:bg-blue-950/90 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                  {isSuccess && (
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                  {isError && (
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                  {isWarning && (
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                  {!isSuccess && !isError && !isWarning && (
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="flex-1 space-y-0.5">
                  {t.title && <div className="font-bold tracking-tight">{t.title}</div>}
                  <div className="leading-relaxed opacity-90">{t.message}</div>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => removeToast(t.id)}
                  className="shrink-0 p-1 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                  aria-label="Close notification"
                >
                  <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </aside>
      )}
    </NotificationContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useNotifications = () => {
  const context = useContext(NotificationContext);
  if (!context) {
    return { 
      actionCount: 0, 
      returnedCount: 0, 
      pendingProposalsCount: 0,
      pendingSystemsCount: 0,
      recentNotifications: [], 
      recentRemarks: [], 
      unreadCount: 0,
      readNotificationIds: new Set(),
      loading: false, 
      fetchNotifications: async () => {},
      markAsRead: () => {},
      markAllAsRead: () => {},
      dismissNotification: () => {},
      clearNotifications: () => {},
      toasts: [],
      showToast: () => {},
      toast: {
        success: () => {},
        error: () => {},
        info: () => {},
        warning: () => {},
      },
      addToast: () => {},
      removeToast: () => {},
    };
  }
  return context;
};

// frontend/src/context/ThemeContext.jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from "react";

const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  // Safe initialization with localStorage or dark mode default fallback
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("theme");
      if (savedTheme === "light" || savedTheme === "dark") {
        return savedTheme;
      }
      // Standard preference check, default to dark to match the CSPC academic layout
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
      return prefersDark ? "dark" : "dark"; 
    } catch (e) {
      return "dark";
    }
  });

  // Automatically apply the target theme class to the document root element
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const root = window.document.documentElement;
      if (theme === "dark") {
        root.classList.add("dark");
        root.style.colorScheme = "dark";
      } else {
        root.classList.remove("dark");
        root.style.colorScheme = "light";
      }
      localStorage.setItem("theme", theme);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Failed to persist theme state to storage:", e);
    }
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme((prevTheme) => (prevTheme === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"));
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme, toggleTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useTheme must be consumed within a ThemeProvider boundary.");
  }
  return context;
}
