// frontend/src/views/admin/Analytics/ComplianceAnalytics.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { 
  BarChart2, 
  AlertCircle,
  AlertTriangle, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  ShieldAlert, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Search, 
  Building, 
  FileWarning, 
  ArrowUpRight,
  Info,
  X,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  CheckCircle2,
  FileCheck
} from "lucide-react";
import { getDepartmentAnalytics } from "../../../api/admin";

export default function ComplianceAnalytics() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [analytics, setAnalytics] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState(null);

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState("all"); // 'all' | 'flagged' | 'compliant'
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("ratio-desc"); // 'ratio-desc' | 'canvas-desc' | 'proposals-desc' | 'name-asc'

  const token = 
    user?.token || 
    user?.accessToken || 
    (typeof window !== "undefined" 
      ? localStorage.getItem("access_token") || localStorage.getItem("token") 
      : "") || 
    "";

  const fetchAnalytics = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!token) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getDepartmentAnalytics(token);
      setAnalytics(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
      setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" }));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Network error fetching compliance metrics.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [token]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchAnalytics();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle, fetchAnalytics]);

  // Aggregate Metrics Calculations
  const totalDepts = analytics.length;
  const flaggedDepts = analytics.filter(d => d.requires_review_abuse).length;
  const compliantDepts = totalDepts - flaggedDepts;
  const totalProposals = analytics.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.total_proposals || 0), 0);
  const totalCustomProposals = analytics.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.custom_proposals || 0), 0);
  const totalMissingCanvases = analytics.reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.missing_canvas_count || 0), 0);
  const overallCatalogAdoption = totalProposals > 0 
    ? (((totalProposals - totalCustomProposals) / totalProposals) * 100).toFixed(1)
    : "100.0";

  // Filter and Sort Pipeline
  const filteredAndSortedAnalytics = useMemo(() => {
    return analytics
      .filter(dept => {
        if (filterStatus === "flagged" && !dept.requires_review_abuse) return false;
        if (filterStatus === "compliant" && dept.requires_review_abuse) return false;

        if (searchQuery.trim()) {
          const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
          const name = (dept.department_name || "").toLowerCase();
          const idStr = String(dept.department_id || "");
          return name.includes(q) || idStr.includes(q);
        }
        return true;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortBy === "ratio-desc") {
          return (b.custom_ratio_percent || 0) - (a.custom_ratio_percent || 0);
        }
        if (sortBy === "canvas-desc") {
          return (b.missing_canvas_count || 0) - (a.missing_canvas_count || 0);
        }
        if (sortBy === "proposals-desc") {
          return (b.total_proposals || 0) - (a.total_proposals || 0);
        }
        if (sortBy === "name-asc") {
          return (a.department_name || "").localeCompare(b.department_name || "");
        }
        return 0;
      });
  }, [analytics, filterStatus, searchQuery, sortBy]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 select-none max-w-7xl mx-auto font-sans pb-12 transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* Top Banner Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <BarChart2 className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 w-5 h-5" />
              <span>Compliance Analytics &amp; Specification Abuse Index</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/20 font-mono">
              Cycle: FY {activeCycle || "2026-2028"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
            Statutory monitoring of non-standard procurement. Flags offices exceeding the <strong>20.0%</strong> limit for custom requests or lacking quotation proofs.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 self-stretch sm:self-auto justify-between sm:justify-end">
          {lastSyncTime && (
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono hidden md:inline-block">
              Synced: {lastSyncTime}
            </span>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={fetchAnalytics}
            disabled={loading}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold shadow-xs cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" : ""}`} />
            <span>{loading ? "Auditing..." : "Sync Diagnostics"}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dismissible Error Alert */}
      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 rounded-xl flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5 shadow-xs animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <span className="font-bold">Diagnostics Error</span>
              <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">{error}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button 
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setError(null)} 
            className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer p-1"
            title="Dismiss Alert"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Aggregate Metric Tiles */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-xl shrink-0">
            <Building className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Monitored Offices</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-0.5">
              {totalDepts} Divisions
            </h3>
            <span className="text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono mt-0.5 block">
              {totalProposals} Total Proposals
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-xl shrink-0">

                    <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                    <span>Catalog Compliant</span>
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Statistical KPI Row */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 pt-3.5 font-mono text-center">
                <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold">Total Items</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-xs">{total}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold">Standard</span>
                  <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold text-xs">{catalogCount}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold">Custom</span>
                  <span className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-xs">{custom}</span>
                </div>

                <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <span className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block uppercase font-bold">Custom %</span>
                  <span className={`font-bold text-xs ${hasAbuse ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"}`}>
                    {dept.custom_ratio_percent}%
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Ratio Progress Bar */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px]">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 font-sans">
                    <span>Non-Catalog Item Index:</span>
                    <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-mono">{customRatio}%</strong>
                  </span>
                  <span className={`font-mono font-bold ${hasAbuse ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"}`}>
                    {hasAbuse ? "Threshold Breached (>20.0%)" : "Within Allowable Limit"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden relative">
                  <div 
                    className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${
                      hasAbuse ? "bg-rose-500" : "bg-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500"
                    }`} 
                    style={{ width: `${Math.min(customRatio, 100)}%` }} 
                  />
                  {/* Visual limit marker at 20% */}
                  <div 
                    className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-slate-400/80 dark:bg-slate-500 z-10" 
                    style={{ left: "20%" }} 
                    title="20% Statutory Specification Limit" 
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Audit Proof Tag & Navigation Footer */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-2 text-[10.5px]">
                <div>
                  {missingCanvas > 0 ? (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-900/60 font-mono font-bold text-[10px]">
                      <FileWarning className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                      <span>{missingCanvas} item(s) lacking quotation proof</span>
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono text-[10px]">
                      <FileCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                      <span>All quotes attached</span>
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/admin/queue?dept_id=${dept.department_id}`)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-500 dark:hover:text-blue-300 font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                >
                  <span>Inspect Office Proposals</span>
                  <ArrowUpRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

CORE SYSTEM FILE: ./frontend/src/views/admin/Audit/AuditTrails.jsx

// frontend/src/views/admin/Audit/AuditTrails.jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "../../../context/AuthContext";
import { useCycle } from "../../../context/CycleContext";
import { getAuditLogs, getDepartments } from "../../../api/admin";
import { 
  History, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertCircle, 
  CheckCircle,
  Search, 
  ArrowRight, 
  Shield, 
  Filter, 
  Calendar, 
  Eye, 
  User, 
  X, 
  Clock, 
  Layers, 
  Globe, 
  Lock, 
  Coins, 
  ChevronLeft, 
  ChevronRight, 
  Download
} from "lucide-react";

export default function AuditTrails() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { activeCycle } = useCycle();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(null);

  // Search & Filter States
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [selectedModule, setSelectedModule] = useState("All");
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("All");
  const [dateSpan, setDateSpan] = useState("All");
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState("");
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState("");

  // Pagination State
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [itemsPerPage, setItemsPerPage] = useState(15);

  // Detailed Modal Inspection State
  const [selectedLog, setSelectedLog] = useState(null);

  const token = 
    user?.token || 
    user?.accessToken || 
    (typeof window !== "undefined" 
      ? localStorage.getItem("access_token") || localStorage.getItem("token") 
      : "") || 
    "";

  // Auto-dismiss transient notifications
  useEffect(() => {
    if (success) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setSuccess(null), 4000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [success]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (error) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setError(null), 7000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [error]);

  // Keyboard navigation for inspection modal
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && selectedLog) {
        setSelectedLog(null);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [selectedLog]);

  const fetchDepartmentsList = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!token) return;
    try {
      const data = await getDepartments(token);
      setDepartments(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not load departments dictionary for audit view:", e);
    }
  }, [token]);

  const fetchLogs = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!token) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await getAuditLogs(token, { limit: 1000 });
      setLogs(Array.isArray(data) ? data : []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Network error loading audit logs.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [token]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token) {
      fetchLogs();
      fetchDepartmentsList();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle, fetchLogs, fetchDepartmentsList]);

  const getDepartmentName = useCallback((deptId) => {
    if (!deptId) return null;
    const d = departments.find(dept => (dept.department_id || dept.id) === deptId);
    return d ? (d.department_name || d.name) : `Department ID: ${deptId}`;
  }, [departments]);

  // Context-Aware Routing for Deep Linking
  const handleDeepLinkRedirect = (log) => {
    setSelectedLog(null);
    const targetId = log.proposal_id;
    const mod = (log.module || "").toUpperCase();
    const act = (log.action || "").toUpperCase();

    if (targetId) {
      navigate("/admin/queue", { 
        state: { 
          highlightId: targetId
        } 
      });
      return;
    }

    if (mod === "SYSTEMS" || act.includes("SYSTEM")) {
      navigate("/admin/systems");
      return;
    }

    if (mod === "PROJECTS" || act.includes("PROJECT")) {
      navigate("/admin/projects/internal");
      return;
    }

    if (mod === "INVENTORY" || act.includes("INVENTORY") || act.includes("IIRUP")) {
      navigate("/supply/inventory");
      return;
    }

    if (mod === "AUTHENTICATION" || act.includes("USER") || act.includes("LOGIN")) {
      navigate("/admin/users");
      return;
    }

    if (mod === "GOVERNANCE" && (act.includes("CEILING") || act.includes("BUDGET"))) {
      navigate("/admin/budget");
      return;
    }

    if (mod === "GOVERNANCE" && (act.includes("OUTCOME") || act.includes("CONCERN"))) {
      navigate("/admin/outcomes");
      return;
    }
  };

  // Maps all official modules to high-contrast badges
  const getModuleBadge = (moduleName) => {
    const mod = (moduleName || "GOVERNANCE").toUpperCase();
    switch (mod) {
      case "AUTHENTICATION":
        return {
          label: "Authentication",
          style: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/20"
        };
      case "PROPOSALS":
        return {
          label: "Resource Outlays",
          style: "bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-500/10 dark:text-purple-300 dark:border-purple-500/20"
        };
      case "SYSTEMS":
        return {
          label: "Information Systems",
          style: "bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border-teal-200 dark:bg-teal-500/10 dark:text-teal-300 dark:border-teal-500/20"
        };
      case "PROJECTS":
        return {
          label: "ICT Projects",
          style: "bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-500/20"
        };
      case "INVENTORY":
        return {
          label: "Annex 1 Inventory",
          style: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/20"
        };
      case "GOVERNANCE":
      default:
        return {
          label: "ISSP Governance",
          style: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20"
        };
    }
  };

  // Macro Metrics Calculations
  const totalLogs = logs.length;
  const authCount = logs.filter(l => (l.module || "").toUpperCase() === "AUTHENTICATION" || (l.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("LOGIN") || (l.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("USER")).length;
  const proposalCount = logs.filter(l => (l.module || "").toUpperCase() === "PROPOSALS" || (l.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("PROPOSAL") || (l.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("STATE")).length;
  const governanceCount = logs.filter(l => (l.module || "").toUpperCase() === "GOVERNANCE" || (l.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("BUDGET") || (l.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("CYCLE") || (l.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("CEILING")).length;

  // Filter Pipeline
  const filteredLogs = useMemo(() => {
    return logs.filter(log => {
      const query = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
      const action = (log.action || "").toLowerCase();
      const operator = (log.operator_email || "").toLowerCase();
      const targetId = String(log.proposal_id || "").toLowerCase();
      const ip = String(log.ip_address || "").toLowerCase();
      const moduleStr = String(log.module || "").toLowerCase();
      const deptName = String(getDepartmentName(log.department_id) || "").toLowerCase();

      const matchesSearch = query === "" || 
        action.includes(query) || 
        operator.includes(query) || 
        targetId.includes(query) ||
        ip.includes(query) ||
        moduleStr.includes(query) ||
        deptName.includes(query) ||
        String(log.id).includes(query);

      let matchesModule = true;
      if (selectedModule !== "All") {
        matchesModule = (log.module || "GOVERNANCE").toUpperCase() === selectedModule.toUpperCase();
      }

      let matchesCategory = true;
      if (selectedCategory !== "All") {
        const catLower = selectedCategory.toLowerCase();
        const actionLower = (log.action || "").toLowerCase();
        const moduleUpper = (log.module || "").toUpperCase();

        if (catLower === "budget") {
          matchesCategory = actionLower.includes("budget") || actionLower.includes("ceiling");
        } else if (catLower === "state") {
          matchesCategory = actionLower.includes("state") || actionLower.includes("submit") || actionLower.includes("approve") || actionLower.includes("return");
        } else if (catLower === "override") {
          matchesCategory = actionLower.includes("override");
        } else if (catLower === "user") {
          matchesCategory = actionLower.includes("user") || actionLower.includes("login") || moduleUpper === "AUTHENTICATION";
        } else if (catLower === "inventory") {
          matchesCategory = moduleUpper === "INVENTORY" || actionLower.includes("inventory");
        } else if (catLower === "system") {
          matchesCategory = moduleUpper === "SYSTEMS" || actionLower.includes("system");
        }
      }

      let matchesDate = true;
      if (dateSpan !== "All") {
        const logDate = new Date(log.timestamp);
        const boundaryDate = new Date();
        if (dateSpan === "Today") {
          boundaryDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          matchesDate = logDate >= boundaryDate;
        } else if (dateSpan === "Week") {
          boundaryDate.setDate(boundaryDate.getDate() - 7);
          boundaryDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          matchesDate = logDate >= boundaryDate;
        } else if (dateSpan === "Month") {
          boundaryDate.setMonth(boundaryDate.getMonth() - 1);
          boundaryDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          matchesDate = logDate >= boundaryDate;
        } else if (dateSpan === "Custom") {
          const start = startDate ? new Date(startDate) : null;
          const end = endDate ? new Date(endDate) : null;
          if (start) {
            start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
            matchesDate = matchesDate && logDate >= start;
          }
          if (end) {
            end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
            matchesDate = matchesDate && logDate <= end;
          }
        }
      }

      return matchesSearch && matchesModule && matchesCategory && matchesDate;
    });
  }, [logs, searchTerm, selectedModule, selectedCategory, dateSpan, startDate, endDate, getDepartmentName]);

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredLogs.length / itemsPerPage) || 1;
  const safeCurrentPage = Math.min(currentPage, totalPages) || 1;
  const startIndex = (safeCurrentPage - 1) * itemsPerPage;
  const endIndex = Math.min(startIndex + itemsPerPage, filteredLogs.length);
  const paginatedLogs = filteredLogs.slice(startIndex, endIndex);

  // Reliable Blob-based COA Compliance CSV Exporter
  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    if (!filteredLogs.length) return;
    try {
      const headers = [
        "Log ID", 
        "Timestamp UTC", 
        "Functional Module", 
        "Action Identifier", 
        "Operator Email", 
        "Operator Role", 
        "Client IP Address", 
        "Department", 
        "Target Entity UUID", 
        "Previous State", 
        "Updated State"
      ];

      const rows = filteredLogs.map(l => {
        const timeIso = l.timestamp ? new Date(l.timestamp).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString();
        return [
          l.id,
          timeIso,
          l.module || "GOVERNANCE",
          l.action,
          l.operator_email || "System/Cron",
          l.operator_role || "SYSTEM",
          l.ip_address || "127.0.0.1",
          getDepartmentName(l.department_id) || "Universal / Central Office",
          l.proposal_id || "SYSTEM_ENVIRONMENT",
          JSON.stringify(l.old_value || {}).replace(/"/g, '""'),
          JSON.stringify(l.new_value || {}).replace(/"/g, '""')
        ];
      });

      const csvContent = [
        headers.join(","),
        ...rows.map(r => r.map(f => `"${f}"`).join(","))
      ].join("\n");

      const blob = new Blob(["\uFEFF" + csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement("a");
      link.href = url;
      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      link.setAttribute("download", `COA_Audit_Security_Ledger_${activeCycle || "Cycle"}_${dateStr}.csv`);
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      document.body.removeChild(link);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

      setSuccess("COA security ledger exported successfully to CSV.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(`Failed to export CSV: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const renderPayload = (payload, isOld = false) => {
    if (!payload || (typeof payload === "object" && Object.keys(payload).length === 0)) {
      return <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic font-mono text-[10px]">No parameters recorded</span>;
    }
    if (typeof payload === "string") {
      return <span className="font-mono text-[10px] break-all text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{payload}</span>;
    }
    
    return (
      <div className="space-y-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto w-full">
        {Object.entries(payload).map(([key, val]) => {
          let displayVal = val;
          if (typeof val === "object" && val !== null) {
            displayVal = JSON.stringify(val);
          } else if (typeof val === "number" && (key.toLowerCase().includes("cost") || key.toLowerCase().includes("ceiling") || key.toLowerCase().includes("amount"))) {
            displayVal = `₱${val.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;
          } else if (val === null || val === undefined) {
            displayVal = "null";
          }
          return (
            <div key={key} className="flex flex-col text-[10px] font-mono leading-tight">
              <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider text-[8.5px] font-bold">
                {key.replace(/_/g, " ")}:
              </span>
              <span className={`font-semibold break-all text-xs ${
                isOld 
                  ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" 
                  : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
              }`}>
                {String(displayVal)}
              </span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* Top Banner Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 gap-4 shadow-xs">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <History className="text-amber-500 w-5 h-5" />
            <span>COA Immutable Audit Security Trails &amp; Global Governance Ledger</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 text-xs">
            Tamper-proof chronological security ledger. Captures user authentications, client IP addresses, parameter overrides, budget reallocations, and inventory mutations.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            disabled={filteredLogs.length === 0}
            className="p-2.5 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer font-bold shadow-xs text-xs"
            title="Export filtered audit entries to CSV for COA compliance audits"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Export CSV</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={fetchLogs}
            disabled={loading}
            className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer font-bold shadow-xs text-xs"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            <span>Sync Ledger</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Overview Tiles */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-xl">
            <History className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Total Audit Events</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-0.5">{totalLogs} Entries</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-xl">
            <Lock className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Authentication Events</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{authCount} Logins</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 rounded-xl">
            <Layers className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Proposal Modifications</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{proposalCount} Actions</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-5 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-xl">
            <Coins className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider">Governance &amp; Ceilings</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{governanceCount} Events</h3>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-955/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 font-bold rounded-2xl flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5 shadow-xs animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
            <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">{typeof error === "object" ? (error.message || JSON.stringify(error)) : error}</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setError(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer p-1">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between gap-2.5 shadow-xs animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
            <span>{success}</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setSuccess(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer p-1">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Advanced Filter Toolbar */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 items-center justify-between">
          <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => { setSearchTerm(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
              placeholder="Search action, email, IP, module, target ID..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none placeholder-slate-400 text-xs focus:border-blue-500"
            />
            {searchTerm && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchTerm("")}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 w-full md:w-auto justify-end">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <select
                value={selectedModule}
                onChange={(e) => { setSelectedModule(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                className="p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <option value="All">All Functional Modules</option>
                <option value="AUTHENTICATION">Authentication &amp; Logins</option>
                <option value="PROPOSALS">Part IV.A Proposals</option>
                <option value="SYSTEMS">Information Systems (Parts II.C &amp; III.D)</option>
                <option value="PROJECTS">ICT Projects Portfolio (Part III.E)</option>
                <option value="INVENTORY">Annex 1 Master Inventory</option>
                <option value="GOVERNANCE">Governance &amp; Ceilings</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Filter className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <select
                value={selectedCategory}
                onChange={(e) => { setSelectedCategory(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                className="p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <option value="All">All Action Categories</option>

                <option value="inventory">Inventory Updates</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
              <select
                value={dateSpan}
                onChange={(e) => { setDateSpan(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                className="p-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                <option value="All">All Time Horizons</option>
                <option value="Today">Today Only</option>
                <option value="Week">Past 7 Days</option>
                <option value="Month">Past 30 Days</option>
                <option value="Custom">Custom Date Range</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {dateSpan === "Custom" && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 animate-fadeIn max-w-md">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Start Date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={startDate}
                onChange={e => { setStartDate(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs outline-none cursor-pointer font-mono"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">End Date</label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={endDate}
                onChange={e => { setEndDate(e.target.value); setCurrentPage(1); }}
                className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs outline-none cursor-pointer font-mono"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Ledger Table Container */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 gap-2">
              <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
              <span>Querying COA immutable security records...</span>
            </div>
          ) : paginatedLogs.length > 0 ? (
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-[11px]">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[9.5px] font-mono">
                  <th className="p-4 w-44">Timestamp &amp; Source</th>
                  <th className="p-4 w-36">Module</th>
                  <th className="p-4 w-48">Operator Identity</th>
                  <th className="p-4">Action Taken</th>
                  <th className="p-4">Target Entity</th>
                  <th className="p-4 text-right">Inspect</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-850">
                {paginatedLogs.map((log) => {
                  const badge = getModuleBadge(log.module);
                  const isSystem = !log.proposal_id;
                  const targetId = log.proposal_id || "SYSTEM_ENVIRONMENT";
                  const deptTitle = getDepartmentName(log.department_id);

                  return (
                    <tr 
                      key={log.id} 
                      onClick={() => setSelectedLog(log)}
                      className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-955/30 transition-colors group cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <td className="p-4 align-top">
                        <div className="font-mono text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-semibold">
                          {new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                          {new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}
                        </div>
                        {log.ip_address && (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9.5px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
                            <Globe className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500" />

                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td className="p-4 align-top">
                        <span className={`inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border font-mono ${badge.style}`}>
                          {badge.label}
                        </span>
                        {deptTitle && (
                          <span className="block text-[9px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 mt-1 truncate max-w-[140px]" title={deptTitle}>

                      </td>

                      <td className="p-4 align-top">

        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Pagination Bar */}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span>
              Showing <strong>{filteredLogs.length > 0 ? startIndex + 1 : 0}</strong> to <strong>{endIndex}</strong> of <strong>{filteredLogs.length}</strong> total events
            </span>

          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-1.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setCurrentPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              disabled={safeCurrentPage === 1}
              className="p-1.5 px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 shadow-2xs"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Prev

              Page {safeCurrentPage} of {totalPages}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setCurrentPage(p => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
              disabled={safeCurrentPage === totalPages || filteredLogs.length === 0}
              className="p-1.5 px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg disabled:opacity-40 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 shadow-2xs"

              Next <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

      {/* COA AUDIT RECORD INSPECTION MODAL */}

          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-2xl p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl animate-fadeIn max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">

                  <span>COA Immutable Audit Record Inspection</span>
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase">LOG ENTRY ID: #{selectedLog.id}</span>
              </div>
              <button 
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedLog(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Executed By</span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                    <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="font-bold">{selectedLog.operator_email || "System/Cron"}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Access Scope</span>
                  <span className="block font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono uppercase text-xs">
                    {selectedLog.operator_role || "SYSTEM"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Module</span>
                  <span className="block font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono text-xs">
                    {selectedLog.module || "GOVERNANCE"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Source Client IP</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono text-xs flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                    <span>{selectedLog.ip_address || "Internal Loopback"}</span>
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Department</span>
                  <span className="block font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs truncate" title={getDepartmentName(selectedLog.department_id)}>
                    {getDepartmentName(selectedLog.department_id) || "Universal / Central Office"}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Action Identifier</span>
                  <span className="block font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-mono uppercase text-xs">
                    {selectedLog.action}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider">Log Timestamp</span>
                  <span className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-mono text-xs">
                    {new Date(selectedLog.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider block font-mono">
                    Previous State Parameters
                  </span>
                  {renderPayload(selectedLog.old_value, true)}
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase font-bold tracking-wider block font-mono">
                    Updated State Parameters
                  </span>
                  {renderPayload(selectedLog.new_value, false)}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Context-Aware Deep Link Action Button */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                {selectedLog.proposal_id ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleDeepLinkRedirect(selectedLog)}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm text-xs"
                  >
                    <span>Inspect Target Proposal in Master Queue</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                ) : (selectedLog.module === "SYSTEMS" || (selectedLog.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("SYSTEM")) ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleDeepLinkRedirect(selectedLog)}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm text-xs"
                  >
                    <span>Inspect in Information Systems Register</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                ) : (selectedLog.module === "INVENTORY" || (selectedLog.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("INVENTORY")) ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleDeepLinkRedirect(selectedLog)}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm text-xs"
                  >
                    <span>Inspect in Master Asset Inventory</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                ) : (selectedLog.module === "AUTHENTICATION" || (selectedLog.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("USER")) ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleDeepLinkRedirect(selectedLog)}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm text-xs"
                  >
                    <span>Inspect in User Whitelisting &amp; Access Control</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                ) : (selectedLog.module === "GOVERNANCE" && ((selectedLog.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("CEILING") || (selectedLog.action || "").toUpperCase().includes("BUDGET"))) ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleDeepLinkRedirect(selectedLog)}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm text-xs"
                  >
                    <span>Inspect in Budget Sub-Ceilings &amp; Policy Control</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedLog(null)}
                    className="w-full py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all text-xs"
                  >
                    Close Inspection
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

  const [editUacsIsSub, setEditUacsIsSub] = useState(false);
  const [editUacsDesc, setEditUacsDesc] = useState("");

  // --- DYNAMIC POLICY THRESHOLDS STATES ---
  const [policySettings, setPolicySettings] = useState({
    capitalization_threshold: 50000.00,
    major_outlay_review_threshold: 2000000.00,
    hardware_replacement_buffer_units: 3,
    canvas_expiration_warning_days: 14
  });
  const [loadingPolicy, setLoadingPolicy] = useState(false);
  const [savingPolicy, setSavingPolicy] = useState(false);

  const token = user?.token || user?.accessToken || (typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("access_token") : "");

  // Active planning horizon years sequence (e.g. [2028, 2029, 2030])
  const activeYears = useMemo(() => {
    return (planningYears && planningYears.length > 0) ? planningYears : [2028, 2029, 2030];
  }, [planningYears]);

  const formatPHP = (val) => {
    const num = parseFloat(val) || 0;
    return "₱" + num.toLocaleString("en-PH", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  };

  const parseAnnualItem = useCallback((val) => {
    if (typeof val === "object" && val !== null) {
      return {
        capex: parseFloat(val.capex) || 0,
        mooe: parseFloat(val.mooe) || 0
      };
    }
    const num = parseFloat(val) || 0;
    return { capex: num, mooe: 0 };
  }, []);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // DATA FETCHING PIPELINE
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!token) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      // 1. Fetch Department Ceilings
      const data = await getBudgetCeilings(token, activeCycle);
      const ceilingsList = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
      setCeilings(ceilingsList);
      
      if (ceilingsList.length > 0 && ceilingsList[0].global_ceiling) {
        setGlobalCeiling(String(ceilingsList[0].global_ceiling));
        setGlobalCeilingInput(String(ceilingsList[0].global_ceiling));
      }

      // 2. Fetch Part IV.B Parity Matrix Data
      const pJson = await getParityMatrices(token, activeCycle).catch(() => null);
      if (pJson) {
        setParityData(pJson);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load budget ceiling data.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle]);

  // Fetch Dynamic Inflation Buffer Settings
  const fetchInflationSettingsData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!token) return;
    setLoadingInflation(true);
    try {
      const json = await getInflationSettings(token);
      const loadedRates = json.rates || [];
      
      // Defensively ensure every year in activeYears is represented in the list
      const existingYears = new Set(loadedRates.map(r => r.year));
      const mergedRates = [...loadedRates];
      activeYears.forEach((yr, idx) => {
        if (!existingYears.has(yr)) {
          mergedRates.push({
            year: yr,
            year_index: idx + 1,
            rate_percent: idx === 0 ? 0.0 : (idx === 1 ? 3.0 : (idx === 2 ? 5.0 : 5.0 + (idx - 2) * 2.0)),
            is_base_year: idx === 0
          });
        }
      });
      mergedRates.sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
      setInflationRates(mergedRates);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Could not load inflation settings:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingInflation(false);
    }
  }, [token, activeYears]);

  // Fetch UACS Catalog Items
  const fetchUacsCatalogData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!token) return;
    setLoadingUacs(true);
    try {
      const json = await getUacsCatalog(token);
      setUacsItems(Array.isArray(json) ? json : []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Could not load UACS catalog:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingUacs(false);
    }
  }, [token]);

  // Fetch Policy Threshold Settings
  const fetchPolicySettingsData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!token) return;
    setLoadingPolicy(true);
    try {
      const json = await getPolicySettings(token);
      setPolicySettings({
        capitalization_threshold: parseFloat(json.capitalization_threshold) || 50000.00,
        major_outlay_review_threshold: parseFloat(json.major_outlay_review_threshold) || 2000000.00,
        hardware_replacement_buffer_units: parseInt(json.hardware_replacement_buffer_units, 10) || 3,
        canvas_expiration_warning_days: parseInt(json.canvas_expiration_warning_days, 10) || 14
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Could not load policy threshold settings:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingPolicy(false);
    }
  }, [token]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (token && activeCycle) {
      fetchData();
      fetchInflationSettingsData();
      fetchUacsCatalogData();
      fetchPolicySettingsData();
    }
  }, [token, activeCycle, fetchData, fetchInflationSettingsData, fetchUacsCatalogData, fetchPolicySettingsData]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // GLOBAL CEILING & PRE-FLIGHT VALIDATION HANDLERS
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleUpdateGlobalCeiling = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        global_ceiling: parseFloat(globalCeilingInput) || 0.0
      };
      await updateGlobalBudgetCeiling(token, payload);

      setGlobalCeiling(globalCeilingInput);
      setIsEditingGlobal(false);
      setSuccess("Institutional Global Budget Ceiling updated successfully.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to update global ceiling.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const runValidationCheck = async () => {
    setValidating(true);
    setError(null);
    setValidationResult(null);
    try {
      const data = await validateBudgetPreflight(token, activeCycle);
      setValidationResult(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Pre-flight validation check failed.");
    } finally {
      setValidating(false);
    }
  };

  // DBM OSPS CSV Spreadsheet Exporter
  const handleExportCsv = async () => {
    setExportingCsv(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const blob = await exportBudgetBlob(token, activeCycle);
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `ISSP_${activeCycle}_Part_IV_A_DBM_Export.csv`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      setSuccess("DBM OSPS-compliant spreadsheet exported successfully.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to download budget spreadsheet.");
    } finally {
      setExportingCsv(false);
    }
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // DEPARTMENT SUB-CEILING CONFIGURATION MODAL HANDLERS
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const balanceAnnualAllocations = useCallback((cap, mooe, targetYears = activeYears) => {
    const span = targetYears.length || 1;
    const annualCap = Math.round((cap / span) * 100) / 100;
    const annualMooe = Math.round((mooe / span) * 100) / 100;
    const newMap = {};

    targetYears.forEach((yr, idx) => {
      if (idx === span - 1) {
        newMap[String(yr)] = {
          capex: Math.round((cap - annualCap * (span - 1)) * 100) / 100,
          mooe: Math.round((mooe - annualMooe * (span - 1)) * 100) / 100
        };
      } else {
        newMap[String(yr)] = {
          capex: annualCap,
          mooe: annualMooe
        };
      }
    });

    return newMap;
  }, [activeYears]);

  const openEditModal = (dept) => {
    setActiveDept(dept);
    const cap = Number(dept.allocated_capex || 0);
    const mooe = Number(dept.allocated_mooe || 0);
    const subCeil = Number(dept.sub_ceiling || (cap + mooe));

    setSubCeilingInput(String(subCeil));
    setCapexInput(String(cap));
    setMooeInput(String(mooe));

    // Preset determination
    if (subCeil > 0) {
      const roundCap70 = Math.round(subCeil * 0.70);
      const roundCap60 = Math.round(subCeil * 0.60);
      const roundCap50 = Math.round(subCeil * 0.50);

      if (cap === roundCap70 && mooe === subCeil - roundCap70) {
        setSplitPreset("70_30");
      } else if (cap === roundCap60 && mooe === subCeil - roundCap60) {
        setSplitPreset("60_40");
      } else if (cap === roundCap50 && mooe === subCeil - roundCap50) {
        setSplitPreset("50_50");
      } else if (cap === subCeil && mooe === 0) {
        setSplitPreset("100_0");
      } else if (cap === 0 && mooe === subCeil) {
        setSplitPreset("0_100");
      } else {
        setSplitPreset("custom");
      }
    } else {
      setSplitPreset("custom");
    }

    // Populate or initialize annual allocations for active horizon with defensive object normalization
    let initialAnnual = {};
    if (dept.annual_allocations && typeof dept.annual_allocations === "object" && Object.keys(dept.annual_allocations).length > 0) {
      activeYears.forEach(y => {
        initialAnnual[String(y)] = parseAnnualItem(dept.annual_allocations[String(y)]);
      });
    } else {
      initialAnnual = balanceAnnualAllocations(cap, mooe);
    }

    setAnnualAllocations(initialAnnual);
    setCustomAnnualMode(false);
  };

  const applyPreset = (presetKey, currentSubCeiling) => {
    setSplitPreset(presetKey);
    const total = parseFloat(currentSubCeiling) || 0;
    let cap = 0;
    let mooe = 0;

    if (presetKey === "70_30") {
      cap = Math.round(total * 0.70);
      mooe = total - cap;
    } else if (presetKey === "60_40") {
      cap = Math.round(total * 0.60);
      mooe = total - cap;
    } else if (presetKey === "50_50") {
      cap = Math.round(total * 0.50);
      mooe = total - cap;
    } else if (presetKey === "100_0") {
      cap = total;
      mooe = 0;
    } else if (presetKey === "0_100") {
      cap = 0;
      mooe = total;
    } else {
      cap = parseFloat(capexInput) || 0;
      mooe = parseFloat(mooeInput) || 0;
    }

    setCapexInput(String(cap));
    setMooeInput(String(mooe));

    if (!customAnnualMode) {
      setAnnualAllocations(balanceAnnualAllocations(cap, mooe));
    }
  };

  const handleAnnualAllocationChange = (year, field, value) => {
    const numVal = parseFloat(value) || 0;
    const currentEntry = parseAnnualItem(annualAllocations[String(year)]);
    const updated = {
      ...annualAllocations,
      [String(year)]: {
        ...currentEntry,
        [field]: numVal
      }
    };
    setAnnualAllocations(updated);

    // Sum overall CapEx and MOOE across all active planning years
    let totalCap = 0;
    let totalMooe = 0;
    activeYears.forEach(yr => {
      const entry = parseAnnualItem(updated[String(yr)]);
      totalCap += Number(entry.capex || 0);
      totalMooe += Number(entry.mooe || 0);
    });

    const roundedCap = Math.round(totalCap * 100) / 100;
    const roundedMooe = Math.round(totalMooe * 100) / 100;
    setCapexInput(String(roundedCap));
    setMooeInput(String(roundedMooe));
    setSubCeilingInput(String(Math.round((roundedCap + roundedMooe) * 100) / 100));
    setSplitPreset("custom");
  };

  const handleSaveDepartmentCeiling = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    const capexVal = parseFloat(capexInput) || 0.0;
    const mooeVal = parseFloat(mooeInput) || 0.0;
    const subCeilingVal = capexVal + mooeVal;

    // Use custom annual allocations if manually tuned, or balanced auto-split
    const finalAnnualMap = customAnnualMode ? annualAllocations : balanceAnnualAllocations(capexVal, mooeVal);

    try {
      await updateBudgetCeiling(token, {
        department_id: activeDept.department_id,
        issp_period: activeCycle,
        allocated_capex: capexVal,
        allocated_mooe: mooeVal,
        sub_ceiling: subCeilingVal,
        annual_allocations: finalAnnualMap
      });

      setSuccess(`Budget allocation updated for '${activeDept.department_name}'. (CapEx: ${formatPHP(capexVal)} | MOOE: ${formatPHP(mooeVal)})`);
      setActiveDept(null);
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to persist department sub-ceiling.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // DYNAMIC INFLATION BUFFER PRESETS & SAVE
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleInflationRateChange = (year, newPercent) => {
    setInflationRates(prev =>
      prev.map(r => r.year === year ? { ...r, rate_percent: parseFloat(newPercent) || 0 } : r)
    );
  };

  const applyInflationPreset = (preset) => {
    setInflationRates(prev =>
      prev.map((r, idx) => {
        if (idx === 0) return { ...r, rate_percent: 0.0 };
        if (preset === "dict") {
          // DICT Guidelines: 0% Y1, 3% Y2, 5% Y3, and compounding +2%/yr thereafter
          const pct = idx === 1 ? 3.0 : (idx === 2 ? 5.0 : 5.0 + (idx - 2) * 2.0);
          return { ...r, rate_percent: pct };
        }
        if (preset === "flat4") {
          return { ...r, rate_percent: idx * 4.0 };
        }
        if (preset === "zero") {
          return { ...r, rate_percent: 0.0 };
        }
        return r;
      })
    );
  };

  const handleSaveInflationSettings = async () => {
    setSavingInflation(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    const ratesPayload = {};
    inflationRates.forEach(r => {
      ratesPayload[String(r.year)] = r.rate_percent;
    });

    try {
      const json = await updateInflationSettings(token, { rates: ratesPayload });
      setSuccess(json.message || "Inflation buffer rates updated and synchronized across all proposal total costs.");
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to update inflation buffer rates.");
    } finally {
      setSavingInflation(false);
    }
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // UACS CATALOG CRUD HANDLERS
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleAddUacs = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newUacsCode.trim() || !newUacsTitle.trim()) return;

    setSavingUacs(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await createUacsEntry(token, {
        uacs_code: newUacsCode.trim(),
        account_title: newUacsTitle.trim(),
        expenditure_class: newUacsClass,
        is_subscription_default: newUacsIsSub,
        description: newUacsDesc.trim() || null
      });

      setSuccess(`UACS Code '${newUacsCode}' added to catalog.`);
      setNewUacsCode("");
      setNewUacsTitle("");
      setNewUacsDesc("");
      setNewUacsIsSub(false);
      fetchUacsCatalogData();
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to add UACS code.");
    } finally {
      setSavingUacs(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenEditUacsModal = (item) => {
    setEditingUacsItem(item);
    setEditUacsCode(item.uacs_code || "");
    setEditUacsTitle(item.account_title || "");
    setEditUacsClass(item.expenditure_class || "Capital Outlay");
    setEditUacsIsSub(Boolean(item.is_subscription_default));
    setEditUacsDesc(item.description || "");
  };

  const handleSaveEditUacs = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editingUacsItem) return;

    setSavingUacs(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await updateUacsEntry(token, editingUacsItem.id, {
        account_title: editUacsTitle.trim(),
        expenditure_class: editUacsClass,
        is_subscription_default: editUacsIsSub,
        description: editUacsDesc.trim() || null
      });

      setSuccess(`UACS Code '${editUacsCode}' updated successfully.`);
      setEditingUacsItem(null);
      fetchUacsCatalogData();
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to update UACS entry.");
    } finally {
      setSavingUacs(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteUacs = async (id, code, title) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Delete UACS code '${code} - ${title}' from catalog?`)) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteUacsEntry(token, id);
      setSuccess(`UACS code '${code}' deleted.`);
      fetchUacsCatalogData();
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete UACS code.");
    }
  };

  // Filtered UACS Items
  const filteredUacsItems = useMemo(() => {
    return uacsItems.filter(item => {
      if (uacsClassFilter !== "All" && item.expenditure_class !== uacsClassFilter) return false;
      if (!uacsSearch.trim()) return true;
      const q = uacsSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
      return (
        (item.uacs_code || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (item.account_title || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (item.description || "").toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [uacsItems, uacsClassFilter, uacsSearch]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // POLICY THRESHOLDS SAVE HANDLER & PRESET RESTORE
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleSavePolicySettings = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSavingPolicy(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await updatePolicySettings(token, policySettings);
      setSuccess("Capitalization threshold, major review gate, and policy settings updated.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to update policy settings.");
    } finally {
      setSavingPolicy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetPolicyDefaults = () => {
    setPolicySettings({
      capitalization_threshold: 50000.00,
      major_outlay_review_threshold: 2000000.00,
      hardware_replacement_buffer_units: 3,
      canvas_expiration_warning_days: 14
    });
    setSuccess("Restored statutory DBM & DICT default policy values. Click 'Save Policy Parameters' to apply.");
  };

  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  // CALCULATIONS FOR MACRO KPI TILES
  // -------------------------------------------------------------
  const totalAllocatedSubCeilings = ceilings.reduce((sum, d) => sum + Number(d.sub_ceiling || 0), 0);
  const totalActualSpent = ceilings.reduce((sum, d) => sum + Number(d.current_spent || 0), 0);
  const globalCapNum = parseFloat(globalCeiling) || 0;
  const unallocatedReserve = globalCapNum - totalAllocatedSubCeilings;
  const isAllocationOverGlobal = totalAllocatedSubCeilings > globalCapNum;
  const globalSpentPercent = globalCapNum > 0 ? (totalActualSpent / globalCapNum) * 100 : 0;

  // Parity Totals & Discrepancy Safe Resolution
  const certifiedGrandTotal = parseFloat(parityData?.certified_grand_total || parityData?.Certified_Grand_Total || 0);
  const isParityValid = parityData?.is_parity_valid !== undefined ? parityData.is_parity_valid : true;
  const discrepancy = parseFloat(parityData?.parity_discrepancy || 0);

  // Filter departments for listing
  const filteredCeilings = ceilings.filter(d => {
    const matchesSearch = (d.department_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || 
                          String(d.department_id || "").includes(searchQuery);

    const spent = Number(d.current_spent || 0);
    const sub = Number(d.sub_ceiling || 0);
    const ratio = sub > 0 ? (spent / sub) : 0;

    let matchesStatus = true;
    if (filterStatus === "over") {
      matchesStatus = spent > sub;
    } else if (filterStatus === "near") {
      matchesStatus = spent <= sub && ratio >= 0.80;
    } else if (filterStatus === "normal") {
      matchesStatus = ratio < 0.80;
    }

    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 select-none max-w-7xl mx-auto font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* Top Banner Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between md:items-center gap-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Landmark className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Sub-Ceiling Allocation, Dynamic Inflation &amp; 4-Way Parity</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/20 font-mono">
              Cycle: FY {activeCycle || "2026-2028"} ({activeYears.length} Years Horizon)
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 text-xs">
            Configure independent CapEx and MOOE department allotments across arbitrary multi-year spans ({activeYears[0]}–{activeYears[activeYears.length - 1]}), compound inflation buffers, manage UACS catalogs, and enforce 4-way parity.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Centralized Compiler Verification Button */}
          <CompilerSyncButton
            moduleName="budget"
            activeCycle={activeCycle}
            token={token}
            onSaveAndSync={fetchData}
            label="Save &amp; Verify Compiler Pipeline"
          />

          <button
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            disabled={exportingCsv}
            className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm text-xs"
            title="Export Part IV.A Detailed Deployment to DBM-compliant OSPS/NEP CSV"
          >
            <Download className={`w-4 h-4 ${exportingCsv ? "animate-spin text-blue-500" : "text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"}`} />
            <span>{exportingCsv ? "Exporting..." : "Export DBM CSV"}</span>
          </button>
          
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate("/admin/parity-summary")}
            className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm text-xs"
            title="Open Detailed Part IV.B Parity Matrix Viewer"
          >
            <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <span>4-Way Parity Ledger</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={runValidationCheck}
            disabled={validating}
            className="p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 shadow-sm text-xs"
          >
            <ShieldCheck className={`w-4 h-4 ${validating ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            <span>{validating ? "Running Dry Run..." : "Pre-flight Dry Run"}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Real-time Dry Run Validation Banner */}
      {validationResult && (
        <div className={`p-5 rounded-2xl border flex items-start gap-4 leading-relaxed animate-fadeIn shadow-sm ${
          validationResult.validation_passed 
            ? "bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-955/30 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300" 
            : "bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-955/30 border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-300"
        }`}>
          {validationResult.validation_passed ? (
            <>
              <Award className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="flex-1 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-sm">Dry Run Validation Successful: All Expenditures Balanced</h4>
                  <button onClick={() => setValidationResult(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
                    <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs">
                  All active department requests fit completely within their assigned sub-ceilings. No overages detected for planning cycle FY {activeCycle}.
                </p>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <ShieldAlert className="w-6 h-6 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shrink-0 animate-bounce mt-0.5" />
              <div className="space-y-2 flex-grow">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-sm">Budget Ceiling Overage Detected ({validationResult.total_violations_detected || 1} Departments)</h4>
                  <button onClick={() => setValidationResult(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
                    <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <p className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs">
                  The following departments have submitted or drafted outlays exceeding their allocated sub-ceilings. These overages must be adjusted before document compilation:
                </p>
