                            : "bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-500/10 dark:text-purple-300 dark:border-purple-500/20"
                        }`}>
                          {item.expenditure_class === "Capital Outlay" ? "Capital Outlay (CO)" : "MOOE"}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Financing Source */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3.5 align-top font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {item.fund_source ? item.fund_source.split(" (")[0] : "GAA"}
                      </td>

                      {/* Schedule Targets */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3.5 align-top font-mono text-[10.5px]">
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{item.total_qty} units</div>
                        <div className="text-slate-400 text-[9px] mt-0.5">
                          {activeYears.map(y => `FY${y}: ${item.yearly_quantities?.[String(y)] ?? 0}`).join(" | ")}
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Cost */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3.5 align-top text-right font-mono">
                        <div className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px]">{formatPHP(item.unit_cost)}</div>
                        <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs">{formatPHP(totalCost)}</div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Quotation Proof */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3.5 align-top text-center">
                        {isStudentSystem ? (
                          <span className="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border font-mono bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20">
                            {item.canvas_evidence_url ? "Proof Attached" : "Turnover Deed"}
                          </span>
                        ) : item.canvas_evidence_url ? (
                          <div className="space-y-1 inline-block text-center">
                            <a
                              href={item.canvas_evidence_url}
                              target="_blank"
                              rel="noreferrer"
                              className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px]"
                            >
                              <span className="max-w-[80px] truncate">{filename}</span>
                              <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5 shrink-0" />
                            </a>
                            {isCanvasExpired ? (
                              <span className="block px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500/20 text-[8.5px] font-bold uppercase font-mono">
                                Expired
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="block text-[8.5px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono">Verified</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold border font-mono bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500/20">
                            Missing Quote
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Review State */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3.5 align-top text-center">
                        <StatusPill status={item.status} />
                      </td>

                      {/* Actions */}
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-3.5 align-top text-right">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => openComments(item)}
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                            title="Revision Remarks"
                          >
                            <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>

                          {item.status === "Submitted" ? (
                            <>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleApprove(item.id, item.item_name)}
                                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-emerald-700 hover:text-white border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:hover:bg-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:hover:text-white dark:border-emerald-500/20 transition-colors cursor-pointer font-bold"
                                title="Approve Line Item"
                              >
                                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => openOverrideModal(item)}
                                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-600 text-blue-700 hover:text-white border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:hover:bg-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 dark:hover:text-white dark:border-blue-500/20 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Classify & Review Parameters"
                              >
                                <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => openReturnModal(item)}
                                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-600 text-rose-700 hover:text-white border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:hover:bg-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 dark:hover:text-white dark:border-rose-500/20 transition-colors cursor-pointer font-bold"
                                title="Return to Department with Instructions"
                              >
                                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <button
                                onClick={() => openOverrideModal(item)}
                                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Classify & Review Parameters"
                              >
                                <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleDeleteProposal(item.id, item.item_name)}
                                className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 dark:hover:text-rose-400 text-slate-500 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Delete Item"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          ) : (
            <div className="text-center py-20 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 italic">
              No proposal line items found matching active parameters.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Pagination Controls */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-xs">
        <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs">
          Showing <strong>{totalCount > 0 ? skip + 1 : 0}</strong> to <strong>{Math.min(skip + limit, totalCount)}</strong> of <strong>{totalCount}</strong> items
        </span>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => setSkip(Math.max(0, skip - limit))}
            disabled={skip === 0}
            className="p-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition-all cursor-pointer text-xs"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Prev</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setSkip(skip + limit)}
            disabled={skip + limit >= totalCount}
            className="p-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition-all cursor-pointer text-xs"
          >
            <span>Next</span>
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* OVERRIDE & GOVERNANCE ASSIGNMENT MODAL (Guided 4-Step Pipeline) */}
      {activeOverrideItem && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-2xl p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl overflow-y-auto max-h-[90vh]">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                  <span>Administrative Review &amp; Governance Classification</span>
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">Proposal ID: {activeOverrideItem.id}</span>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => setActiveOverrideItem(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer">
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Department's Raw Submission Summary Card */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />
                  <span>Department's Raw Submission</span>
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                  Submitting Unit: <strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{getDepartmentName(activeOverrideItem.department_id, activeOverrideItem)}</strong>
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-[11px]">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-[9px] uppercase font-bold block">Raw Item Label:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{activeOverrideItem.item_name}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-[9px] uppercase font-bold block">Original Unit Cost:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{formatPHP(activeOverrideItem.unit_cost)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px]">
                <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-[9px] uppercase font-bold block">Requested Quantities Schedule:</span>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1 font-mono text-[10px]">
                  {activeYears.map((yr, idx) => {
                    const q = activeOverrideItem.yearly_quantities?.[String(yr)] ?? 
                              activeOverrideItem.yearly_quantities?.[`Year ${idx + 1}`] ?? 
                              (idx === 0 ? activeOverrideItem.year_1_qty : idx === 1 ? activeOverrideItem.year_2_qty : idx === 2 ? activeOverrideItem.year_3_qty : 0) ?? 0;
                    return (
                      <span key={yr} className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                        FY {yr}: <strong>{q} units</strong>
                      </span>
                    );
                  })}
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900">
                    Total: {activeOverrideItem.total_qty || (activeOverrideItem.yearly_quantities ? Object.values(activeOverrideItem.yearly_quantities || {}).reduce((a, b) => a + (parseInt(b, 10) || 0), 0) : 0)} units
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {activeOverrideItem.justification && (
                <div className="text-[11px]">
                  <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 text-[9px] uppercase font-bold block">Technical Justification:</span>
                  <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 italic whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 mt-1">
                    "{activeOverrideItem.justification}"
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[10px]">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase text-[9px] font-bold">Attached Proof / Quotation:</span>
                  {activeOverrideItem.canvas_evidence_url ? (
                    <a 
                      href={activeOverrideItem.canvas_evidence_url} 
                      target="_blank" 
                      rel="noreferrer"
                      className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline font-semibold inline-flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <span>View Proof Document ({activeOverrideItem.supplier_name || "Quotation"})</span>
                      <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    </a>
                  ) : (activeOverrideItem.created_by_students || activeOverrideItem.is_in_house_turnover) ? (
                    <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                      In-House / Non-Commercial Turnover (Quotation Exempt)
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold">
                      No Quotation Canvas Attached
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {activeOverrideItem.canvas_expiration_date && (
                  <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono text-[9.5px]">
                    Expiry: {new Date(activeOverrideItem.canvas_expiration_date).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Guided Administrative Governance Assignment Form */}
            <form onSubmit={(e) => handleSaveOverride(e, false)} className="space-y-4 text-xs pt-1">
              
              {/* Resource Item Label */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Resource Item Label</label>
                <input
                  type="text" 
                  required 
                  value={overrideItemName} 
                  onChange={(e) => setOverrideItemName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-semibold outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Student / In-House Turnover Flag */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 block text-[11px]">In-House / Non-Commercial Turnover</span>
                  <span className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block">Classified as Capital Outlay (ICT Software); commercial quotation is optional.</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={overrideCreatedByStudents}
                  onChange={e => setOverrideCreatedByStudents(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              {/* STEP 1: Program Outcome Assignment (Part I.A.4) */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5 p-3.5 bg-blue-50/90 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/60 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 rounded-xl">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[9px] font-bold">1</span>
                    <GraduationCap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                    <span>Program Alignment (Part I.A.4 Organizational Outcome)</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-rose-500 font-bold">*Mandatory</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={overrideOutcomeId}
                  onChange={(e) => setOverrideOutcomeId(e.target.value)}
                  required
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none cursor-pointer font-semibold text-xs"
                >
                  <option value="">-- Select Organizational Outcome --</option>
                  {outcomes.map(o => (
                    <option key={o.id} value={String(o.id)}>
                      {o.outcome_name} ({o.type_label})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <span className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block pt-0.5">
                  Establishes statutory accountability and links this outlay to institutional key result areas.
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* STEP 2: Root Problem Provenance (Strategic Concern & Section 8.0 Needs Assessment) */}
              <div className="space-y-3 p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[9px] font-bold">2</span>
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />
                  <span>Strategic Concern &amp; Needs Assessment Linkage (Part II.A &amp; Section 8.0)</span>
                </span>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Parent Strategic Concern (Part II.A Root Problem)
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={overrideConcernId}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const cId = e.target.value;
                      setOverrideConcernId(cId);
                      const concern = strategicConcerns.find(c => String(c.id) === String(cId));
                      if (concern?.outcome_id) {
                        setOverrideOutcomeId(String(concern.outcome_id));
                      }
                      if (concern?.intended_use && !overrideJustification) {
                        setOverrideJustification(concern.intended_use);
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs"
                  >
                    <option value="">-- No Specific Strategic Concern --</option>
                    {strategicConcerns.map(c => (
                      <option key={c.id} value={String(c.id)}>
                        [{c.mfo}] {c.critical_system} — {c.problems.slice(0, 50)}...
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <ClipboardCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" />
                    <span>Linked Department Needs Assessment (Section 8.0)</span>
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={overrideNeedsAssessmentId}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const selectedId = e.target.value;
                      setOverrideNeedsAssessmentId(selectedId);
                      const matched = needsAssessments.find(n => String(n.id) === selectedId);
                      if (matched) {
                        if (!overrideJustification) {
                          setOverrideJustification(`[Justified by Needs Assessment]: ${matched.current_problem}`);
                        }
                        if (matched.strategic_concern_id) {
                          setOverrideConcernId(String(matched.strategic_concern_id));
                          const concern = strategicConcerns.find(c => String(c.id) === String(matched.strategic_concern_id));
                          if (concern?.outcome_id) {
                            setOverrideOutcomeId(String(concern.outcome_id));
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs"
                  >
                    <option value="">-- None / Standalone Line Item --</option>
                    {needsAssessments
                      .filter(na => !activeOverrideItem?.department_id || na.department_id === activeOverrideItem.department_id)
                      .map(na => (
                        <option key={na.id} value={String(na.id)}>
                          [{na.mfo_alignment?.toUpperCase() || "MFO"}] {na.title}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    {needsAssessments.some(na => activeOverrideItem?.department_id && na.department_id !== activeOverrideItem.department_id) && (
                      <optgroup label="Other Department Needs Assessments">
                        {needsAssessments
                          .filter(na => activeOverrideItem?.department_id && na.department_id !== activeOverrideItem.department_id)
                          .map(na => (
                            <option key={na.id} value={String(na.id)}>
                              [{na.department_name || `Dept ${na.department_id}`}] {na.title}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                      </optgroup>
                    )}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* STEP 3: Strategic Allocation Gate & ICT Project Portfolio (Part III.E) */}
              <div className="space-y-3 p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[9px] font-bold">3</span>
                  <FolderKanban className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-500" />
                  <span>Governance Allocation Gate &amp; Strategic Portfolio (Part III.E)</span>
                </span>

                {/* 3-Mode Allocation Gate Selector */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block">
                    Pipeline Allocation Intent (Prevents Unlinked Cost Leak into Table B.1)
                  </label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                    <label className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                      governanceMode === "project_bound"
                        ? "bg-purple-50/90 dark:bg-slate-955 border-purple-400 dark:border-purple-800 text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 ring-1 ring-purple-400"
                        : "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:border-slate-400"
                    }`}>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name="govMode"
                          checked={governanceMode === "project_bound"}
                          onChange={() => {
                            setGovernanceMode("project_bound");
                            if (projects.length > 0 && !overrideProjectId) {
                              setOverrideProjectId(String(projects[0].id));
                              setOverrideStrategicCat(projects[0].project_category || "Internal ICT Projects");
                            }
                          }}
                          className="accent-purple-600"
                        />
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs">Bind to ICT Project</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[9.5px] opacity-75 mt-1 block">Compiles under target Part III.E charter</span>
                    </label>

                    <label className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                      governanceMode === "intake_pool"
                        ? "bg-amber-50/90 dark:bg-slate-955 border-amber-400 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 ring-1 ring-amber-400"
                        : "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:border-slate-400"
                    }`}>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name="govMode"
                          checked={governanceMode === "intake_pool"}
                          onChange={() => {
                            setGovernanceMode("intake_pool");
                            setOverrideProjectId("");
                            setOverrideStrategicCat("Internal ICT Projects");
                          }}
                          className="accent-amber-600"
                        />
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs">Place in Intake Pool</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[9.5px] opacity-75 mt-1 block">Approved but quarantined from PDF</span>
                    </label>

                    <label className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                      governanceMode === "standalone"
                        ? "bg-blue-50/90 dark:bg-slate-955 border-blue-400 dark:border-blue-800 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 ring-1 ring-blue-400"
                        : "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:border-slate-400"
                    }`}>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name="govMode"
                          checked={governanceMode === "standalone"}
                          onChange={() => {
                            setGovernanceMode("standalone");
                            setOverrideProjectId("");
                            setOverrideStrategicCat(overrideCategory === "Subscription" ? "Continuing Costs/Expenses" : "Office Productivity");
                          }}
                          className="accent-blue-600"
                        />
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs">Standalone OpEx</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[9.5px] opacity-75 mt-1 block">Compiles under routine office outlays</span>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Dynamic Explanatory Callout Banner based on Governance Mode */}
                {governanceMode === "intake_pool" && (
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-amber-50/90 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-900/60 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 rounded-xl text-[10.5px] flex items-start gap-1.5 animate-fadeIn">
                    <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span>
                      <strong>Intake Pool Quarantining Active:</strong> This proposal will be approved into the departmental intake pool. It will <strong>NOT</strong> leak into Table B.1 or Table IV.A until an administrator assigns it to a Part III.E Project Charter in the Projects Portfolio.
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {governanceMode === "project_bound" && (
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 animate-fadeIn">
                    <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span>Select Target ICT Project Portfolio Charter (Part III.E)</span>
                      <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">*Required</span>
                    </label>
                    <select
                      value={overrideProjectId}
                      required={governanceMode === "project_bound"}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const pId = e.target.value;
                        setOverrideProjectId(pId);
                        if (pId) {
                          const pObj = projects.find(p => String(p.id) === String(pId));
                          if (pObj) {
                            setOverrideStrategicCat(pObj.project_category || "Internal ICT Projects");
                            if (pObj.funding_source) {
                              setOverrideFundSource(pObj.funding_source);
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      }}
                      className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none cursor-pointer text-xs font-semibold"
                    >
                      <option value="">-- Choose Target ICT Project --</option>
                      {projects.filter(p => !((p.project_category || "").toLowerCase().includes("cross"))).length > 0 && (
                        <optgroup label="Part III.E.1 Internal ICT Projects">
                          {projects
                            .filter(p => !((p.project_category || "").toLowerCase().includes("cross")))
                            .map(p => (
                              <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>[Internal] {p.project_title}</option>
                            ))}
                        </optgroup>
                      )}
                      {projects.filter(p => (p.project_category || "").toLowerCase().includes("cross")).length > 0 && (
                        <optgroup label="Part III.E.2 Cross-Agency ICT Projects">
                          {projects
                            .filter(p => (p.project_category || "").toLowerCase().includes("cross"))
                            .map(p => (
                              <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>[Cross-Agency] {p.project_title}</option>
                            ))}
                        </optgroup>
                      )}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Resource Nature</label>
                    <select
                      value={overrideCategory} 
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const val = e.target.value;
                        setOverrideCategory(val);
                        if (val === "Subscription" && governanceMode === "standalone") {
                          setOverrideStrategicCat("Continuing Costs/Expenses");
                        }
                      }}
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 outline-none text-xs"
                    >
                      <option value="Hardware">Hardware Equipment</option>
                      <option value="Software">Software Packages (COTS / Licenses)</option>
                      <option value="Subscription">Subscription (Cloud / SaaS)</option>
                      <option value="Services">Services (Consulting / Maintenance)</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span>Spending Bucket (Table B.1)</span>
                      {governanceMode === "project_bound" && <span className="text-[8.5px] text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono">(Project Inherited)</span>}
                    </label>
                    <select
                      value={overrideStrategicCat}
                      onChange={(e) => setOverrideStrategicCat(e.target.value)}
                      disabled={governanceMode === "project_bound" || governanceMode === "intake_pool"}
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none cursor-pointer font-semibold text-xs disabled:opacity-60"
                    >
                      {strategicCategories.length > 0 ? (
                        strategicCategories.map((sc) => (
                          <option key={sc.id || sc.name} value={sc.name}>
                            {sc.name}
                          </option>
                        ))
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <option value="Office Productivity">Office Productivity</option>
                          <option value="Internal ICT Projects">Internal ICT Projects</option>
                          <option value="Cross-Agency ICT Projects">Cross-Agency Projects</option>
                          <option value="Continuing Costs/Expenses">Continuing Costs/Expenses</option>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Helpful Guidance Callout for Packaged Software vs Custom Systems */}
                {overrideCategory === "Software" && (
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-blue-50/90 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/60 text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 rounded-xl text-[10px] flex items-start gap-1.5 leading-relaxed">
                    <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span>
                      <strong>Procurement Scope Note:</strong> Use this line item for Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) software licenses and perpetual seat packages (e.g. AutoCAD, SPSS, Adobe CC, Windows Server CALs). Enterprise systems running multi-user workflows (e.g. HRIS, Student Portal) must be managed under <strong>Part III.D Information Systems</strong>.
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* STEP 4: Deployment Location, Fund Source, UACS & Accounting */}
              <div className="space-y-3 p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-700 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[9px] font-bold">4</span>
                  <Tag className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                  <span>Deployment Location, Funding &amp; UACS Accounting (Table B.4)</span>
                </span>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Unit Cost (PHP ₱)</label>
                    <input
                      type="number" step="0.01" min="0" required value={overrideUnitCost} onChange={(e) => setOverrideUnitCost(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono font-bold outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Deployment Location</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={overrideOfficeLoc}
                      onChange={(e) => setOverrideOfficeLoc(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g. Planning Division, Central Office, Field Branch..."
                      className="w-full p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>Financing Fund Source</span>
                    {governanceMode === "project_bound" && <span className="text-[8.5px] text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono">(Project Inherited)</span>}

                  >
                    <option value="General Appropriations Act (GAA)">General Appropriations Act (GAA)</option>
                    <option value="Foreign-Assisted Projects (FAP)">Foreign-Assisted Projects (FAP)</option>
                    <option value="Locally Funded">Locally Funded</option>

                  </select>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">

                    </label>
                    <button
                      type="button"

                      className="text-[9.5px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline font-mono cursor-pointer"

                      Reset to Auto-Resolved
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <select
                    value={resolvedEffectiveUacs}
                    onChange={(e) => setOverrideUacsCode(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-xs outline-none cursor-pointer font-semibold"
                  >
                    <option value={overrideAutoClass.uacs}>
                      [Auto-Resolved]: {overrideAutoClass.uacs} ({overrideAutoClass.expClass})
                    </option>
                    {uacsCatalog.map(u => {
                      const fullCode = `${u.uacs_code} - ${u.account_title}`;
                      if (fullCode === overrideAutoClass.uacs) return null;
                      return (
                        <option key={u.id} value={fullCode}>
                          {fullCode} ({u.expenditure_class})

      )}

      {/* RETURN WITH REVISION INSTRUCTIONS MODAL */}
      {returnModalItem && (

          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">Return Proposal for Revisions</h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">Resource: {returnModalItem.item_name}</span>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => setReturnModalItem(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer">
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={submitReturnWithInstructions} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Revision Instructions (Will be flagged as Action Item in Department Inbox)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  required
                  value={returnRemark}
                  onChange={e => setReturnRemark(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Detail missing documentation, expired quotation updates, or required quantity adjustments..."
                  className="w-full p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none resize-none leading-relaxed focus:border-rose-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/90 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-900/60 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 rounded-xl text-[10.5px]">
                Returning this proposal unlocks editing for the department and locks submission until this action item is marked resolved.
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setReturnModalItem(null)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold cursor-pointer text-xs transition-colors"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={isSubmittingReturn}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl font-bold cursor-pointer shadow-sm text-xs transition-colors"
                >
                  {isSubmittingReturn ? "Returning..." : "Confirm Return"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* DISCUSSION MODAL */}
      {activeDiscussionItem && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-xl flex flex-col h-[520px] shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-sm">Discussions &amp; Remarks</h3>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">Proposal: {activeDiscussionItem.item_name}</p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => setActiveDiscussionItem(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer">
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3">
              {comments.length > 0 ? (
                comments.map((c) => (
                  <div key={c.id} className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
                      <span className="font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">{c.author_name}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-mono">{new Date(c.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed text-xs">{c.text}</p>
                    
                    {c.requires_department_action && (
                      <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center">
                        <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:text-rose-400 dark:border-rose-500/20 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">
                          Requires Action by Department
                        </span>
                        {c.is_resolved ? (
                          <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono">
                            <CheckSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Resolved
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleResolveComment(c.id)}
                            className="text-xs bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors shadow-2xs"
                          >
                            Resolve Action
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 italic">No remarks logged yet.</div>
              )}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handlePostComment} className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-955 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  id="action_gate"
                  checked={requiresAction}
                  onChange={(e) => setRequiresAction(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-3.5 h-3.5 accent-rose-600 rounded cursor-pointer"
                />
                <label htmlFor="action_gate" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer select-none">
                  Flag as Action Item (blocks department submission until resolved)
                </label>
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text" required value={newCommentText} onChange={(e) => setNewCommentText(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Post feedback or revision instructions..."
                  className="flex-1 p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                />
                <button type="submit" className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-lg cursor-pointer">
                  Send
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

    setError(null);
    try {
      const [sysData, cData, pData, dData, naData, stratData] = await Promise.all([
        getInformationSystems(token, activeCycle).catch(() => []),
        getStrategicConcerns(token, activeCycle).catch(() => []),
        getIctProjects(token, activeCycle).catch(() => []),
        getDepartments(token).catch(() => []),
        getAllNeedsAssessments(token).catch(() => []),
        getDevelopmentStrategies(token).catch(() => null)
      ]);

      setSystems(Array.isArray(sysData) ? sysData : (sysData?.data || []));
      setStrategicConcerns(Array.isArray(cData) ? cData : (cData?.data || []));
      setProjects(Array.isArray(pData) ? pData : (pData?.data || []));
      setDepartments(Array.isArray(dData) ? dData : []);
      setNeedsAssessments(Array.isArray(naData) ? naData : []);

      if (stratData && Array.isArray(stratData) && stratData.length > 0) {
        setDevelopmentStrategies(stratData);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to load information systems.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [activeCycle, token]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchSystems();
  }, [fetchSystems]);

  // Development Strategies Management Handlers
  const handleAddStrategy = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newStrategyName.trim()) return;

    const generatedCode = (newStrategyCode.trim() || newStrategyName.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "_")).slice(0, 30);
    setSavingStrategy(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await createDevelopmentStrategy(token, {
        code: generatedCode,
        display_name: newStrategyName.trim(),
        description: newStrategyDesc.trim() || null
      });

      setSuccess(`Development strategy '${newStrategyName.trim()}' registered successfully.`);
      setNewStrategyCode("");
      setNewStrategyName("");
      setNewStrategyDesc("");
      const updated = await getDevelopmentStrategies(token).catch(() => []);
      if (Array.isArray(updated) && updated.length > 0) {
        setDevelopmentStrategies(updated);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to register development strategy.");
    } finally {
      setSavingStrategy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteStrategy = async (code, name) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Permanently remove development strategy '${name}' (${code})?`)) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteDevelopmentStrategy(token, code);
      setSuccess(`Development strategy '${name}' deleted.`);
      const updated = await getDevelopmentStrategies(token).catch(() => []);
      if (Array.isArray(updated)) {
        setDevelopmentStrategies(updated);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete development strategy.");
    }
  };

  const handleOpenCreateModal = (defaultStatus = null) => {
    setEditingId(null);
    let resolvedStatus = defaultStatus;
    if (!resolvedStatus) {
      if (statusTab === "Operational") resolvedStatus = "Operational";
      else if (statusTab === "For Development") resolvedStatus = "For Development";
      else if (statusTab === "For Enhancement") resolvedStatus = "For Enhancement";
      else if (statusTab === "Proposed") resolvedStatus = "For Development";
      else resolvedStatus = "Operational";
    }

    setForm({
      ...initialFormState,
      status: resolvedStatus
    });
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEditModal = (sys) => {
    setEditingId(sys.id);

    const classStr = sys.classification?.value || sys.classification || "";
    const classLower = classStr.toLowerCase();

    const isSupport = sys.is_support_to_operations !== undefined 
      ? Boolean(sys.is_support_to_operations) 
      : classLower.includes("support");

    const isAdmin = sys.is_general_administrative !== undefined 
      ? Boolean(sys.is_general_administrative) 
      : (classLower.includes("administrative") || classLower.includes("admin"));

    const isOps = sys.is_operations !== undefined 
      ? Boolean(sys.is_operations) 
      : (classLower.includes("operations") || (!isSupport && !isAdmin));

    const isFrontline = sys.is_frontline_service !== undefined 
      ? Boolean(sys.is_frontline_service) 
      : (classLower.includes("frontline") && !classLower.includes("non-frontline"));

    const isNonFrontline = sys.is_non_frontline_service !== undefined 
      ? Boolean(sys.is_non_frontline_service) 
      : classLower.includes("non-frontline");

    // Check project linkage via both sys.project_id and project.system_id
    const linkedProj = projects.find(
      p => (sys.project_id && String(p.id) === String(sys.project_id)) || String(p.system_id) === String(sys.id)
    );

    setForm({
      strategic_concern_id: sys.strategic_concern_id || "",
      needs_assessment_id: sys.needs_assessment_id || "",
      project_id: sys.project_id || (linkedProj ? String(linkedProj.id) : ""),
      name: sys.name || "",
      status: sys.status?.value || sys.status || "Operational",
      classification: classStr || "Operations - Frontline Service",
      proposed_cost: sys.proposed_cost !== undefined ? String(sys.proposed_cost) : "",
      is_client_facing: sys.is_client_facing !== undefined ? Boolean(sys.is_client_facing) : true,
      is_support_to_operations: isSupport,
      is_general_administrative: isAdmin,
      is_operations: isOps,
      is_frontline_service: isFrontline,
      frontline_hosting_type: sys.frontline_hosting_type?.value || sys.frontline_hosting_type || sys.hosting_type?.value || sys.hosting_type || "Online",
      online_url: sys.online_url || "",
      is_non_frontline_service: isNonFrontline,
      description_and_purpose: sys.description_and_purpose || "",
      enhancement_details: sys.enhancement_details || "",
      development_strategy: sys.development_strategy?.value || sys.development_strategy || "Outsourced",
      development_platform: sys.development_platform || "",
      database_name: sys.database_name || "",
      data_storage_type: sys.data_storage_type || "",
      internal_users: sys.internal_users || "",
      external_users: sys.external_users || "",
      system_owner_office: sys.system_owner_office || "",
      is_integrated_with_others: Boolean(sys.is_integrated_with_others),
      internal_integrated_systems: sys.internal_integrated_systems || "",
      external_integrated_systems: sys.external_integrated_systems || "",
      generates_data_for_others: Boolean(sys.generates_data_for_others),
      processes_data_from_others: Boolean(sys.processes_data_from_others),
      is_deployed_on_shared_platform: Boolean(sys.is_deployed_on_shared_platform),
      processes_personal_information: Boolean(sys.processes_personal_information),
      has_undergone_pia: Boolean(sys.has_undergone_pia),
      pia_target_date_text: sys.pia_target_date_text || ""
    });
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  // Open Administrative Review Modal (Populates both Department Inputs & Technical Stack)
  const handleOpenReviewModal = (sys) => {
    setReviewingSystem(sys);
    setReviewAction("APPROVE");
    setReviewStatus(sys.status?.value || sys.status || "For Development");
    setReviewProposedCost(sys.proposed_cost !== undefined ? String(sys.proposed_cost) : "0");
    setReviewConcernId(sys.strategic_concern_id || (strategicConcerns[0]?.id ? String(strategicConcerns[0].id) : ""));
    
    // Find if any project is already linked to this system
    const linkedProj = projects.find(
      p => (sys.project_id && String(p.id) === String(sys.project_id)) || String(p.system_id) === String(sys.id)
    );
    setReviewProjectId(sys.project_id || (linkedProj ? String(linkedProj.id) : ""));

    // Pre-populate technical architecture defaults for the Administrator to confirm
    setReviewDevStrategy(sys.development_strategy?.value || sys.development_strategy || "Outsourced");
    setReviewPlatform(sys.development_platform || "Web-Based Architecture (FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL)");
    setReviewDatabaseName(
      sys.database_name || 
      `${(sys.name || "app").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "_").slice(0, 25)}_db`
    );
    setReviewDataStorage(sys.data_storage_type || "GovCloud / On-premise Storage");
    setReviewProcessesPII(Boolean(sys.processes_personal_information));
    setReviewHasPIA(Boolean(sys.has_undergone_pia));
    setReviewPiaTargetDate(sys.pia_target_date_text || "");

    setReviewIsIntegrated(Boolean(sys.is_integrated_with_others));
    setReviewInternalIntegrated(sys.internal_integrated_systems || "");
    setReviewExternalIntegrated(sys.external_integrated_systems || "");
    setReviewGeneratesData(Boolean(sys.generates_data_for_others));
    setReviewProcessesData(Boolean(sys.processes_data_from_others));
    setReviewSharedPlatform(Boolean(sys.is_deployed_on_shared_platform));

    setReviewReason("Please provide additional technical justifications and details regarding frontline integrations.");
    setError(null);
  };

  // Commit Review Decision & Synchronize Architecture + Financial Parity
  const handleReviewSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reviewingSystem) return;
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      if (reviewAction === "RETURN") {
        await reviewProposedSystem(token, reviewingSystem.id, {
          action: "RETURN",
          status: reviewingSystem.status?.value || reviewingSystem.status,
          rejection_reason: reviewReason.trim() || "Proposal requires revision or additional technical details."
        });

        setSuccess(`System proposal '${reviewingSystem.name}' returned to department with revision remarks.`);
      } else {
        // APPROVE: First update the system with all technical specifications confirmed by the Admin
        const parsedCost = parseFloat(reviewProposedCost) || 0.0;
        const updatePayload = {
          proposed_cost: parsedCost,
          project_id: reviewProjectId || null,
          development_strategy: reviewDevStrategy,
          development_platform: reviewPlatform.trim(),
          database_name: reviewDatabaseName.trim(),
          data_storage_type: reviewDataStorage.trim(),
          processes_personal_information: reviewProcessesPII,
          has_undergone_pia: reviewHasPIA,
          pia_target_date_text: reviewProcessesPII && !reviewHasPIA ? (reviewPiaTargetDate.trim() || null) : null,
          is_integrated_with_others: reviewIsIntegrated,
          internal_integrated_systems: reviewIsIntegrated ? (reviewInternalIntegrated.trim() || null) : null,
          external_integrated_systems: reviewIsIntegrated ? (reviewExternalIntegrated.trim() || null) : null,
          generates_data_for_others: reviewGeneratesData,
          processes_data_from_others: reviewProcessesData,
          is_deployed_on_shared_platform: reviewSharedPlatform
        };

        await updateInformationSystem(token, reviewingSystem.id, updatePayload);

        // Finalize review approval
        await reviewProposedSystem(token, reviewingSystem.id, {
          action: "APPROVE",
          status: reviewStatus,
          strategic_concern_id: reviewConcernId || null,
          project_id: reviewProjectId || null,
          rejection_reason: null
        });

        setSuccess(`System '${reviewingSystem.name}' approved! Technical specs committed and linked to Part III.E & Part IV.A.`);
      }

      setReviewingSystem(null);
      fetchSystems();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to process review.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);

    if (!form.name.trim()) {
      setError("System Name is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (!form.is_support_to_operations && !form.is_general_administrative && !form.is_operations) {
      setError("Please select at least one classification category: Support to Operations, General Administrative, or Operations.");
      return;
    }

    if (form.is_operations && !form.is_frontline_service && !form.is_non_frontline_service) {
      setError("When Operations is checked, please specify either Frontline Service, Non-Frontline Service, or both.");
      return;
    }

    if (!form.description_and_purpose.trim()) {
      setError("System Description and Purpose is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (form.status === "For Enhancement" && !form.enhancement_details?.trim()) {
      setError("Please provide specific planned enhancement details when status is set to 'For Enhancement'.");
      return;
    }

    if (form.processes_personal_information && !form.has_undergone_pia && !form.pia_target_date_text?.trim()) {
      setError("Data Privacy Compliance: Please provide a Target Audit Completion Date (e.g., 'Q3 2027') for systems with uncompleted PIAs [1].");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);

    const classTokens = [];
    if (form.is_support_to_operations) classTokens.push("Support to Operations");
    if (form.is_general_administrative) classTokens.push("General Administrative Systems");
    if (form.is_operations) {
      if (form.is_frontline_service && form.is_non_frontline_service) {
        classTokens.push("Operations (Frontline & Non-Frontline)");
      } else if (form.is_frontline_service) {
        classTokens.push("Operations - Frontline Service");
      } else if (form.is_non_frontline_service) {
        classTokens.push("Operations - Non-Frontline Service");
      } else {
        classTokens.push("Operations");
      }
    }
    const classificationStr = classTokens.join(", ") || "Operations";

    const payload = {
      ...form,
      name: form.name.trim(),
      classification: classificationStr,
      proposed_cost: parseFloat(form.proposed_cost) || 0.0,
      is_client_facing: Boolean(form.is_client_facing),
      is_support_to_operations: Boolean(form.is_support_to_operations),
      is_general_administrative: Boolean(form.is_general_administrative),
      is_operations: Boolean(form.is_operations),
      is_frontline_service: Boolean(form.is_frontline_service),
      is_non_frontline_service: Boolean(form.is_non_frontline_service),
      frontline_hosting_type: form.is_frontline_service ? (form.frontline_hosting_type || "Online") : "Online",
      online_url: (form.is_frontline_service && form.online_url?.trim()) ? form.online_url.trim() : null,
      description_and_purpose: form.description_and_purpose.trim(),
      enhancement_details: form.status === "For Enhancement" ? (form.enhancement_details?.trim() || null) : null,
      strategic_concern_id: form.strategic_concern_id || null,
      needs_assessment_id: form.needs_assessment_id || null,
      project_id: form.project_id || null,
      development_strategy: form.development_strategy,
      development_platform: form.development_platform.trim(),
      database_name: form.database_name.trim(),
      data_storage_type: form.data_storage_type.trim(),
      internal_users: form.internal_users.trim(),
      external_users: form.external_users.trim(),
      system_owner_office: form.system_owner_office.trim(),
      internal_integrated_systems: form.is_integrated_with_others ? (form.internal_integrated_systems?.trim() || null) : null,
      external_integrated_systems: form.is_integrated_with_others ? (form.external_integrated_systems?.trim() || null) : null,
      pia_target_date_text: form.processes_personal_information && !form.has_undergone_pia ? (form.pia_target_date_text?.trim() || null) : null
    };

    try {
      if (editingId) {
        await updateInformationSystem(token, editingId, payload);
      } else {
        await createInformationSystem(token, payload);
      }

      setSuccess(`Information System '${form.name}' saved successfully.`);
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      fetchSystems();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to save system.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id, name) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Permanently delete Information System '${name}'? This will uncouple any linked BIA records and ICT projects.`)) {
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(null);
    try {
      await deleteInformationSystem(token, id);
      setSuccess(`System '${name}' removed from registry.`);
      fetchSystems();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to delete system.");
    }
  };

  // Summary Metrics Breakdown
  const intakeCount = systems.filter(s => (s.submission_status || "").toLowerCase() === "submitted").length;
  const operationalCount = systems.filter(s => (s.status?.value || s.status) === "Operational" && (s.submission_status || "Approved").toLowerCase() === "approved").length;
  const proposedCount = systems.filter(s => (s.status?.value || s.status) !== "Operational" && (s.submission_status || "Approved").toLowerCase() === "approved").length;
  const devCount = systems.filter(s => (s.status?.value || s.status) === "For Development" && (s.submission_status || "Approved").toLowerCase() === "approved").length;
  const enhanceCount = systems.filter(s => (s.status?.value || s.status) === "For Enhancement" && (s.submission_status || "Approved").toLowerCase() === "approved").length;
  const returnedCount = systems.filter(s => (s.submission_status || "").toLowerCase() === "returned").length;

  const totalProposedOutlay = useMemo(() => {
    return systems
      .filter(s => (s.status?.value || s.status) !== "Operational")
      .reduce((sum, s) => sum + (parseFloat(s.proposed_cost) || 0), 0);
  }, [systems]);

  const pendingPiaCount = systems.filter(s => s.processes_personal_information && !s.has_undergone_pia).length;
  const frontlineCount = systems.filter(s => {
    const c = (s.classification?.value || s.classification || "").toLowerCase();
    return s.is_frontline_service || (c.includes("frontline") && !c.includes("non-frontline"));
  }).length;

  // Filtered Systems List (Tabs & Text Search)
  const filteredSystems = useMemo(() => {
    return systems.filter(s => {
      const sStatus = s.status?.value || s.status || "Operational";
      const subStatus = (s.submission_status || "Approved").toLowerCase();
      let matchesTab = true;

      if (statusTab === "Intake") {
        matchesTab = subStatus === "submitted";
      } else if (statusTab === "Operational") {
        matchesTab = sStatus === "Operational" && subStatus === "approved";
      } else if (statusTab === "Proposed") {
        matchesTab = sStatus !== "Operational" && subStatus === "approved";
      } else if (statusTab === "For Development") {
        matchesTab = sStatus === "For Development" && subStatus === "approved";
      } else if (statusTab === "For Enhancement") {
        matchesTab = sStatus === "For Enhancement" && subStatus === "approved";
      } else if (statusTab === "Returned") {
        matchesTab = subStatus === "returned";
      }

      const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchesSearch = q === "" || 
        (s.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (s.system_owner_office || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (s.development_platform || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (s.database_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (s.description_and_purpose || "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (s.enhancement_details || "").toLowerCase().includes(q);

      return matchesTab && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [systems, statusTab, searchTerm]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 max-w-7xl mx-auto select-none font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      
      {/* Header Banner Panel */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 gap-4 shadow-xs">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Database className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <h2 className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-serif font-bold text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Information Systems Register &amp; Intake Queue</span>
            </h2>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/20 font-mono">
              Cycle: FY {activeCycle || "2026-2028"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 text-xs">
            Review department-submitted proposed systems, assign technical architectures, and bridge governance linkages: <strong>Part I.A.4 Outcome</strong>, <strong>Part II.A Strategic Concern</strong>, and <strong>Part III.E ICT Project Portfolio</strong>. Approving a system automatically commits the estimated budget into Part IV.A outlays.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 self-start md:self-auto">
          {/* Verified Compiler Pipeline Synchronization Button */}
          <CompilerSyncButton
            moduleName="systems"
            activeCycle={activeCycle}
            token={token}
            onSaveAndSync={fetchSystems}
            label="Save &amp; Verify Compiler Pipeline"
          />

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsStrategyModalOpen(true)}
            className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer font-bold shadow-xs text-xs"
            title="Configure Development Strategies Taxonomy"
          >
            <SlidersHorizontal className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
            <span>Manage Strategies ({developmentStrategies.length})</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={fetchSystems}
            disabled={loading}
            className="p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 font-bold shadow-xs text-xs"
            title="Refresh systems register"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`} />
            <span>Sync</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleOpenCreateModal()}
            className="p-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-sm text-xs"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Register System</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
        {/* Intake Queue Counter */}
        <div 
          onClick={() => setStatusTab("Intake")}
          className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs ${
            statusTab === "Intake"
              ? "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-955/40 border-blue-400 dark:border-blue-700"
              : "bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-blue-300"
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl shrink-0 ${intakeCount > 0 ? "bg-blue-600 text-white animate-pulse" : "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"}`}>
              <Inbox className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Dept Intake Queue</span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{intakeCount} Pending</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl shrink-0">
            <Server className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Part II.C Operational</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono mt-0.5">{operationalCount} Systems</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 rounded-xl shrink-0">
            <Cpu className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Part III.D Proposed</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{proposedCount} Systems</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-xl shrink-0">
            <Coins className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Proposed Outlay Pool</span>
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono mt-0.5">{formatPHP(totalProposedOutlay)}</h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-3.5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 rounded-xl shrink-0">
            <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 tracking-wider">Uncompleted PIAs</span>
            <h3 className={`text-base font-bold font-mono mt-0.5 ${pendingPiaCount > 0 ? "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 animate-pulse" : "text-slate-900 dark:text-white"}`}>
              {pendingPiaCount} Deficits
            </h3>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setError(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {success && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-955/40 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between shadow-xs animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <span>{success}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setSuccess(null)} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Filter and Search Bar with Clean Grouped Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-955 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl self-start">
          {[
            { id: "All", label: `All Systems (${systems.length})` },
            { id: "Intake", label: `Intake Queue (${intakeCount})`, isAlert: intakeCount > 0 },
            { id: "Operational", label: `Part II.C: Operational (${operationalCount})` },
            { id: "Proposed", label: `Part III.D: Proposed (${proposedCount})` },
            { id: "For Development", label: `For Development (${devCount})` },
            { id: "For Enhancement", label: `For Enhancement (${enhanceCount})` },
